Last weekend my girl friend and I met up for dinner at Avenue Shabu. It was Friday night so I thought I should put in a reservation or show up early to join the waitlist. I joined the waitlist and checked in with the host as soon as I arrived. All parties must be present upon arrival. They are prompt, once seated you are seated the start the timer. The menu is AYCE, so for dinner is $32.99 and premium dinner is $36.99. We chose $32.99 and ordered a drink. The food was good and the service was great!

This place is located inside a shopping center, Bella Terra. All parking located in front and around the restaurant are designated parking for 90 mins. Highly recommend arriving early and parking in the structure located across from Costco.

I found out about this place from TikTok so I thought I'd try the reverse happy hour special. Got the Szechuan broth for an extra charge and the broth was ok, but a bit bland. You can order meats through a QR code which is convenient and the service is nice and attentive. 5 stars for the service. Seafood and veggies and noodle are at the self-serve bar.

The reason why for the low rating is because I got sick with stomach pains after eating here. Given the previous reviews that also mentioned food poisoning, it seems likely that the restaurant can use some work improving hygiene and food safety conditions.

Saw this place on TikTok. I've had this bookmarked on Yelp for a while and finally got to try. I think this is my new favorite AYCE hotpot place. It was clean, modern, and aesthetic. Manager was super nice and gave us a free drink since it was our first time. There was good variety of proteins, veggies, and noodles. Plus there was an option to add AYCE sushi. I liked how they let you sample the broth options before choosing. Definitely worth the price and will be back again soon.

There were 12 of us last week and we were seated promptly! The service was fantastic. Restaurant was clean and air conditioned and had great ventilation. We love Shabuya but this was closer to us and liked much better! Great broths, AYCE buffet was fabulous and our meat was always refilled fast! Can't wait to go again!

It's a pretty solid shabu spot. The prices are pretty good and the selection of sides is quite nice. The sauce bar also offers a yuzu ponzu sauce, which not many places have. The broth selection is also quite extensive and delicious.
The service was okay. They put us in a corner and forgot about us. The food was okay, the broth was the highlight have had others where the veggie selection was better

Great food, great service, and at a great price point! Their Late-night reverse happy hour is such a good deal!!! From Mon-Thurs from 8:30-9:45 PM, you can choose between 4 broth options & 5 meat options for $19.99/per person with the option to add-on additional meats such as their wagyu. I tried their add-on wagyu and it absolutely melts in your mouth. I would definitely recommend trying it (it was my fav meat). They also have a premium lunch or dinner option, which includes their ayce shabu shabu + sushi rolls. I usually get their premium dinner option and they've been so consistent each time I visit! All of the workers are so helpful and the food comes out so fast! Genuinely one of my favorite ayce shabu shabu spots.

AVENUE SHABU -- A Chill Spot for a Casual Meal!

My husband and I enjoyed our visit to Avenue Shabu! It's a chill, casual spot with plenty of food options. The shabu is good, and I love the variety of appetizers and sides to choose from! There's a little something for everyone.

The sushi is just so-so, nothing too special, but it's nice to have as an extra option.

My only little gripe is that getting to the back to grab your appetizers can be a bit of a hassle because of the wall blocking the way. LOL!

Overall, my husband and I had a good time! It's a nice spot for a casual meal, especially if you're craving shabu and want plenty of sides to go with it. Service was great. It gets pretty packed.

Good food, lots of choices, and a relaxed vibe! We'd come back again!

Other than the fact that this is one of my family's favorite Shabu spot - always fresh veggies, delicious broth and great service- I dropped my phone in a very difficult area that was hard for them to get - with so much grace, they got it for me! Loved this spot before and even more now! Thank you Alvin and Moon for your help and kindness !

"This is for people who decide to choose the premium menu" you have to know the difference the cuts of meat otherwise they will cheat on you and bring out cheap cuts!!! Be warn!!! So after I confronted the server about the cuts of meat he started to bring out some real Wagu!!

Why did it take me this long to try this place?! I went here to meet up with some friends for lunch and we saw they had an outside patio for AYCE which I didn't even know existed but it was perfect because we had two doggies. They were so accommodating. So many options of broth base and it's ENDLESS! If you get the premium lunch, you also have access to sushi and more meats. I thought there was going to be a huge selection but there were only 2-3 types of rolls so keep that in mind. Other than that, it was very yummy and there were a lot of veggies/add-ons for the shabu shabu itself as well as a sauce bar! I'd definitely come back again!

Its a steal for their deal!! Most important, everything was fresh. Meat is in bright red color (not the brownish, means they are freshly cut). Blue crabs are full of meat, not the soggy type compared with other ayce places. Overall, food quality is on the high side. We thought the broth was a bit bland at first, but until it was boiled and evaporated, it was pretty tasty. They were understaffed for the night we went, but their staffs are the hardest working people.

An amazing and fantastic find!! My daughter and I sat down and we were greeted with a friendly broth cart taster. Chose our broth and the server went over the menu with us. Everything was yummy and really enjoyed the buffet of goodies to choose from. This is our new go to for Shabu!! Wish we new about it sooner.

I can't even talk about the food because it was so just okay that it was entirely forgettable in the context of the rest of our time at this place.

The manager(?) or owner(?) had no tact or spatial awareness or even a semblance of time management, it seemed. We saw our waiter once. The hostess caught an attitude after being asked about the Yelp waitlist. The rest of the staff was great, though. Loved the guy with the broth cart hovering to check on us.

You order meat on your phone if outside or a tablet if inside but our orders didn't come. Or they'd be incomplete or we'd get a different table's stuff. And then the dude would argue with us about how we definitely ordered something because he knows what we ordered on our phones better than we do. Our plates would then stack up because we saw our waiter only once. Truly an experience I have never had at a shabu place before. Definitely unique. Won't be experienced ever again because I won't be coming back.

So 100% not at all worth the wait but super interesting to see a restaurant completely ignore their waitlist and just freestyle the entire night. Maybe everyone should go work at different restaurants, learn something, and then work at Avenue Shabu. Manager included.
My favorite AYCE Shabu restaurant! Friendly staff! We will be back!!! Premium is the way to go!
the interior is beautiful, the staff is so friendly, and the meat quality is great ! also loved the different variety that you could get

We came on a Friday night for a family dinner and were seated right away. We got a table next to the food buffet, which was convenient.

They have a great selection of broths, noodles, and meats. They also have hot drops at the sauce station, which is a must for me when having hot pot! The meats came out quickly after we placed our orders on the tablet.

Service was great. The staff stopped by many times to refill our broth and make sure we had everything we needed. They also offer a senior discount, which is great for my mom since she doesn't eat that much.

Overall, we had a great experience. Good selection, fast service, and attentive staff. Would definitely come back!

you know you a regular when they already know your regular soup base #1avenuefanthanku

clean & organized in door seating
This is our new go to Shabu. Fast service, great food. You gotta try the beef bowl. Atmosphere is great. And the bathroom is clean...LOL.

The food here is good. Great value, lots of variety, amazing seafood selection. But there has been multiple times that I've been here where every single table is covered in dirty dishes. I understand that the broth pots are hot but there is no excuse for leaving every table piled high with dirty plates. It just makes it look unappetizing and unclean. The staff never seem to be in a hurry to tidy up. It's a shame because I really enjoy the food. Hopefully they can staff another busser so this stops happening.
I recommend getting the premium deal. The Wagyu and ribeye meats were super tender. The sushi rolls were pretty good too ! I really liked their herbal broth too

Very disappointing experience at Avenue Shabu.

We brought our small dog with us, and before we were seated, we specifically asked about bringing the dog. The first staff member told us that dogs were allowed and that we could stay on the patio. However, no one clearly explained that the dog was not allowed to sit on a restaurant chair.

We were already in the middle of dinner when another staff member suddenly came over and told us to put our dog on the ground immediately. We were then told that if we could not do so, we needed to leave.

We were not trying to ignore the restaurant's rules. If someone had clearly explained the policy when we arrived, we would have followed it. What was upsetting was being allowed to sit down and start our dinner without being told about the restriction, only to be confronted about it in the middle of our meal.

We simply paid our bill and left rather than create a problem.

I completely understand that restaurants can have rules about pets, and we are happy to respect reasonable rules. But those rules need to be communicated clearly and consistently, especially before customers are seated. The way this situation was handled felt unnecessary and very uncomfortable.

I hope management can use this as an opportunity to make the pet policy clear to customers and ensure that all staff communicate the same information from the beginning.

My friend & I were looking for an AYCE shabu & randomly found this place on Yelp. It was our first time here last weekend on a Saturday night. Place wasn't busy at 5:30 & we got seated right away. Ambiance was nice & modern. They also had outdoor seating but the weather was too hot so we sat inside. Servers were attentive & efficient throughout the night. Each table had its own tablet to order from as far as appetizers, meats, drinks, & dessert. We got our orders pretty quick which was a plus. Since it was AYCE, they had their veggie/seafood/noodle/sauce bar including AYCE sushi if you decide to pay extra for the premium price. We opted for the regular price which was 32.99. Price is affordable. Veggies & seafood were fresh & they served many different kinds of sauces. The only downfall is that the meat was way too thin for my liking. Wish it was a bit thicker in my opinion. I wouldn't say the Meat quality was outstanding as I've had better but it wasn't bad. We had a pleasant surprise at the end where one of the servers offered us free ice cream TOGO bc the weather was too hot. This was such a kind gesture. My friend really enjoyed this place so we plan to come back in the future.

We went with the premium AYCE menu and got our money's worth by piling plates up high with wagyu and ribeye!

Note: There's a 90-minute time limit and no wait time between tablet orders.

I love that everyone gets their own individual hot pot and choice of broth. Ordering meat through the tablet couldn't be easier. The buffet bar offers everything from seafood, vegetables, and mushrooms to sauces and even sushi.

The staff kept everything running smoothly. They brought out our meat almost as soon as we ordered it, cleared away empty plates in no time, and stopped by often to top off our broths.

The variety of food and speedy service make this a great spot for casual dates, hangouts, or family outings.

One star, and it's entirely because of how the meal ended.

I went to Avenue Shabu for the reverse happy hour.

Service throughout the meal was mediocre with long waits for basic meats. They also STRICTLY enforce the time limit so, if you go during busy hours, don't expect to get full. That alone would have made it a two or three star review.

However, the food was decent if you factor in the happy hour price.

What really made it one star was what happened after we paid. An employee straight up confronted me about the tip amount which is CRAZY! I've never had that happen. It was an Asian man with a middle part that seemed to be the manager. If they really are the manager, I would be worried about this place's management.

Is tipping not supposed to be discretionary? The fact that it is being challenged is so unprofessional and genuinely uncomfortable. It turned an underwhelming dinner into one I actively regret.

I definitely won't be back cause WHAT THE HELL?!?!

Decided to try the reverse happy hour at Avenue Shabu, and was completely blown away. It was only night three of this deal, and they absolutely nailed it.

Ambience (9/10) Modern, cozy, and welcoming. I've been to this plaza hundreds of times and had no idea this gem was tucked away here.

The Food (9/10) Broth & Meats: Got the recommended Tsuyu broth--flavorful, deep, and spot on. The meat quality is incredible for the price: top-tier pork belly, brisket, short plate, and blade meat.

Seafood Spread: Crawfish, crab, shrimp, mussels, clams, lobster balls, and roe-stuffed fish balls.

Veggies & DIY Sauce Bar: Fresh bok choy, crown daisy, Napa cabbage, spinach, and enoki mushrooms. The sauce bar is fully stocked with sesame (goma), shoyu, minced garlic, chili drops, and custom house mixes.

Dessert: Do NOT skip the Ube ice cream.

Service (10/10) The staff operates like the Avengers. Shoutout to William (Iron Man)--he was flying everywhere, dropping nukes of top-tier service. Food arrived fast, empty plates were cleared constantly, and extra napkins appeared before we even asked.

Overall (10/10) Premium broths, high-grade meats, a stacked sauce bar, and fantastic vibes. Getting an AYCE spread like this for $20 is an absolute no-brainer.

Pro-Tip: Reverse happy hour seating starts STRICTLY at 8:30 PM.

No brainer... stop by if you're in the area.
10/10 great service, and delicious broth and meats. Only thing was the noodles and broth were a bit salty. Other than that it was awesome!

What I got: AYCE DINNER PREMIUM $36.99 (Includes unlimited meat/wagyu options and sushi)

Fish Bowl Cocktail Screw Kiss Snow Ju

I love this place! The options are soo good and worth it for the price!

The ambiance is a little elevated very different from other Ayce hotpot I know! Have plenty of seating very pretty inside and clean! The service is amazing it's fast if you need any alcohol or extra meat and self as serve by the bar for hotpot side dishes/sauces and sushi.

The price is sooo affordable! The options are plenty to choose from! We got the AYCE dinner premium and it was soo worth it! It comes with unlimited meat/wagyu/sushi options.

The food is sooo goood! I love the broths they're very flavorful and a lot to choose from, Ofcourse I love the Wagyu! Everything was fresh and clean soo important for Ayce! The vegetables and other ingredients are always fresh! They always refill the bar area! The sauces are a lot to choose from as well and love mixing and making my own sauce shabang! The meats are soft, and really good! I'm obsessed with the soju!!! It's sooo huge! Plus it comes with the ice cream popsicle perfect for this cocktail drink! It's soo worth it a definitely must!!!

I will highly recommend this to my friends this is another good spot for a hotpot for me! Will comeback to try more

This is a modern AYCE shabu spot with a clean, vibey atmosphere with an interactive fun dining experience. The restaurant had a wide selection to choose from their menu such as broth, vegetable, meats, seafood, and other desserts - all at such an affordable price. Everything tasted fresh and the orders came out quickly. The staff were very attentive and friendly and always came around to check in on us to make sure everything was going well

I especially liked their mocktails (Avenue Azure & Avenue Citrine) - they were beautifully presented, refreshing, and a fun addition to the meal.

Overall, Avenue Shabu is definitely a spot worth checking out! It's perfect for group dinners or catching up over something warm and comforting. A place where you not only come for the food but also the experience and the wide variety of options that is available.

I was at Avenue Shabu yesterday for lunch. As always, the food is fresh and delicious! And, it's all healthy!

At first, I thought Kelly was the hostess as she greeted us with friendliness, courtesy and a wonderful smile, and led us to our booth. We ordered our meats, etc. from the very efficient tablet, and Dillon brought us our order. Kelly continued checking up on us, and we saw how she was taking care of other tables, cleaning, etc. in addition to taking care of our needs. Dillon also checked up on us, and because we thought Dillon was our server, we asked for our needs from him which he obliged with courtesy and respect.

It was not until the check came that I realized Kelly was our actual server. No wonder she was so attentive!

I must write that Dillon and Kelly certainly make a wonderfully fantastic team. They will both "drop" what they are doing to take care of you.

The food is always great, but it is the service that truly defines the heart and soul of Avenue Shabu!

One of the better shabu spots I've tried in OC. The meat quality is really good for AYCE, especially the wagyu which was easily my favorite cut. The rib eye and brisket were solid too. I went with the spicy miso broth and really liked it. Good flavor with a nice kick to it. The self-serve bar is stocked with plenty of fresh seafood, veggies, sauces, and extras like lobster balls. They even have sushi rolls, which were surprisingly pretty on point too. The space is big and clean, and service was very attentive throughout the meal. Overall, we really enjoyed it. Good quality meats, plenty of options, and everything you want from an AYCE shabu spot. Would definitely come back.

I came on a Saturday night with a party of 7 and even though the wait was very long, the host was super accommodating and kind so that we could be seated as soon as possible. It was about an hour so I would recommend joining the waitlist early or calling ahead of time, especially if you want to sit on the patio since there's limited space there. It's around 32 per person for the regular dinner selection. The vegetable and seafood bar is pretty standard as well. The service was also great throughout as our table was constantly getting checked on so there was no need to chase down a waiter. My only gripe would be the flavor of the broths, which were a bit bland. Even the schezuan spicy broth was barely spicy.

Nice ambience, some veggies were not fresh, and seafood still frozen. Not sure what hit my stomach but I had a stomach after that. A bit pricey for standard menu, no desserts no drinks for free like other ayce Shabu.
We enjoyed the food but our server dropped off the bill too early (which is fine) but he checked to see if we had paid already which destroyed the experience

Enjoyed this shabu experience more than the one in Irvine I shall not name. Very clean and the tables have a warmer for each person to get a different broth. Good sauce bar. Service was good, always taking dirty plates and filling our ice water and broth as needed. Did not like the sushi rolls from the buffet bar, and I tried at least 4 kinds. Very mushy. Overall, I would definitely dine here again!
Great service. Fast service! Beefs are in amazing quality! Will visit again! Before you know it your ordered items are in!

The premium dinner was outstanding, especially the wagyu beef and the delicious sushi selection. The quality of the food exceeded my expectations. The service was friendly and attentive, and the atmosphere made the whole experience even better. We had such a wonderful time and will absolutely be coming back. Highly recommended!
Everything was perfect and the service was awesome staff and customers service. Great

I had my doubts about a shabu spot located in Huntington Beach of all places, but ended up here for a work lunch and was pleasantly surprised.

Each person gets their own individual pots and they have a variety of broths to choose from. If you're not too sure which broth you want to commit to, they'll give you a small sample to help you choose! I ended up with the Chinese herbal broth and it went nicely with the goma and ponzu dipping sauces.

They have a self-serve bar for sauces, vegetables, raw seafood, and even sushi! The sushi was surprisingly good for an ayce shabu spot and there were 4-5 roll options to choose from.

I love that each table has a screen to order drinks, appetizers, meats, and desserts because it made the whole dining experience run so seamlessly (especially for our large group) and we weren't left waiting for any food to come!

The only downside is that the premium lunch option doesn't include wagyu, so I'll have to come back for dinner.

This place is a hidden gem. I didn't know they existed until recently. Their pricing is pretty good given the high quality meat they offer and the wide selection of their self serve bar. Not only is the ambiance nice and cozy, their service is also very good. I really enjoyed their Wagu cuts but all the other meats were actually also pretty good. My kid is very picky on what to eat, and this place has a good selection of other appetizers and dishes that you can order. They also have sushi, milk tea, and ice cream. I got the tonkatsu soup base and it was flavorful. Overall, I had a great time here. I would come back here for birthday celebrations with friends, cause it's just a nice place and easy for gathering.

Went here for this first time last night and everything was great! The meat was sliced thin but it was great quality, they have a variety of vegetable, broths, and sauces to choose from. The customer service was great too, very friendly staff. You order your meat off the screen at your table and it comes out quickly. Definitely recommend this spot for AYCE Shabu.

We're definitely coming back for happy hour.

good broth and buffet selections. meat portions are on the smaller side. favorite part were their hot side dishes which surprisingly were warm and fresh tasting. happy about that.

will come back :)

replying to owner comment: i came thursday night, mistyped as friday cuz halloweekend felt bundled. attached my payment as proof that i was there. and also i was ordering 3-4 portions of each meat during the first rounds, and each plate had 4-5 slices. so ur saying 3 orders of pork belly = 5 pieces? for 4 people? i started ordering only 1 order per meat at the end because the numbers weren't making sense, and i was still getting the same amount of meat... so also i guess, 1 order = 3 orders?

came here on friday night for their late night special. me and my whole party came in person and i saw that they had the ipad open for yelp waitlist. i joined the waitlist through the yelp app (cuz its the same time and my whole party was already here) and then waited outside for about ten minutes when i got a text that said "you were removed from the yelp waitlist", so i went inside to ask.

the server guy said "you have to be here in person to join the waitlist, we aren't accepting waitlists from the app". first off, why even open your app waitlists if you're not accepting it, plus i was literally there already with my entire party. then he mentioned that he called me on my phone, but when i got the call on my phone, it didn't even ring once fully before he dropped the call and i couldn't pick up. it's giving "calling just to prove that he attempted". note that i wasn't even at the top of the waitlist when they removed me. and they didn't even attempt to call out my name (and i assume other people too) outside where everyone was waiting. we were already there so i just rejoined the waitlist with him directly and waited again but this time from the bottom of the list.

their ordering system also sucks. for each round of meat i ordered, i was ordering multiple plates of the meats. like i would get 2 of the pork belly. but they only brought out one each time. no matter what meat it was or the quantity, i just got one. every. time. there's like 5 pieces of meat on the plate and there's four of us eating, so we ended up waiting on scraps like the entire night.

i used to enjoy coming here but until the quality and system of service improves, i don't see myself giving avenue shabu another chance.

"This is for people who decide to choose the premium menu" you have to know the difference the cuts of meat otherwise they will cheat on you and bring out cheap cuts!!! Be warn!!! So after I confronted the server about the cuts of meat he started to bring out some real Wagu!!
you know you a regular when they already know your regular soup base #1avenuefanthanku

Great service and the staff is very nice. I would recommend this place if you are looking to experience something new.

Broths are very bland. I tried the spicy miso and the regular miso and both are bland compared to other places. This sucked since when cooking the meat, you're forced to eat it with sauce or some type of dipping which I don't usually do.

Service was fine, came by to grab the empty plates, immediately brought out our meat, and made sure we had water.

As for the interior, it's really nice inside! Overall, I'd probably only go here for lunch but besides that, I'd go somewhere else.

The food is astonishingly mid. The appetizers are just bad but that's what you usually expect at an AYCE so I can let that slide. The broths unfortunately were extremely bland and flavorless. We got to sample 4 different broths: I thought they were all very bland but attributed it to the fact that the samples were cold/lukewarm instead of hot. We ended up choosing the schezuan and pho broths but even with the fire boiling, there was no flavor or depth.The meats were okay but the seafood was very fishy. The service /staff were probably the best part of the dining experience. The service was great: they let you sample the broths if it's your first time and also refill your broth for you throughout the dinner. I just wish the food could match in quality.

This is one of our favorite shabu spots. Wait time is short for our party of 2! They have a decent amount of choices. A plus is that the appetizers are included in the AYCE. There's 2 sets of pricing. We are good with the cheaper option! Higher pricing tier includes sushi & more meat options! Staff is attentive and picks up our empty trays fast! And don't forget your bowl of rice tucked in the far left corner! I would recommend joining the yelp waitlist too! Especially if you have a big group! We come here at least once a month!

So excited to have found a great new Shabu spot! To begin, it's a very modern and clean vibe in there. I really appreciate it how clean the entire space was and the tables weren't too close together, and they had ample booths. Fortunately, my booth was right across from the food station, so it was very easy to get all the sides. I couldn't believe that they had sushi sitting there on the side as well, and it looked very fresh, and there were definitely no flies lurking nearby, which I definitely pay attention to.

The portions were good and considering it's an all-you-can-eat spot, they had a really large menu. I was surprised that they had a lot of Wagyu available as well. Can't wait to come back!

The ambiance in the restaurant was nice. The service was responsive. For the food, many of them were frozen, including the meat options. What I did like about the restaurant was the tablet for self order and the ice cream.

Note: I don't have the receipt for this location because a friend paid and I forgot to take a picture of the receipt.
This is definitely one of our favorite restaurants. The food is so delish. Everyone here is so friendly and efficient.

This might be my new favorite AYCE shabu-shabu spot! Located at Bella Terra, my family chose the premium dinner menu for $37 per person, which includes wagyu, ribeye, and sushi. They offer a great variety of broths, and you can even mix flavors. Our favorite was the house tsuyu broth, which had a rich, sukiyaki-style flavor.

The self-serve buffet features a wide selection of noodles, vegetables, seafood, dipping sauces, and sushi. There are also appetizers you can order from the tablet, plus a good variety of meats.

The meat was tender, the broth was flavorful, and all of the ingredients tasted fresh. We also appreciated how well-stocked the buffet remained throughout our visit. The restaurant itself is spacious, clean, and organized.

For drinks, we tried the fishbowl cocktails (watermelon wave and big jaws) along with a few mocktails. The cocktails were fun and strong, and my mom especially enjoyed her mocktail.

Service was amazing! Our waiter was friendly and took the time to explain the broth options to my parents, even offering samples. The staff kept our table clear of empty plates, and service was fast and attentive. We also met the manager, Alvin, who was very kind. The food, service, and atmosphere made it well worth the price!

Amazing place. So much food to choose from.
Clean and waiters very helpful.
Will come back again.

Avenue Shabu hits every time. The quality is way better than most AYCE/shabu spots -- everything tastes fresh, the ingredients are well stocked, and the sushi bar is actually good. I love being able to grab exactly what I want without feeling rushed or crowded.
Service is fast and super attentive. They're always on top of refills, checking in, and clearing plates so your table doesn't get messy. Dinner pricing is fair for how much variety you get, and the hot appetizers are delicious. Honestly, I could eat a whole plate of those alone.
If you're craving shabu and want something reliable, clean, and tasty, this place is an easy yes.
A cute little shabu restaurant, they have a decent amount of options as far as veggies, seafood and meat. They also offer other options that include sushi. Definitely recommend their brisket!

We came here on a Monday evening for dinner to celebrate a birthday and had the best experience. Sat outside because we had our dog with us but service remained top tier. Staff were very attentive and made us and even our dog feel so welcome. We ordered from the premium menu and let me tell you- you must upgrade!! The Wagyu cuts here beat any other AYCE shabu place I've been to. The marbling is insane and they sliced the meat to perfection where it's not too thick or thin. Literally melts in your mouth. I also appreciate the wide selection of seafood, veggies and sushi rolls that you grab yourself. From the service to the food to the pricing, we were truly blown away. Will definitely be back!

great place for when you're craving wagyu shabu and sushi!! meat quality was amazing. the options at the buffet bar were solid too--seafood, noodles, veggies, and more. all the broths were yummy; you're able to sample them before choosing!

servers were very attentive! restaurant is super clean, loved my experience. parking is pretty easy as well, there's a very big lot nearby

I was pleasantly surprised by all the options available! I usually go to Broth in Cerritos, but now definitely prefer here. It's a newer, cleaner restaurant and has more appetizer, soup, protein, and veggie options. They let you sample the soup bases and you order everything through a kiosk. Service is quick, you occasionally need to waive down a server but everything for the most part is self-service. I think it's only indoor seating but the parking lot is manageable and it's located in Bella Terra. Overall a great option for shabu shabu and definitely worth the slight pay difference!

seriously had the best time here!! alvin, the manager, was so nice and the service was amazing. not only that, the interior was clean and modern!! they had so many different broths to choose from, and a huge selection of seafood, veggies, tofu, and more!! not to mention the sushi. the drinks were also so so good. my bestie and i loved our experience here and will be bringing out friends back to try!!

Looooong over due review but my go-to hotpot whenever I'm in the area! Bars are always freshly stocked and cleaned every few minutes. Broth is delicious and there's a variety you can pick from. What's even better is that you get your own pot. Highly recommend!
The food is fresh and delicious. Everyone is so attentive from filling up all the ingredients to making sure you have enough broth. The place is very clean, even the bathrooms. Can't wait to go back.
Amazing customer service by Brielle at the front. The restaurant is very nice and modern. great music and the food was excellent
I came here yesterday with my family. The food was delicious and the service was great!

This place has the most creative broth options such as pho, soondubu, curry, sichuan, and many more. Literally recreated pho with the pho broth since they have the noodles and veggies

Their wagyu quality was insane, must try !! i also loved their soju cocktails, each one came with a a different popsicle. service was also rlly good!

I actually heard of this place through Instagram ads and me and my friend tried it for the first time! He got sukiyaki broth. I got tom yum but I didn't like it so they let me switch it out :) the pork bone was better.
Also I spilled my WHOLE PLATE OF VEGETABLES ON MY SEAT but they were really nice about it.

Service was amazing but I wasn't too keen on their broth. The salad bar is not bad either.
Meat quality is not bad for ayce.

I like the set up inside and it's really bright! Which I like. And parking is easy too.

Everything was pretty good and lots of variety on veggies, meats and seafood but their service could be stepped up a notch, we ordered drinks, they didn't come and they messed up the appetizers we ordered. Also I'm
A ponzu snob and both their regular and yuzu ponzu have way too much citrus. All in all pretty good deal, I would go back for the meats and veggies though.
Great food great service and friendly staffs. Not to mention the location by Bella Terra!

I'm updating my 4-star review to a 5-star review for a few reasons. Every time I come here, I'm treated wonderfully by Alvin and the rest of the Avenue Shabu staff. They consistently tend to me, and never have I had a dull moment where I needed to flag down a server. To put it simply, every time I dine here, I feel truly valued as a guest.

The food has also never let me down and is always high quality. I want to clarify why I originally posted a 4-star review: on my first visit, I ordered their Szechuan broth, which happened to be a bit too salty for my liking, making my meats and veggies overly salty as well. Since then, I've consistently ordered their spicy miso broth, which has the perfect flavor for me and always hits the spot!

Following my recent visit, I knew I had to revise my review because this is definitely a 5-star establishment for me -- from the service, to the upscale ambiance, to the quality of the food. The fact that they are dog-friendly and also tend to my fur baby by offering her a water bowl is something I greatly appreciate.

Overall, I highly recommend Avenue Shabu to anyone in need of a great dinner option. Support your local businesses!

I honestly was disappointed in this place.. their broth was so bland.. i got their tom yum broth.. even after all the meat and veggies have been cooked in it.. i even added garlic and green onions to flavor my broth more. The sauce selection didn't have that much variety for me to make a good sauce for my meat and veggies. Their sushi was good, but fills you up fast.
Service was actually really good. I would
Not come back again.

My best friend was craving shabu, so my husband and I treated her to this all-you-can-eat spot that we like. We went with the premium dinner option, which comes with wagyu and ribeye. They have a great selection of seafood, vegetables, and noodles. They also have some good sushi rolls. Shoutout to Jessica for being our wonderful server last Friday!

Came in on a Friday to try the lunch special. I was SO excited because the menu looked stacked with broth options and photos I've seen of the self-service bar looked great too (enoki mushroom!!!). As I sampled their broths, I immediately knew I had to try to Tom Yum. I love Tom Yum, but what I sampled was not what I've ever had. Overall, the broths that I sampled were not up to par with what I've had at other places. I was a bit disappointed. I got the combo I get everywhere else (tonkotsu/spicy miso) and it also ended up not being that great compared to my experience with that combo at other places. The same thing for the sauce. The goma was really thick and the yuzu ponzu didn't quite deliver for me either.

For the $24 lunch price point, I felt that the meat was decent.

I was happy to see a few things that I couldn't get elsewhere: enoki mushroom, yuuz ponszu, sushi

Service was amazing, but please note that it was a weekday and there weren't too many people at the time. The staff were nice and one of them brought us broth samples, which is great since there are so many options on the menu. They were super attentive, and pretty much picked up trays as we put them down. Again, keeping in mind that this was at opening on a weekday.

Tldr; broth was not to my taste (including what I sampled and even the spicy miso/tonkotsu that I normally order everywhere), but service was great! Meat was decent for the price point

This is mine and my boyfriend's go-to shabu spot! It's truly a gem. The service is always on point and the ambiance is great. Moon usually takes care of us and he's amazing. He always makes sure we're well taken care of and goes above and beyond.

i tried it for the first time and got the premium menu for the sushi but didn't realize the sushi was quite limited haha, but dor $38 ayce, still pretty good with the selection. the wagyu was ok tho, not the best but it's good. staff were really nice and gave free ice cream for the anniversary! speedy service and clean facility

I really wanted to enjoy this place, but the buffet line is disappointing as well as the flavors of the broth. I got the tom yum and it was pretty watered down, but when I asked for a new broth they said they would charge me so i just stuck with it. meats were pretty decent though! sauce bar could be better as well. overall, I would give them another try just maybe a little longer down the road as I am sure improvements are always happening (:
The food was sooo goood with so many options to choose from. Service was amazing everyone was so nice and made sure you had an amazing experience. Would come again!!
OMGGGG the absolute best shabu evaaaaa, the servers are great and service is super quick! 10/10 will come back again hehe

I love this place. We live right across the street and walk over all the time. Their speed of service is crazy fast! My meat usually comes out just minutes after ordering it on the tablet. Veggie selection is great too - not a lot of places have enoki mushrooms, my favorite!!!

Not to mention they have a great all-you-can-drink happy hour during late nights. The best!!

I love AYCE shabu, even better when it comes with AYCE sushi! Although, I didn't try any of the sushi because I was too full from the shabu and there wasn't any at the time I wanted to grab it. So will be back to try the sushi next time.

I came in on a Saturday right before the dinner rush. It looks like dinner rush starts at 6pm-ish. There's indoor and outdoor seating. It was pretty cold outside on the day I went, but the outdoor seating was enclosed so it wasn't cold at all.

You can ask to try the broth before choosing the one you want. My favorite was the house tsuyu. The premium menu is worth it if you love wagyu! There's also a sauce bar and self serve rice. Very clean restaurant with a huge selection of seafood, veggies, noodles that you grab on your own. The staff are really good about making their rounds to take your order. Definitely will be back!

Our first time this afternoon for 2pm lunch. Good pricing for ALOT of tasty food. A wide selection of meats with a variety of sauces and veggies. KAREN our server was great to highlight best combinations, with great results. Ask for her. Will be returning with more friends.
Brad D

I recently celebrated a casual birthday get-together here this past weekend.

Pros:
- I called to make a reservation since we were a fairly large group and they were able to accommodate. However, there was no wait when we came in at 12PM on a Saturday.
- They have normal meal price or premium price. The only difference is premium comes with the sushi rolls. The sushi rolls are actually really good considering this is a shabu place. My favorite broth is the Chinese herb.
- Place is very clean and decently ventilated.

Cons:
- Parking can be difficult. This plaza seems to be really packed all the time.
- After the 1st initial trays of sushi rolls, we waited at least 30 mins for another batch...I finally had to ask a server if they were making more because our party was waiting for this. We all loved the sushi rolls so this put a slight damper in our experience.

I was too busy hanging out with friends to take pictures this time around, but I'll be back. This is my 2nd visit and definitely not my last. I heard it's dog-friendly so I'm definitely coming back!

Such a great spot!! Highly recommend the premium menu, it was so flavorful and delicious! The service is so quick! We got our meats literally right after ordering. So many options to choose from and also loved the cocktails!! The watermelon wave was my favorite
Everything was so fresh and clean! The soontofu broth was rich and flavorful, and the wagyu beef was great quality, tender and delicious. Such a good shabu shabu spot and will definitely come back!
Food is really good for its price! Meats are fresh and good quality. Even sushi was good too! Everyone is really friendly, especially ryan was very professional and kind.

We've eaten here twice and had a fantastic time twice! The food is fresh and delicious! The ambiance is fun. The best thing is the customer service - from the time you walk the staff is friendly, helpful and happy! We will be back!

Korean style Shabu!!! Not bland just a vast array of flavor options. Someone said the "Szechuan flavor was salty" "Hot pot" ‍ that'd be China ma'am.

Anywho service was excellent, meat, and array of buffet options were fresh and delicious. We enjoyed every single bite. It's got a nice modern vibe, very clean. Healthy and delicious!

The rolls and shabu-shabu were absolutely delicious! The staff were incredibly kind and attentive, and I felt happy the entire time. It was so good that I even forgot to take pictures

After going to Huntington Beach, it warmed me up perfectly.

The strawberry ice cream for dessert at the end was especially amazing--such a perfect finish to the meal. Highly recommend!

Our first time at Avenue Shabu! We have done shabu many times. It was a wonderful experience from start to finish. We enjoyed the premium meats and the buffet bar with all the veggies and sides. There was so much to choose from as well. The service was phenomenal and everything was run efficiently. Alvin was so helpful and welcoming. He made our experience a 10/10. It's a great setting and very clean. We are looking forward to our next visit. Great date night, night out with friends or family dinner.
Food and service great! Sushi was fresh. Did take a while for them to replenish sushi but that just gave me time to eat the shabu!! Didn't get chance to try their alcohol drinks.

The meat quality here was really good. Usually at other AYCE shabu places, the first 2-3 orders are good and then the meat quality kind of drops, but here it was consistently good from start to finish.

The vegetables and seafood were also fresh, which I liked. For the soup base, I personally liked the Sundubu more than the Miso.

Our server was very friendly and attentive, and someone who seemed like a manager also came by to check on us a few times. Maybe it was because we had babies with us, but overall the service was really good.

I'd definitely come back again.

Wow, such a clean and well ventilated Shabu spot.
Stopped by after watching a movie on Sunday and had a great time. They had a variety of soup choices and absolutely loved that you get your own pot, so you don't have to share (in case you have any allergies).
They have the self serve area very well labeled and stocked up. Enjoyed the amount of sauces they have, especially since they give ideas on what to mix.
We ordered the premium menu. The broths were flavorful! There is a wide variety of oils and selection at the buffet-styled bar. Service was fast and great! Definitely plan on returning!
The food is great and the service is impeccable. I would definitely recommend the premium menu, the sushi and premium meats are worth it. Free refill on drinks too.

This place I did not want to share review as I wanted to keep it as my secret place. They have variety of broths to choose from with the most fresh vegetables available. We got the premium lunch with sushi included. They didn't have a lot of selections for the rolls but OMG the quality was outstanding and it was sooooooo good. Meat was amazing as well.
It's fairly new so you know the restaurant is super clean and spacious. I would definitely avoid weekends as it may get super crowded but best of all the servers were very and I mean VERY kind and customer oriented. I highly recommend for family or friend gatherings heck even a nice date spot!
Too bad I wasn't able to take photos because I was so busy eating and then remembered.

I really enjoyed shabu shabu! It was really delicious and meat quality was good too! I ordered tofu soup for mine and my friend ordered miso soup. They were both good. I also ordered soju cocktail. I enjoyed all menu and I will definitely come again. Their ice cream was insane btw.

Probably the best ayce shabu shabu you can find in OC right now. All the meat were super high quality and the soup bases were so creative and different. We had pho, schezuan, and soontofu soup base. Never seen pho soup base at a shabu shabu and it felt like unlimited pho with premium wagyu and fresh veggies that you can get from the salad bar. The soontofu had a very savory flavor that you would get from a premium kbbq place and it complimented super well with egg and egg noodles. The schezuan was like the typical mala that most shabu shabu usually carry and it never goes wrong. The servers were super attentive and constantly stopped by to give refills on water, soup, and meat. The place is kept super clean and you can't even see water stains on any of their tablewares. They also have good happy hour deals that we didn't get to try so we will definitely be back for it!

Love how clean this place is and has lots of choices from the veggie bar and sauces!

Meat quality was good as well! Easy to order with the tablet on the table and nice customer service!

Will definitely come back soon!

Came here to celebrate a birthday and it was my bfs first time having Shabu. I'm so glad we came here because the service was amazing! The manager Alvin took great care of us from showing us different sauce, meat and side options. William who also helped served us was super sweet !

Very clean restaurant and the atmosphere was welcoming and fun. So happy we found a new favorite place close to home and we plan on coming back soon !

A good choice for Shabu Shabu. My coworkers and I chose this place for a celebration dinner. We appreciated their variety broth options as well as buffet options that were also vegetarian friendly. I chose the Tsuyu broth and it was savory and sweet, which really complemented our premium meats. One neat thing about their buffet is that they also have specialty sushi rolls available which were also yummy! We sat outside and had a lovely view of the fountain and felt that the atmosphere outside was a lot more loose versus the bustling activity indoors. Our service, namely Moon, was very attentive to our needs when it came to broth refills, meat delivery and drinks.

Food - house broth & spicy miso was great flavorful , meats, toppings all yummy
Service -staff super helpful & very knowledgeable, so kind
Ambiance - clean atmosphere, rest rooms & dining areas
10 out of 10 I recommend

We've had such a great experience at Avenue Shabu and keep coming back! The service is always fast, the meat selection is really good, and everything comes out fresh and quickly, which makes the whole hot pot experience really enjoyable every time we visit.

One of the servers, Moon, has taken care of us multiple times and is always amazing. He's very attentive, makes sure our broths stay full, and keeps the meat coming out in a timely manner without us having to ask. It really shows how on top of things he is and it makes the experience even better :)

The manager Alvin also stopped by to check on us throughout our visit, which was really thoughtful. He was very kind and made sure we were enjoying everything. Overall the staff is welcoming, the food is great, and the service keeps us coming back. Definitely one of our favorite spots!

My husband and I come and dine here at least once a month!! There are so many different broths to choose from and a lot of meat choices as well! We always order the premium menu, and even if you go at lunch time you can order dinner premium items (you'll just get charged the dinner premium cost which is fine). The service is great and they actually just launched a new tablet ordering system at the tables so you can order all of your drinks, appetizers and meats at the table. It does lock you out for 5 minutes after you make your order but you can just flag down a waiter if you need to add something to your order sooner that that. The staff are all super friendly and attentive. I really love that they have sushi at their sides bar - you do need to pay the premium price but we always get premium anyway so it isn't a problem.

Food is delicious, the service are amazing and the ambiance is slightly noisy but not crowded. Although I attended during lunch time of weekdays. Sushi and prime ribs are premium price but you can get regular lunch price and still have an amazing lunch.
Delicious food! Service is quick and attentive. Best shabu ayce in oc hands down. The difference is quality is apparent.
Amazing food and service. Everything was delicious and the vegetable bar was very clean. My server William was the best! 10/10 service.

The meat here is the best I have ever tasted. Especially the Rib Eye meat. The service is very accommodating, the waiter came around every once in a while to ask if I needed anything which was amazing. The mood and lighting at the restaurant was very soothing.

This place is great. Everyone was so welcoming. Our server William was exceptional and was always quick to get what we needed with great enthusiasm. The food selection is better than I've ever had at any other shabu place. Highly recommend!

This place is clean with a good amount of tables. We selected the premium tier that came with premium cuts of meats and sushi ($37). The broth wasn't too salty and quality of the meat was up there. The sauce bar could've had more options. Some of the sushi was surprisingly tasty. I wish they had replenish more of the popular items often.

The food selection is big enough that you're able to try a little bit of everything and it doesn't get boring. So many options at the cool bar and sauce station. A lot of different broths (I got the herbal broth which was great). The service was very attentive but didn't make us feel pressured to leave even once we were done. For premium menu with tip it cost less than $50 and it was AYCE. Pretty great deal. Would love to come back and try more flavors. The restaurant was quite big so it didn't feel like you were squished with the people next to you. Very clean and bright interior.

Service was great, very attentive!

Premium lunch included premium meat options, sushi bar, & choice of ice cream pint at the end, including matcha ice cream, which we loved.

Great quality in selection and the wait staff was quick and attentive. The premium upgrade for $4 more to include wagyu and rib eye is a no-brainer. I'm definitely coming back. Plus they have my favorite item from the Little Sheep, which is the roe-filled fish balls.

The ambiance is great, and the service is even better. The food is fresh and clean. I love the soondubu broth and my husband loves trying all of flavors. Our toddler loves the seafood and I'm happy that it's fresh and safe for her to eat. The owners liked our daughter so much that they gave us ice cream on the house. Love this place and that it's AYCE! Better than the one down the street in every way.
good choices of meat, seafood, vegetables, noodles, dipping sauces & broths... we all came out full

Came in at 8:30 pm, The host seats guests quickly, and service is fast and efficient. They have an (AYCE) lunch special available weekdays from 11 AM-3 PM, priced around $23.99 for regular and $27.99 for premium. Dinner runs about $32.99-$36.99 for premium, which includes sushi, one Wagyu plate, and bulgogi plates.

We choose tom yum and Pho! it was delicious!!
although the ribeye that was given to us towards the end tasted smell/odd.

Overall,
Fresh vegetables, great konjac spinach noodles, and friendly service made the overall experience pleasant.
Owner/manager asked us if the self order new system was working well, and not going to lie. I enjoy it better. Will come back for another experience.

this is my first review i've ever done on yelp and i haaaad to make an account because moon was absolutely amazing!! we came in 15 minutes before last call and he was so accommodating and made sure we got everything we needed throughout the entire time we were there... we've had him as our server once before and the service is outstanding... thank you moon!!!! we'll definitely be back :)
This spot is definitely a hidden gem. It's very clean inside and the staff attends to you fairly quickly. The food is also delicious. I will be back!

pot experience that feels truly elevated, this place is an absolute gem. From the moment we walked in, everything was spotless -- one of the cleanest restaurants I've been to in a long time. You can immediately tell they take pride in their space and in the quality of what they serve.
The ingredients were incredibly fresh and high-quality -- crisp vegetables, perfectly sliced meats, and broths that tasted rich, comforting, and thoughtfully prepared. Everything felt premium, not just thrown together, and it made the whole meal feel special.
Yes, it's a little on the pricey side, but honestly? Completely worth it. The experience, the cleanliness, the flavor! Win

Places that offer shabu or hotpot depend heavily on the flavor of their broths. Even if the meat is premium, if it's cooked in broth that's lacking it will taste off. This place has the best broths in OC. The meat only adds to the flavor, not making up for lack of. Gosh this is my favorite spot of all time. Khoi my server was super attentive and didn't rush me although I took my time. After trying around 12-15 different hotpots/shabu places in OC I will always come back to Avenue Shabu in the end. Nothing compares.

I come here every Tuesday after I watch a movie they know me by name now lol but this place is absolutely amazing, my favorite server is Michelle she is absolutely the best, friendliest and checks up on you periodically. The Ambience is amazing very cozy and relaxing. Last but not least the food is very good the spicy tofu soup base is my favorite they have plenty of meat options along with veggies I highly suggest this place to everyone.

I absolutely love this place! I have been to a handful of hotpot / shabu places and this is by far my favorite. There's a variety of soup bases to choose from and they've added more over time. My favorite is the soondubu (Korean tofu) base. It's a little spicy but not too bad. You can also mix broths.

Service is always fast and efficient. The servers come by multiple times for meat / appetizer refills.

The tables are mostly 4 people, but some seat 6. Very clean restaurant. Would recommend!!

First time here and it was a pleasant experience. We were immediately sat down and the interior was very modern and clean. We chose the premium dinner option which included the sushi, wagyu and prime beef cuts. The servers constantly checked in on us and offered to submit in more meat orders. The quality of the seafood in the buffet line was very clean and fresh. I really liked the veggie options, again everything was clean and organized. The staff was constantly refilling low items and ensured the tongs were clean. I also really liked that this restaurant has a wide variety of broth for your hot pot. I chose the pho option and it didn't disappoint. I will certainly be back in the near future.

The best shabu with excellent service and there is an outdoor area so we can take our dog!! We were in the area and looking for an outdoor restaurant so we can take our dog. I came across this restaurant and we absolutely loved it!!

First, love the individual pot. They also have a variety of soup base. This is an all you can eat shabu shabu. The meats are served while everything else is buffet style. The he Wagyu, filet and lamb were my favorite!! All the veggies are so fresh too.

Big shoutout to Moon. The best server! He was so friendly. He made sure to check up on us and made our dinner so much more enjoyable!!

We will definitely come back when we are in the area!!

Great shabu shabu spot with a ton of options so good place to come with people who like different things. The broth selection is amazing! My favorites are the soondubu and tonkatsu. They also have a wide variety of vegetables, so you can mix things up every time. Service is always quick and attentive. For appetizers, the japchae and karaage are my go tos and never disappoint. Solid place overall and easy to come back to.

Craving hot pot on a rainy day and kept hearing great things about Avenue Shabu, so we finally gave it a try. Since it was raining, there was a wait, but it honestly wasn't bad at all. Service was excellent--staff were attentive and accommodating, especially when we requested help for our baby, which we really appreciated. Ambiance was modern and comfortable, great for a cozy hot pot meal.

The sauce station could use some improvement though--sauce bowls were noticeably missing, which made it a bit inconvenient. There is a premium option that adds two wagyu beef choices and sushi, but we opted out. Honestly, once it's in the hot pot, wagyu and regular beef tasted pretty much the same to us, so the regular menu was more than enough.

Where Avenue Shabu really shines is the buffet selection. Tons of great options: scallops, mussels, clams, fish, eggs, crawfish, multiple types of tofu, mushrooms, and a wide variety of vegetables. Soup base options were also solid, and you can mix and match. I got the tonkatsu broth and it was rich and delicious. My mom ordered the herbal broth, which tasted very clean and comforting, and my husband went with spicy miso and tonkatsu--every broth we tried was flavorful and satisfying.

Overall, a strong hot pot spot with great service, variety, and atmosphere. Minor tweaks could elevate the experience even more, but we'd definitely come back the next time a hot pot craving hits.
Clean, fresh, and with lots of varieties to pick on the regular menu. Service is excellent

Food:
Everyone gets their own soup pot and bowl, which I love, and you can refill or even switch broths if you want. They start you off with a broth tasting so you can try a few before choosing. You can also control the heat level yourself with buttons at the table, so you are not stuck waiting for someone to adjust it. I got the sczechuan broth because I love spicy and this was perfect. It wasn't too spicy but had a good spicy kick.

The premium option was nice. It includes the sushi bar plus extra meat options like ribeye and wagyu. Meats come out three at a time. The sushi was actually good quality and they also switch up the rolls pretty often, so there is usually something new to try.

There are two sauce bars and also bottled sauces set up next to the sushi like white vinegar, soy sauce, sesame oil, sriracha, and more, so you can customize everything exactly how you like it.

Service:
Service was great. The staff was always checking in, refilling water, clearing plates, and making sure we had what we needed. Super easy to get their attention and everyone was friendly and helpful the whole time. Even when it was busy, we never felt ignored.

Ambiance:
The place was busy with people waiting outside even though there are a lot of tables. The atmosphere feels lively but still chill at the same time. It is a fun spot without feeling too loud or stressful.
The broth was really flavorful and their was so many sauces that we can choose. The staffs were really kind and greeting. Overall everything was amazing and I would go back there.

Food (5/5): Solid veggie, seafood, fishball, and carb options here comparable to shabuya and broth shabu-shabu. They had a few unique broths and sauces (hibachi, Thai chili) that I haven't seen in other places and broths weren't overly salty. It's also so rare for a place to have both the Chinese bbq satay/shacha sauce and the standard ponzu + goma sauces. I wish they had soft tofu and not just firm/frozen. You can sample a few broths before picking. Meat slices are thin but good quality, and they come with only 3-4 slices per plate.

Service (5/5): multiple servers/bussers constantly roaming and immediately removing empty dishes and asking if you need more meat. We actually don't eat that much meat so maybe one suggestion is to implement a card system where if you want more meat, you can flip it to one side, and if you want to take a break, you can flip it to the other side. We're probably the minority, but I wonder if some people would find it tiresome to constantly say they don't want more meat and just want to eat vegetables lol. They accidentally overcharged us and we didn't notice until they came back to refund us and recharge us the correct amount. Hard to find a place that operates with such honesty and integrity.

Ambiance (4.5/5): Modern and very clean and organized! Busy, but no wait. The only thing I didn't like is that the seating is aesthetic but not very comfortable for people with bad backs. Booths have the straight backs and the chairs are at a slight recline which is awkward when you need to lean forward to cook your food.

Bathroom has a changing table. Several tables can handle larger groups since they also have seating outside. Decent amount of parking in Bella Terra.
Broth is okay, but the meat itself is good! I like the pho brother the most!!! Super nice staff
the food was pretty good with things at the salad bar. the service was very nice as well. we did have to wait around 30-45 mins but it wasn't bad. it was crowded but not too loud.

Hubby and I came here on a Saturday night around 6pm. There was a wait, it was crowded, but not too bad. You can also add yourself on their waitlist on Yelp. We went for the premium dinner menu. It was delicious! I think this may be my new fav shabu spot!

How it works: You order your chose of broth and the sliced meat with the server. Self serve your veggies, seafood, and sauces at the buffet station. They also have carb choices (e.g. rice, noodles, udon, ramen).

Their veggies were really fresh and quality of meat was great!

Service was great. The servers checked on us often and also refilled our broth.

There is outdoor patio seating and it's covered. In terms of decor, layout and seating, restaurant was clean and there are tables for large parties.

Avenue Shabu is an ayce hotpot spot. Broth, appetizers and meats are brought out by the server and the rest (veggies, seafood, sushi, sauces) are self serve at the counter. There's a ton of variety and everything is kept very well clean. The service is amazing, our server checked on us multiple times throughout the meal, we never had to flag them down. I would definitely recommend this place!
Cute place! Service was great! Great price! Abundant selection of food! Food was fresh and delicious!

My favorite ayce shabu. It's better than hot c pot, Oniku, shabuya, happy lamb pot.. etc.

The quality of their meat is the best bank for your buck, they have the best sauce which isn't water down. They have the hot drop on the side without needing to ask your server. They have all the veggies you need!

Everything is priced accordingly from the food to the alcohol. It used to be in the salty side, but now that they are no longer new, everything is on point.

Staff was nice and patient. Went the day of new year's. They weren't busy when we got there for lunch but then everyone had the same idea due to rainy weather. Even though it was chaotic and there was a shortage of staff that day, we were still very much attended too. The ambiance was great, service was great, meat cuts were also great. Will definitely revisit.

this new shabu place is VERY spacious and clean! upon getting seated we were immediately greeted and was asked if we wanted to sample any of the soups! they had a wide variety for us to try and our server gave amazing recommendations! we got the dinner premium set and i personally loved it as wagyu and ribeye were the best options on the menu!
things to note - everyone at your table has to order the same set/menu
& on holidays and weekends they only serve the dinner sets!
Food is great and servers are very friendly. The buffet portion is well stocked and clean. Though it is very busy a majority of the time, the wait is not too bad and we'll worth it.

Food was great . Service amazing
Been there two times . Great every time. Clean environment. Lots of choices.
Decided to give their lunch menu another shot. We didn't get the premium one. Everything went well and servers and other staffs were attentive.

Went on New Years, was the second party to arrive. The staff are very nice, friendly and attentive. I forgot my waitress name, but I liked how she constantly checked up on us. The servers also walks around with their cart to refill your broth. Since it was New Years, it was dinner prices. Got the premium which included sushi as well. Restaurant was nice and clean. I liked the different sauces they had, I wish they had quail eggs but no biggie. Will be going back again.

Solid spot for AYCE hot pot!

Pro tip: it can get busy in the evening esp since it's located in Bella Terra so join the online waitlist before heading out if you see a decent wait!

Location: busy plaza in Bella Terra right next to the Costco. Some spots out front if you're lucky but if not try the Costco lot or the parking garage

Ambiance: moderate noise level to loud during dinner time. Most seating was indoors -- the outdoor seating is actually covered with adjacent warmers

Service: the estimate from the waitlist was pretty accurate I would say. Despite how busy it was, our servers came back pretty consistently for meat orders, water and broth refills, and to bus the plates

Value: I would say it's a reasonable value for the AYCE aspect and selection. There are different tiers (regular vs premium) where premium includes addition of Wagyu and ribeye for meat selection, as well as sushi from the buffet line. Regular lunch is 23.99, premium lunch 27.99, regular dinner 32.99, premium dinner 36.99

Food: pretty good meat, seafood, vegetable, and noodle selection along with sauces. Meats were all beef except one cut of lamb, chicken breast, and pork belly. 6 broths to choose from -- I got the tom yum and enjoyed the spicy and sour flavor. Helped cut through the meaty flavor :)
My favorite shabu spot. It is in a nice shopping plaza. The place is nice and clean. Service always good. Food scrumptious.

I have this bookmarked here for awhile back now and wanted to try this place. This was my first time coming here. Today, I went here with my sister and she got Szechuan as the soup and I got the spicy miso soup. The spicy miso soup was good, great flavor, and love the spice. The buffet had a lot of variety options on choosing vegetables, seafood, and noodles you want of your choice alongside with the sauce bar. I also got a Shirley temple it was super refreshing and delicious also free refills. They also have a sushi bar as well. I would give this a 4/5 since the fries were okay but interesting. The volcano chicken was delicious, great seasoning, and flavor. The gyoza was decent, good, and great flavor. Jessica & Michelle were our servers and they were very nice and friendly. I got to try the sample of the soup before making my decision on which soup base I want which was amazing. The restaurant has a great atmosphere, spacious, and clean. There is plenty of parking. I would definitely come back here if I want a nice hotpot.
Jessica was a great server and the meats were always brought out quickly. great service

I've been eyeing Avenue for a long time, and finally decided to try it out. Nothing beats a hot soup on a cold winter day.

Upon arriving the hostess saw me checking in on their tablet, came to get me and seated me right away. YAY!

After being seated we were greet by our waitress Michelle, she was nice and attentive. I also really appreciated that she we could sample the broths they had beforehand. I went with the Szechuan, a smooth bone broth with a spicy little kick.

They had a lot of good options at the vegetable, seafood, noodle, and sauce bars. But because we went with the premium dinner package ($36.99), we unlocked what really sets them apart. They carry Waygu and a lot of other marble meats, DELICIOUS! I also really enjoyed that they had a little mini sushi bar and it was actually pretty good for not being a specialty sushi restaurant. I found myself going back for more!

As we finished, a waitress named Jessica helped us and she was so friendly and bubbly. It was the end of her shift so she spent some time to converse with us. She helped us end the night just right.

I had a good time at Avenue, and it's so good to know there's a Shabu spot so close to me. I will definitely be back.
Fantastic hot pot experience! The broth options were flavorful, the ingredients were fresh, and the staff was friendly and attentive throughout our meal. Lots of good sauces and sides selection.
So yummy, great service, great prices! We sat outside and the weather was great. Would def come again!

This brand new AYCE shabu shabu is hidden gem of Bella Terra. Went here for work Xmas party. It's walking distance from Crumble so locals know how parking is hectic during peak times. Have both inside and outside dining

Menu has both regular and premium menu ($4 extra on premium) and lunch is cheaper than dinner. Like any AYCE shabu shabu, you choose type of broth. Bar have a variety selections of veggies, seafood and different types of noodles. Don't forget to check out the sauce sections. Here's the main difference: they have sushi and there's wasabi paste and ginger on the side. Sodas are fountain.


Got the spicy miso. On request, they have concentrated hot sauce and recommended two drops on broth but can go beyond if you dare. If you are spicy lover, did 10 drops on the broth and 5 on the sauces. It got a kick but goes away slowly. Don't overload the broth because the pot is kind of small to fit an entire plate of seafood. Overall, very good and give a try

First time dining here recently. We went during lunch, and got the premium price with sushi + premium cuts, wagyu and prime ribs. The meat was delicious, sliced perfectly, and did not disappoint. The broth itself was okay, a little bland and could've used more flavor, but overall, it was a delicious meal, shared with my family. Will come back again!

I've been here twice now, and both times the service was excellent. I've visited for both lunch and dinner and enjoyed each experience. Just a heads up the lunch menu is a bit limited so not every meat option is available. If you order the premium option for dinner, it includes sushi rolls along with additional premium meat selections.

Everything from the seafood and veggie bar to the broth and meats is really solid for AYCE. The restaurant is super clean. Quick tip: if you buy an original soju, the second bottle is only $1

This is officially one of my new favorite AYCE shabu spot.

Pricing:
Lunch: $23.99
Premium Lunch: $27.99
Dinner: $32.99
Premium Dinner: $36.99

Totally worth it!

Came for a casual dinner on a weekday to forego the wait. This spot has been on my list for a while so I wanted to try it out. Overall it was alright. The meat quality is great but the broths while offering a lot of options felt a bit bland. My friend liked his Tsuyu but the other broths we tried were alright. We tried the premium menu to get the rolls and they were alright. I usually don't have high expectations for sushi with shabu but if you're looking for mainly California rolls then this was the spot. I will however say that this spot is very well stocked and equipped. The buffet had fresh everything and nothing ever seemed to run out. The sauce bar was also not lacking but maybe needed some labels.

Overall not my first pick for shabu but not a spot to avoid! I think if you're looking for something simple and filling this would work.

My wife and I dined here last Friday.

Parking is very difficult, so be prepared. This restaurant is not suitable for family gatherings--the music is extremely loud, making it hard to have a conversation. There is also a strict 100-minute dining limit.

When we were seated, the first server rushed us to order right away, which felt uncomfortable. A second server later took over and was nice and friendly.

The food appears to be mostly frozen and is very similar to Shabuya, but the price is higher than Shabuya in Fountain Valley.

Overall, if you have eaten at Shabuya before, the food here is essentially the same. I ordered a bowl of rice and beef, which was very oily, including the rice itself.

Compared to Shabuya, the only differences are the name, location, price, and soup style.

If you have never eaten here before, I would recommend thinking twice before trying this place.

This has become my favorite shabu place.

Broth and meat selection are awesome, walk up bar with unlimited sushi are amazing, and the service is great!

Surprisingly rarely a wait, even for a good sized group.

Always clean and bar is fully stocked. Highly recommend.

I think this place is price really well. I really enjoy mushrooms and kale noodles and this is one of these places that actually has both so I really like coming here. Lunch is really cool here. I recommend upgrading to get sushi. It's not the best sushi in the world but definitely worth it especially for the upgrade and it's fun being able to switch between them.

My family came by and ate here tonight, and there service was terrible.

There was a young girl working there that we didn't get the name of that flat out lied to us about what the vegetarian options were. She came back and continued to argue with my girlfriend and crossed the line into border line abuse.

The only acceptable thing the restaurant can do is fire her as none of my family will ever be eating here again.

My wife found a new shabu restaurant in HB.
We decided to discover how's the quality and service there for lunch.
Lunch is cheaper, $23.99 premium lunch $27.99 including special rolls.
Dinner is $36.99.

Today is Friday but not many people. We are late to get there around 1:30.
They open at 11 and lunch ends at 3.
This restaurant has almost same concept like Miss shabu in Buena. park.

First, we both liked the comfy tables, each person has own small pot. You don't need to share the big pot. The concern was the pot didn't boil fast as soon as we added the meats and veggies. They use the electricity not the gas. Take so much time to wait until boiled completely. Needed Patience!!!

Let's talk in detail, for broth, I chose donkotz broth and my wife got the basic Kombu. She likes dipping so she wants the basic unseasoned broth all the time.
For appetizers, koyza, chapchae, fried chicken, ddeokbboki, and some more but we liked ddekbokki.

For meats, not many choices for lunch premium. We got brisket, rib eye, and blade meats.

If you want other meats like wakyu, you pay more for dinner.

Anyway, the meats were tender, so thin....
The veggie bar and seafoods, a variety of veggies including my fave mushrooms, spinach, cabbages, bean sprouts, etc, shrimps, mini octopus, tiny mussels, squids, etc.

I liked most of seafoods but the mussels, wow!!! Too tiny...haha.
I couldn't pick them up....
I've never seen those tiny mussels at the shabu restaurants.

We didn't like the noodles in shabu.
We only had meats, veggies, and seafoods.

I didn't try any special rolls.
My wife tried some salmon, unagi, crunchy rolls, and tuna.
She is a picky eater for sushi, rolls.
She said just test today, no more rolls next time.

For the dipping sauces, pretty much same, basic and spicy.....

Overall our first experience today was not bad. Kind of late to start lunch after 1:40. But we had a great time to enjoy hot shabu w soju.

I like hot sake but they only have cold sake bottles.
I had only peach flavor soju.
We got the deal today, one soju $10.99 , and the 2nd is $0.99.

The server asked us if we are over 65????
Might be good discount for the seniors.

Only problem I don't like was tiny mussels.
Hopefully they have regular size mussels.

Location, price: 5 stars
Quality: 3 1/2
Ambiance: casual modern, comfy, dark.
Service: too slow, we had to wait for the refills many times

Good place to enjoy shabu w affordable price, good vibes.

I was so excited to go to a new Shabu restaurant in Bella Terra mall, HB.
We got late for the lunch but we sat right away around 1:40.
Lunch starts at 11 and ends at 3.
They have 3 different AYCE menus, lunch $27.99 premium shabu including special rolls Mon to Fri, basic shabu is only $23.99, $32.99 dinner, and $36.99 on weekends.

First my impression as soon as I entered, was dark, not like typical shabu restaurants. A little modern, contemporary style dining vibes w high ceiling, comfy tables. Well organized. Each person can have their own small pot, but they use the electic burner. That is why it takes way more time to boil the meats and veggies compared to gas burner.
You need little patience....until boiled. Haha....
