I chose premium shabu plus rolls, and basic kombu (seaweed) broth, my hubby got Tonkotz broth. I checked the rolls, not many variety of special rolls but still including salmon, tuna unagi, crunchy rolls.
To be honest, not too bad but I like special rolls very fresh made by chef at the sushi bar. I am spoiled a lot for the sushi and rolls.

One suggestion for the special roll tray, the rolls were stuck to the tray, I couldn't take it easily, why not put the extra parchment paper to avoid stickiness? Presentation is beautiful thou.

Overall, they have lots of veggies including mushrooms, fish cake balls, seafoods, noodles, but the meats....
Very thin, thin....also very limited to choose the beefs, only available brisket, rib eye, blade meat, the other beefs like wagyu for the dinner price. You get more once you pay more....

For the seafoods, looked fresh but look at the tiny mussels???? Dissapointed!!!

I couldn't take them to eat....??? They need to select regular big mussels.
I loved the squids, they precut finely to make tender so I could taste the tender texture of squids. Really tender, flavorful.

Let's talk about the dipping sauces, loved sesame sauce, and basic ponzu.
I didn't try other sauces. I always have basic sauce and sesame.
There are two Sauce self bars. Convenient....

For appetizers,
Kyoza, egg rolls, ddeokbboki, chapchae, some chicken fries... I picked ddeokbboki for the best flavor today.

For drinks, we like soju or hot Sake. They don't have hot Sake so we got peach flavor soju. Still great match w shabu.
We got Great Deal!!
$10.99 soju, the second was $0.99.

The sever asked us if we are seniors over 65 years old. I don't know how much discount for the Seniors over 65.
Great idea for the seniors.

We need to wait few years to get discount....near future haha...

Well, if we got there around opening time, we could have enough time to check all the ingredients and relax a lot but a kind of late to start our 1st test lunch after 1:40.

My hubby wants to go back to have another good time next time.

Great place to eat all different veggies, meats, and rolls if you are special roll lovers.

Hopefully we can have big mussels next time. No more tiny mussels....

Service: a little slow 3 out of 5
We had to wait so many time to reorder the meats, napkins, drink, and etc.
Price: affordable 5 stars
Location: 5 stars beautiful location in the Bella Terra mall, HB
Quality of foods: 3 1/2 so tiny mussels....special rolls are stuck a lot.
Ambiance: 4 out of 5
Comfy but little dark

This is one of my favorite places to go to dinner with friends. It is cheap for an all you can eat place, especially considering the premium menu is only a few dollars more. The service here is always great and the food arrives to your table in a matter of minutes.

I've never experienced customer service this poor. The server wouldn't even make eye contact with us while we were waiting to be seated. We explained that my daughter has a medical disorder that prevents her from digesting protein, but she still wanted to join us for lunch. We politely asked if we could pay à la carte for just rice and noodles. He didn't care at all--he insisted she had to pay full price for all the protein options, even though she physically cannot eat them.

His attitude was rude from the start. I explained the situation kindly, and he flat-out said he didn't care and wouldn't make any accommodations. When I told him we'd take our money elsewhere, he simply pointed at the door.

What a complete letdown. We won't be returning.

I'm so glad I stumbled across Avenue Shabu while hunting for an affordable AYCE shabu lunch spot. The high ratings, the big clean dining room, and the great-looking food pulled me in--and honestly, it lived up to the hype.

I went for the first time last week and was extra delighted to find out they had a $4-off lunch deal. My total came out to around $20. In this economy, that basically feels like winning the lottery.

I'm a Szechuan broth kind of person, so I was thrilled they offer it. The meats were high-quality and thinly sliced--exactly what you want for shabu. Their selection of seafood, veggies, and sauces is huge, which makes the whole experience even better.

The staff deserves a shout-out too. They were incredibly attentive--refilling water, topping off broth, checking on meats--pretty much everything before I even had to ask. To the point where I felt like the needy one, and that's saying something.

All in all, this place might just become my new go-to shabu spot. I've already been back twice!

This place is in Bella Terra. Small restaurant with outdoor seating. You can do Yelp Waitlist which is a bonus and you don't have to be within the dumb 5-10 mile radius that some restaurants have now.

Review for the Regular Dinner Menu

Appetizers - we had the Japchae, volcano chicken, rice cakes, and both style of fries. Neither one disappointed us! Usually the Japchae is soggy or salty but not here.

Meats - the meats are thinly sliced and not tough or chewy! The difference between this menu and the premium is that you get sushi and wagyu with the premium. It's not needed y'all...just go for the regular. The meat options are better than Dada in Irvine which used to be my #1 spot for Shabu. They don't bring our big plates which I think is great because then we were able to try different meats and not have to force ourselves to finish.

Broth- they have way more broth options than most places and even have pho. I'm Viet but not sure if I'd ever try that for Shabu . I had the tonkotsu and this is one of the few places where we didn't need to add seasoning because it was already very well seasoned! And it wasn't only me but the whole table who didn't have to add stuff. The only thing they added was the chili for the spicy eaters. They don't let you mix broths for free like most places but that's not a deal breaker for me. If you want to mix then it's like $3 charge I think.

Side Bar - they have konjac noodles y'all! For those of you that know what I'm talking about let's rejoice! They have the typical veggies that you love with your shabu and I like how they cut up the oyster mushrooms so they are bite sized! (I know...bear with me....its the little things that make me happy) And they have corn...it's not the chewy corn that Asians typically like (which I don't care for). So we were extremely happy to get our typical !

Sauces - the Goma sauce (I think that's how it's spelled)....the peanut looking one was sooo good! I was very happy with it and my salt with sesame oil mixture.

As I mentioned earlier this place has now officially taken the #1 spot for Shabu and Dada has been demoted to #2. They don't offer free drinks, fruits, or desserts but it's fine....maybe one day they will .

The service was phenomenal. They were always checking up on us and quickly brought anything requested.

This is a must try if you're looking for some AYCE Shabu!

One of my top shabu places I go to in HB area. They have great menu options. The meat slices and food bar selection has a large variety. If you like sushi they offer Ayce on their premium menu
Service- attentive
Ambiance - bright and clean with ample seating.
I have been able to walk in without making reservations
The food, service, and ambiance were great for having 5 adults, 2 kids and an infant with all the baby stuff. Under $300 is not bad for brunch at dinner prices. But I would not pay that again lol.

Fell in love with this place immediately. First of all there was no wait for lunch on a Friday, they had sat us down quick and got to serving us asap. Their pricing was amazing premium lunch was 27.99 which is unheard of at other AYCE places. They even had an affordable soju for 10.99 which is also UNHEARD OF. Then a drink special that was buy one get one for a cent!! Quality of meats were amazing and they had so many different sauces and broths and things to add to the broth. I am definitely coming back here to try their dinner options. So affordable and delicious and checked off all the boxes. Who doesn't love sushi and shabu in one place?! Servers were also always around and providing us with anything we needed. Amazing place and good music playing.

Food was good, but 5 stars for the best service from our waiter Jayden.
Jayden was patient and explained the ordering process for our girl night. It was our first time here.

Overall service was good from the rest of the staff.

My friend took me out to try this place as she really enjoyed it the last time she came. Her judgement was spot on - we had a great time.

It was midday during the week, so we were able to get seated right away. It wasn't completely packed, but there were tons of people enjoying their meals.

Service was wonderful - everything was explained quickly, we ordered our broth (tom yum for me, spicy miso for my friend) and then got down to picking our meats/veggies. Meats had to be ordered, but veggies/seafood could be picked up at the bar. Everything looked fresh at the bar as well as all the meat that came out.

We enjoyed ourselves and how easy it was to go back for more veggies/seafood. We ordered a few more meats, but were stuffed after a couple of rounds. The tom yum soup was delicious - the right amount of tangy flavor, but could have used more spice (I'm sure it's just my personal preference, though).

The atmosphere while we were dining was fun - the music wasn't too loud, but it was lively. This would be a great place for friends, family and/or dates. I would definitely come back again next time I'm in town.

I will be honest, I have my regular spot which I go to for shabu. But yesterday I decided to give Avenue Shabu a try after all the hype on social media. First of all great customer service, I wish I got her name. Very welcoming lady 5 stars to her!
Food was good, broth had a lot of flavor, but the selection of ingredients and sauces was so poor. I would say very limited compare to the other places.
Sushi which are also included if you get premium - were ok.
For the meats I really liked bulgogi and ribeye - great favors here.
Would I return? I am not sure. As I like to combine different veggies and add ons and mix and match my dipping sauces But at least I can say I tried

Came to Shabuya in Fountain Valley expecting a good meal, but somehow ended up with a new family member. Huge shoutout to our server, Stepbro (Danny), for making the experience 10x better.

The food was genuinely great. The meat was fresh, the broth was flavorful, and everything came out looking and tasting like it should. But the real highlight was Danny's service. Super attentive, quick, and somehow always knew when we needed something. Bro has better situational awareness than my own family.

He kept our table clean, checked on us regularly, and made sure we were taken care of the entire time. Great food is one thing, but having a server who actually makes the experience fun is what makes a place worth coming back to.

10/10 food, 11/10 service, and 12/10 family bonding. Someone please give him a raise.

We stopped by Shabuya on Halloween for a quick and easy lunch. The service was great, everything seemed fresh, and we had an overall pleasant experience. I've been coming to Shabuya for years, and it's always been one of my favorites! Unfortunately, I felt the need to leave a review to bring something concerning to management's attention. Both my boyfriend and I became extremely sick later that night. My boyfriend started experiencing nausea and severe upper stomach pain around 2 AM, which continued into the following day. My symptoms started around 4 AM and lasted until about 2 PM. I experienced the same stomach pain and nausea, but I was also vomiting constantly throughout those hours. I couldn't even keep water down, and the pain became so unbearable that I seriously considered going to the ER. Shabuya was the only meal either of us had eaten that entire day, so we strongly suspect we experienced food poisoning from something we ate at the restaurant. Obviously, we can't know exactly what caused it, but the timing and the fact that we both became sick with similar symptoms were extremely concerning. I'm not writing this to bash the restaurant because, like I said, I've been a loyal customer for years and have always loved coming here. I genuinely just want management to be aware in case there was an issue with food handling, storage, or freshness that day. I would hate for another guest to experience what we went through. I'm sure I'll eventually return, but unfortunately, when you get that sick after eating somewhere, it's really hard to feel comfortable going back anytime soon. ): It's especially disappointing because Shabuya has always been one of my favorite spots.
The best food, I love everything. The service, the wait time. Everything good. The bar is always full, never missing something.

Food is amazing as always.
Air- Rick is such a an amazing waiter.
He was friendly, attentive, and provided outstanding service throughout our visit. He made sure everything was perfect and went above and beyond to make us feel welcome. Truly great customer service. This is the second time we've had it and 10/10 we hope to always get him. Eveyrone there is helpful and nice. We will definitely be back again

Definitely a must-try!

This is the sequel to my last hotpot review!

After our first failed AYCE attempt, one of the boys brought this place up as an alternative.

Mind you, my daughter was STILL mad at me for taking them to a restaurant advertised as AYCE when it wasn't. And yes, I was misled by Yelp's false advertisement! Anyway, I'm still waiting for that damn apology from her! :X

Now, back to the food!

Service was great! We went on a crowded rainy Halloween night, and our server happened to be one of the managers. He was extremely attentive, accommodating, and made sure our needs were taken care of.

The price was $29.99 per person, which was very reasonable and college-kid friendly. I keep calling them kids because, well, they're kids to me, even though technically they're young adults.

Feeling guilty about the earlier mix-up, I offered to cover the tax and tip. I was secretly hoping they'd say no, but they took me up on my offer! Darn it! :D

The ambience was fun, and they played some pretty cool music. Great vibe overall.

And the food? Absolutely delicious!

Definitely a much better ending to our hotpot adventure. Worth the visit!

W
We had a great experience at Shabuya last week! The food was delicious, and our server, Air Rick, provided excellent service. He was friendly, attentive, and made sure our table was well taken care of throughout the meal. Really appreciate his great hospitality. We'll definitely be back!

First time at Shabuya and man I gotta say what an experience the food was amazing, great flavors, thinly sliced meats for you to grub, the ambiance was relaxing great music playing in the background tvs on at the bar I'm definitely coming back. Oh last but not least my server oh what can I say BIANCA was absolutely amazing at her job told her it was my first time here she gave me suggestions on what to order. I think if it wasn't for BIANCA my experience would of been different just because of her I can honestly recommend this place if you're in the area and without a doubt I'll be back so again thank you BIANCA for the best experience I've had at a restaurant.
Came to try the sinigang broth for Filipino heritage month and this handsome Filipino server named "deez" did a wonderful job help navigate the menu, assuring that we had everything we needed
Our server, Deez, was amazing! Was very helpful explaining how the broths taste and refilled our waters and meats in a timely manner as well.

I love this place! I would eat here every day if I could. What really gets me excited to come is having Danimal as our server. I met him my first time coming about a year ago, and have requested him every time of the 30-40 times I've been back. He always goes above and beyond to make you feel welcome and also that you have everything you need to have an amazing meal. Food is great but his service is exceptional. Do your group a favor and asked to be sat in his section. :)

Shabuya is already one of the best all-you-can-eat shabu-shabu spots around, but Danimals took the entire dining experience to the next level.
He was incredibly attentive, welcoming, and fast with the meat orders. Every time our trays were empty, he cleared them immediately and made sure our broth stayed perfectly filled. He kept a close eye on our table without ever making us feel rushed, and his recommendations for the sauce bar pairings were absolutely spot on.
Amazing food, premium meat quality, and top-tier service thanks to Danimals. We will absolutely be back!

Came here for a last minute bite craving soup and meat! I saw the prices on the menu and thought it was a great deal for AYCE hotpot. The selections are limited on the menu for appetizers and meat but overall it's a good deal still. They have a self serve bar with seafood veggies noodle and sauce bar with all the fixings. I enjoyed the meat thought it was good quality. I just would prefer somewhere with a wider selection. Service was quick and our waiter was friendly. Inside was nice there is a lot of seating so wait time was not too long. Overall a good place to visit for hot pot.

I usually don't write reviews, but this was a special case. The appetizers and meats were excellent and tasted fresh. The space was clean and well organized, particularly the self-service area. There was a good variety of options, and I would say all were high quality.

However, personally, the service really took the spotlight. My server, Austin, was always attentive and proactive in making sure everything was just right. Never did I have to wait long for my order or refills even when it was busy. His professionalism really made the experience stand out compared to other places.

Overall, I had a great experience and would definitely come back again with some extra company.

It's always a pleasure to dine at Shabuya because of the server, Danimals. His energy and jokes made my dinner with my friends enjoyable! If you ever want to have a chill night out, I highly recommend his services.

My server Deez was absolutely amazing, he immediately came to my table and asked my friends and myself how our day was and made us feel like family. My friends and I ordered a total of 5 rounds of 8 meats and it was amazing quality with amazing service. The atmosphere was also incredible with servers all around. This experience made me really happy, and thank you Deez for making my day.
Danimals was awesome! Super friendly, quick service, and made sure we were taken care of!

Came in on a busy Saturday dinner and we were seated within 20 minutes. Our server, Dan, was absolute gold--he walked us through how to choose the broth and all the food options, and checked in on us right when we needed him without hovering. Good service and food quality

Had a great experience at Shabuya for my dad's birthday! The food was fresh, there were plenty of options, and everything came out really good. Huge shoutout to Danimals for taking care of us! He was super friendly, attentive, and made sure we had everything we needed the whole time. Definitely made the experience even better. Great service and great food, we'll definitely be back!

Decided to come and try this place out again and Drewski was phenomenal with catering a perfect hot pot experience. He took his time explaining all parts of the menu and even gave me his personal rec's for mixing different broths! Will definitely be coming back again

flavorful broth options, good selection of meat options, and a good variety of vegetables and seafood. service is always good and fast. definitely one of my go to shabu places to eat! spacious space too!
I came for my birthday and gummy was so awesome!!! he was very friendly n welcoming n was so patient with our group! definitely ask for gummy when you visit! love him!
this was my very first time at Shabuya! Neil helped break down the menu & gave his own personal recommendations, which were amazing! Definitely coming back for the amazing service & food :D
We had such a fun night. The atmosphere was so fun! Our server Neil made sure to check up on us frequently throughout the night. 10/10 will go back, ask for Neil.
Our server, Neil, was great! He asked if we wanted to double up on our meat, so we did and we got great portions! The music was fun and it was a great place to catch up with friends.
Just had a great experience, with Air Rick!! Great customer service, he checked in regularly, and was funny. Made the experience even better!

Had a really good experience at Shabuya today! The food was fresh, everything tasted great, and the quality was definitely worth it. Our server Austin was also super friendly and attentive, always checking in on us and making sure we had everything we needed. Overall, great food and even better service. Definitely coming back!

This is one of my favorite places to eat and bring friends and family however, last night I brought my best friend for the first time. We had been planning this for months.

Service was awful!!!
Our server never came back for us to order more food and refill our completely empty drinks. He was watching the game with his friends at the bar instead. Avoided eye contact, had to wave my hand to get anyone to bring more broth. He started my pot with half way full, had to keep turning my egg because it wasn't enough broth, I asked him for more and he acted bothered. Couldn't order more meat because he wouldn't come back, asked for rice at the beginning but he never brought it, when I got more broth I reminded him of my rice he said let me see if we have any it was 7pm
Ruined a special dinner because of absolute lack of customer service, care and rudeness.
He had a dangling earing, tattooed sleeves and he thought he was so cool.
How do you allow a business to run with providing that kind of service?!

Came in to eat yesterday and had a great experience. I've been here many times but I wanted to comment on my server, Drewski, on his excellent service. He was very patient, kind, and helpful. I'm pretty introverted but his calm demeanor made my dining experience with my family very enjoyable. Please ask for his section when you come to eat!
I always forget to take pictures since I'm already gobbling my food down but the restaurant also has live games going on and the environment is not too loud and very clean.

Danny was a great server! Honestly, I told him to choose for me because this place can be pretty overstimulating, and he made the decision easy. I ended up getting sukiyaki with some spicy miso sauce on the side, along with gyoza and toros. Everything was delicious, and his recommendations were exactly what I needed. He was very attentive throughout the meal and made sure we had everything we needed. Ambiance is okay but i don't really mind it.

This is one of my favorite ayce shabu places! Plenty of parking and short waits. They also are on Yelp so you can join ahead if you're nearby! The meats were super high quality! The appetizers were also good! I loved the gyozas! Their self serve selection for seafood, noodles, and veggies were super high quality also! The best part was the price! It was lower than $40 compared to other ayce hotpot places

First time dining here today; the food was amazing, and the service Austin had provided was on par with, or even better than the food! I came in a little hesitant because I dined here on a whim while driving home from work, and upon coming in, that feeling of uncertainty changed instantly! Will come back soon and would definitely recommend!

I genuinely cannot say enough good things about this employee. Austin work ethic, professionalism, and dedication are truly exceptional. Every time I see him working, he consistently goes above and beyond to make sure everyone has a great experience. He is incredibly hardworking, attentive, respectful, and always maintains a positive attitude, even when things get busy. What stands out the most is how naturally he takes initiative and how much pride he takes in his work. It's rare to come across someone who demonstrates this level of commitment and genuine care for customers.

Plenty of parking and seating inside. They also have a sauce/toppings station for your soups. They have a Lunch Special for $20.99 and Happy Hour Mon-Fri 3-5pm for $24.99. It's AYCE so definitely have to eat your worth :) . Love how the meat is thinly sliced and it melts in your mouth.

What I got:
- got all the meats except chicken
- sukiyaki and miso broths
- Favorites: pork belly and the blade meat

Tbh, I originally came here just to drink with my friends but Danny convinced me to try the food along with the cocktails since I had never had it before. I'm glad he did because the food paired surprisingly well with the soju cocktails! He even mixed the lychee and yogurt flavors for me, and let me tell you, THAT WAS GAS. The combination was so good and refreshing that it honestly made the whole experience even better. Danny was super helpful with his recommendations and definitely knows how to make a first timer feel comfortable trying something new. Came in just for drinks, but now I have another reason to come back. Great service and great drinks!

Danny was a great server! He took the time to explain the differences between the soup bases and gave us recommendations on which meats were best for dinner. He was very attentive and made sure we had everything we needed throughout the meal. Even though he was constantly running back and forth taking care of other tables, he somehow always kept an eye on ours to see if we wanted more meat. Honestly, I found that little trick pretty funny, but it was also a nice touch that showed how attentive he was! Overall, great service, helpful recommendations, and a positive dining experience. Definitely appreciate Danny for making our dinner enjoyable!!!
visited this spot on a saturday night with some friends. great value and yummy plates. went there for AYCE and our server Danny has amazing service. will come back.
Dan is the goat. He gave us the best service. Gave everything so fast and smoothly. He was making sure we were doing good as well making sure we were okay!
i came here recently with my family and had a great time! Austin was super friendly, helpful and made sure everything was good. appreciate his service, would recommend

We had an amazing meal at shabuya today and that was due to Deez's excellent service. He gave us some tips to help elevate our meal and it was truly game changing. He was very friendly and never had us waiting on our meat!

Had such a great dining experience with my family! Drewski took care of us for most of our visit and made us feel so welcomed. He was friendly, attentive, and made sure we had everything we needed. Austin stepped in while Drewski was on his break and kept the great service going! He checked on us regularly, refilled our drinks, and made sure everything was going well. It's always nice to have servers who genuinely care about their guests. Huge thanks to both Drewski and Austin for making our visit so enjoyable. We'll definitely be back! :)

had a great experience at shabuya recently! the food was excellent and the service was even better. everyone here was really friendly, but austin and drew definitely stood out to me. they were quick, attentive and very knowledgeable about the menu and made sure we had everything we needed throughout the meal. highly recommend!

Drew was the best server ever. I've come here many times and while service is always good, Drew made my experience phenomenal! I will come AGAIN in hopes of having Drew as my server. He SERVEDDDDDDD. I love Shabuya and he made me love it more. The ambiance of this location is great!!
Got food poisoning here last night.. tried to call the restaurant.. no answer.. can't leave a message... voicemail not set up to pick up calls. First and last time here.

Had an AMAZING experience here! Our server, Drew, was incredibly attentive and provided exceptional service throughout our visit. My entire party left more than satisfied with both the delicious food and the overall experience. We'll definitely be coming back!

11/10 Service! Honestly makes the food so much more worth it to know I always get great service especially on a bad day. My server Drew/Drewski is who I always ask for (I'd be willing to wait for a table in his section too) is always attentive to even the small details and knows exactly what to recommend too.

As for the food, I really liked the Volcano Chicken and the green Spinach noodles that they have! The spicy miso and tonkotsu are my favorites for broth. For meat I really enjoyed the flat iron steak and beef toro!!

Had a great time at lunch! The lunch specials price is great! Deez was a very attentive server and came at the right times when we needed more food without us even needing to call him over. Deez was friendly and provided great service!

Great! Our server Deez was great as well.

Foods awesome and the quality was on fire..!!
Deez was one of the best servers! Quick to bring what was requested. Ambiance was like other Shabuya locations. Nothing special.

Love that there's a Yelp waitlist, so the wait time doesn't feel super long. No complaints on the service staff, everyone was super friendly and checked on our table often.

It's been several years since I've visited and I remember why I never came back now. The 3/5 stars is because the food was mediocre. While it is cheap AYCE, you're better off with à la carte at Mokkoji for a better quality of meats, broth, veggies, and sauces. The sauce bar at Shabuya is also so limited, and their goma is wayyyyy too sweet.
Waiting here on Monday night; not many people as you can see in the picture. There are so many empty tables but look likes not enough servers

As far as pricing goes, Shabuya's probably the best priced AYCE shabu place in OC, especially if you go for their weekday lunch special ($21pp).

As far as anything else goes, you can probably find better elsewhere.

Broth options were standard, they had your usual miso, spicy miso, tonkatsu, sukiyaki and a house broth. Nothing special or stand out, I got their tonkatsu which was flavorful and creamy.

Salad bar was pretty bare bones compared to other places. They had a decent selection of veggies, seafood options, noodles and tofu's. Nothing special and pretty underwhelming.

Meat selection was good for the price you're paying. They had a pretty good selection to choose from and it's a set price, no upcharge for higher quality meat.

Sauce bar was terrible. It was very limited and their goma was not good. Goma's supposed to be a nutty sesame sauce. The goma at Shabuya tasted like sweet mayo with a hint of peanut. Worst goma ever.

Basic shabu place, really only worth it during their lunch special, otherwise there's much better shabu places in the area.

Make sure to come here with an empty stomach and a big appetite because you need to come for the all you can eat shabu (Japanese hot pot). The different broth options, all great-tasting meat options, and even side dishes all make this my go-to place when I wanna take someone to shabu in OC.

Air Rick is amazing, he cares about his customers and pays attention to details. Thank you Air Rick! But the wait was two hours for lunch yesterday, not sure if it was because of the back to school promotion.

I came for the Back to School Special because it was so cheap ($10.99/student with $2.50/drink). Our server, Air Rick (Eric), was so nice! We were probably second in line at opening, but he never rushed us and was attentive to our needs. I felt like he actually cared about our table and was present anytime we were asking him questions.

The meats are cut very thin, but you can order up to 8 at a time, and they are served very fast. The drinks at half sweet were probably 100% sweet at other places, so I would recommend the half sweet. I also wish that there were enoki mushrooms here! That's the only thing that I felt was missing.

It was fully packed with 100 people on the waitlist when we were leaving, but it didn't feel overcrowded.

Shabuya was excellent, specifically because of an outstanding man named Steven. This guy was awesome and went above and beyond, and covered us in all ways. This man's unmatched service needs to be studied.
steven was the best waiter ever fs coming back. Steven was so fast and very considerate he even took our group photos and they were the best.

came here today for lunch to celebrate a friend's belated birthday! our server deez was really nice and helpful. it was my first time here and the food was super yummy! shoutout to deez for all the recs, it definitely made the experience a 10/10 i would 10000% come back if it meant deez was going to be my server. he made the vibe of the restaurant even better.

had an amazing experience at shabuya in fountain valley! the food is fresh and there are so many options to choose from. the atmosphere has a good and welcoming vibe, perfect for a date or a family meal. shoutout to derek and serena especially for the amazing unforgettable experience, they were very friendly and attentive. definitely would recommend coming here if you are in the area!

this place was so good! everything was incredibly fresh and the meat selection was amazing. serena and derek were awesome, best service and food i've had anywhere in a while! will go back a million times over

I went to Shabuya recently for the back to school ayce discount and had a great time. Me and my friend went and were served by Air Rick who kept The energy high, checked up on us a lot and kept the food coming. I loved the delicious assortments of meats and soups to choose from it made the whole experience a lot better.
Air rick's service was amazing. Very kind guy and always checked on us constantly making sure were doing great. Food and overall atmosphere was amazing and Air rick made our experience here amazing.

Honestly, we had a really great time here, and shoutout specifically to our server, Air Rick.

Not gonna lie, it started off a bit slow with the orders at first, which i guess happens when it gets super busy, but once Air Rick took notice, he totally stepped up. He prioritized our table, got everything moving fast, and had us completely caught up in no time.

Aside from just fixing the pacing, he was genuinely just a super great and awesome guy. You could tell he actually cared about us having a good time, and his service felt really sincere instead of just going through the motions like most servers. Made the whole meal way better so i'll definitely be hoping to get him as our server next timsz.

Our server Air Rick was absolutely fantastic throughout our entire visit. He made sure our glasses were always full and checked on us constantly. We had such a great experience thanks to his attentive service. It is rare to find someone who works that hard to keep guests happy. We will definitely be coming back soon to see him again.

The Service was so GOOD I loved the Food and everything and Air Rick was the Best servicer and He was so kind to us and is a chill guy that I had so If you meet him Thank him for his services and the chicken and meat was so perfect I LOVED IT HERE 10/10

as far as hotpot goes, shabuya never lets me down. service always hustling, plates always stacking. and i eat my weight in meat every time. fresh and tasty, if you don't like it you're making your soup bad

I stopped by shabuya again but I just had a standout experience from Lamar. He had great service and was very efficient and professional! All the other servers + hostesses were also awesome. Ambiance was good as always. The food was hitting 10/10

Its about time I wrote a review here!

We dine here pretty often as its just such a good deal! 20 for lunch and 30 for dinner for AYCE!! I love getting the tonkotsu broth but their spicy miso or sukiyaki are also a hit! They do a great job in cleaning the buffet and sauce bar to make sure its always restocked.

The service is also pretty good and are consistent to getting your next order in- we leave here always stuffed! The meat quality is something worth going back for with good options of fatty toro vs lean cuts. It does get very busy so do plan ahead by adding your name on the yelp waitlist!
Front desk needs organization. Granted it was busy, we got skipped a few times. Food is standard to shabuyas quality.
The hostess, Linh, was very accommodating and sweet to us. Bianca was an amazing server/bartender. She checked up on us and made sure we got everything we needed.
Thank you Leilani for your amazing service!! The food was delicious and she was quick to fill our water and check in with us when we wanted to order more food
Really loved the service here, Leilani made sure our needs were met proactively. Music here is always on point!
Shabuya is always an amazing place to go with a group for shabu! Leilani was amazing! Very kind and attentive :) Food is good as always!

They have quality meat that comes out very quickly. Service is great. Sauce bar and seafood and veggie selections, compared to other shabu places, however, is a bit limited, left messy, and often runs low.

As always, the food is great here. However, the hostess really needs to work on her Customer Service skills. I walked in at 11:05 and saw a lady that was in front of me walking in, but when I got inside, she was sitting down. I assume she had already been help but the hostess said give me a minute. Let me help her first. This is after I noticed she was texting on her phone while we were waiting. Once she finally helped the lady she came back to help me and asked me how many. When I said one, she said oh that's gonna be a couple more minutes. Then I noticed she looked back to an empty restaurant, maybe 10 people in the whole place while she rearranged her desk and put signs out. I'm not really sure what the wait was but that's not how you treat your customers. It did not make me feel welcomed and the look she had on her face made me feel like I was inconveniencing her. On a bright note, the server was great, nice smile, friendly and excellent customer service.

Went last min only 15 min wait but did not the fact they charged dinner prices all day just cause today was ok Labor Day. Broths were good and decent selection is meats. Think drinks should be included. Would like a larger selections of condiments and sides bar. Service was ok not too friendly but helpful if we needed anything.

So their Back to School promotion stated that it's between August 8th and September 7th, on Saturday and Sunday. That is not the case. We came here today, Sunday, September 6th, and they refused to honor it because it's "Labor Day weekend." Their excuse is that it would be "too confusing." Whatever that means. This is either a mistake made by their marketing team or they have decided that they would rather pissed off a lot of their customers to make some money over the Labor Day weekend. This is an idiotic move. A promotion supposed to bring customers to the restaurant, but they're not going to like it if you decide to bait and switch them. Once it puts a bad taste in the customers' mouths, they won't come back. I've been here several times, but I won't be coming back after today. Certainly there are plenty of other restaurants out there that serve the same style of food. Besides, you're doing your own cooking anyway, so it isn't that special. I'll be sure to steer clear of anything Shabuya related. You should too.

Would give it 6 Stars if I could, one of the best restaurants I've ever been to.

Employees are super friendly and attentive. The meats and broth are phenomenal and absolutely top tier.

It's usually packed and has very long lines, so I recommend joining a Waitlist ahead of time.

My girlfriend and I are really disappointed with our experience. We came in expecting to receive the back-to-school discount because the poster clearly advertised that the promotion ran from August 8th through September 27th. There was no mention on the poster that the discount would not apply on Labor Day.

When we arrived, we were told that we could not receive the discount because it was Labor Day. We understand that businesses can have exclusions for certain holidays, but if that is the case, it should be clearly stated on the promotional advertisement. We feel that the promotion was misleading, and it was frustrating to find out about the exclusion only after we got there.

We hope the business will make the terms of future promotions clearer so customers aren't caught off guard.

We arrived at Shabuya about ten minutes before opening, and there was already a line out the door -- always a good sign. Luckily, there's plenty of parking since it's in a busy shopping center. We added our name to the waitlist and appreciated being able to wait inside because it was extremely hot outside. While waiting, we noticed a promotion advertising free meals for students with ID, which was a nice touch.
Once seated, our server came right over and explained the broth and meat options. I was disappointed to see they only offered chicken thigh instead of breast, which is the only chicken I eat. Because of that, I had to rely on the buffet area for my protein. The buffet itself is small, but well stocked with veggies, seafood and sauces. I grabbed shrimp to make myself a shrimp soup, though the shrimp wasn't deveined, so I had to do it myself.
Despite that, my soup and everyone else's, turned out delicious. The veggies were cut larger than I prefer, and it was pretty warm inside the restaurant, likely because of the heat outside and all the boiling pots. Still, the place was clean, the staff was friendly, and the overall experience was enjoyable.

Disappointing Promotion Experience

I'm very disappointed with how this promotion was handled. The promotion clearly stated that it would end on September 7, 2026, but right before the promotion ended, it was not honored because of the Labor Day weekend.

If certain dates or holidays were excluded from the promotion, that should have been clearly stated in the original promotion terms. Customers should not be given an advertised expiration date only to have the promotion denied before that date.

Stated promo run from august 2026 to end of september 2026. We showed up early and wait to get in just to be told "We're not running promo today. No posts, no communications at pages at all. At least let your customer know ahead of time. This kills the hope. OG post did not say holidays excluded. Bad business practice. Will not comeback!
Did not announce publicly about not doing student promotion on a sunday. Wasted my time when my kids were already there.
Neil thank you for serving us, I loved it I had a great time here at shabuya 10/10 experience WILL come again

Student discount promo was not honored due to holiday weekend. Was not informed of this until it was too late to organize a different place to eat.
Very misleading and feels like a shady business practice. I expected better transparency and customer service.

So expensive! We got ripped off too. No sign of anything to do with Labor Day weekend. Once we got there, the message of saying that the discount does not apply finally appeared. And that was at 12. The food was alright. The vibe was chill but the price ruined it.

Waited over an hour and a half this labor day weekend for the Back to School student promo only to be messaged through yelp saying that they will not be honoring the promotion. No notice whatsoever on their instagram. No notice saying it excludes holidays. Extremely disappointed especially for all the college students back in town for the holiday.
I loved the food and how efficient all the workers were. Constantly asking and checking up on me to see if I wanted anything else. Shout out the food runners
First time here and I enjoyed my experience. We celebrated a birthday. Great for families. Leilani served us and Gemmy! Made my experience feel right at home.

Leilani LE Was amazing server definitely recommend for promotion very professional very kind. Very respectful was very attentive.
Made us feel comfortable. Would definitely recommend this restaurant 1000 out of 10%.
She was amazing. Food was amazing. Ambience was amazing highly highly highly recommend this place. Best server ever.
We are traveling to OC and had an amazing time at this place. Food are so delicious. My kids had wonderful time here. Diane our server is excellent. John and Serena the manager are great.
Huge thanks to Vincent and CVO for a good experience today! We got all of our food and drinks really fast and they were attentive to us the whole time. 10/10

I was extremely disappointed with how Shabuya handled student discounts. I was already worried that they wouldn't accept my digital ID, because my school no longer offered a physical ID option, neither for free nor for purchase. They stated on multiple online platforms that digital student IDs were valid to receive a discount, but upon arrival at the restaurant both the server and manager stated it wasn't allowed, even after I showed the OFFICIAL online advertisements stating it was, mind you. This is false advertising, and I hope they know it will turn many customers away.

Came on Sunday for the student discount with many family members that are students as well. As many schools have stopped issuing physical IDs, we brought our digital school IDs as well as other forms of identification such as drivers licenses in order for the restaurant to verify that we were all students. The host refused to accept the two forms of identification and blamed it on "corporate policy." After asking for the manager and explaining once again that many schools have stopped issuing physical IDs, we were also met with the same response that it is "corporate policy" to not accept digital school IDs. We also tried to explain that some of us were about to start college soon but because UC schools don't start until late September, there is no way to get a current physical ID until then. The advertising on Instagram and other social media platforms only stated to bring a school ID (nowhere did it state that it needed to be physical). We decided to eat there anyways as we were with our elderly grandparents and they were waiting for a very long time to be seated. After getting home, we then saw that underneath an Instagram post, the official Shabuya page confirmed to another person that digital IDs would be accepted!! This is absolutely unacceptable and false advertising!! We used to always come here for family gatherings but because of the incredibly rude responses back to us and horrible customer service we will never be back!!

We came at one of the busiest times of the day so service was kinda slow but still super decent place to eat. The broth was flavorful they meat was so fresh and scrumptious i could not get enough. The self serve table was filled with an amazing variety of the freshes most flavorful vegetables. The carmael milk tea was so yummy! Definitely recommend trying it!!

Food is good, i like original broth, but the waiter gave a bad attitude in service. Went to Shabuya for lunch promotion on Sun 30 Aug, 1:00 pm, we sat on the table behind tables in front of the bar, the waiter was the big guy with glass, no tag name, and he seems like doesn't want to go to work and gave a really bad attitude to us. BAD

I came with the student ID. They said they can't give me discount as a student. The manager did not even look at my student ID, said it is a trade school and did not accept it. My classmates came yesterday with the IDs of the same school. All of them got discounted. Since we wait almost 2 hours for the spot and my kids are hungry. It is probably the last time I came to your restaurant. Should list all the colleges that you won't accept publicly so you don't waste other people time. Discrimination students with family and kids is very obvious to me.

Honestly, everything at Shabuya was fantastic! The food, service, and experience were all amazing, and I'm so happy I came here. I absolutely loved it and highly recommend it! My only request: please, please peel the potatoes!
My family and I go to shabu spot! Service is great, good meat, and soup is good as well!

I really like the sauce options here. I think the tables can be a bit more clean though, i felt like it was kinda sticky. The mango iced tea was very good. Employees are very nice. Clean restrooms as well.

We go to this place frequently. Great way to eat lots of fresh veggies and meat cooked in a healthy way. My wife and I both noticed last night's broths however were TOO salty (two different varieties) Hopefully this was a fluke and not a change in their recipe. I was disappointed that I couldn't enjoy the soup after all my cooking because it was just too salty.

Shabuya is easily top 3 of the best AYCE shabu spots in OC. You get a self serve veggie, noodle, seafood and sauce bar. The sauce bar hits EVERY time. If it's your first time, a full scoop of their goma and dash of ponzu and chili oil makes the best creamy sauce. You start off by telling the server your broth of choice, I'd recommend sukiyaki if you like the taste of sweet soy sauce! You can order up to 8 plates for meat and I'd HIGHLY recommend you have the #5 prime flat iron steak for one of your rounds.

My family and friends are quite regulars here and we've had Christian as our server several times now so it only feels right to reserve a part of this review to glaze this man. Not only is he probably one of the best servers in any restaurant we've dined in, he's always got a great attitude. As customers we have our days and depending on the people we encounter, they might take a jab at them. Personally when I have my moments, I think to myself, how would Christian from Shabuya handle this? That's another way of saying how great of a service Christian provides for us whenever we see him. He is genuinely great at his job and is always a vibe. You're doing great man and we appreciate you!

The best dining experience is when you have a little rnb playing in the background. Some mariah the scientist, blxst, lil tecca OOOOF the playlist always hits here.

Sauce bar, meat quality, service, music... this place does it RIGHTT!
We came in at 1:30 for the student discount and waited 2 hours and were cut off the waitlist. Do not visit this place
Good food and services. The best is the the back to school promotion. My kids enjoy food here.

This place pissed me off. I went on the weekend to eat for the student discount for 10.99. Got here at 2 PM and waited an hour just for them to cut off the discount at 3 PM even though we put our name on the waitlist at 2. Do not come here the waiter is a bitch and there was a cockroach in the broth

My friends and I went for the "Back to School" $11 pp promotion. The original soup base was best. The miso soup base tastes similar to the original except it's a bit saltier. The tonkotsu broth is good but tasted a little more artificial. Beef was very good and flavorful. There was also a large selection of veggies and seafood.

Service was wonderful and our server came over whenever he saw we were almost done with our meat.

The restaurant was also very modern, clean, and spacious.

We went in on a Friday night and got in ver try quickly after joining the waitlist on Yelp. Although we had been to this particular location a handful of times, this visit was particularly memorable. Our waiter, Danimal was the best. He was not only all the things a good staff member should be but he was extraordinary. He was always one step ahead--bringing us napkins before we even asked, making excellent recommendations on which meat option to choose, and overall super professional and personable without being over-the-top/questionable. So refreshing to find wait staff who are excellent!

Just left after dining at Shabuya. For a Monday night, the restaurant was really busy and service was lacking. Unfortunately while we were eating we found two slivers of clear plastic in our raw sliced meat. Each piece was about 3-4 inches long and slim- almost unnoticeable. I'm guessing the meat was sliced with plastic on it.. each piece was found on different plates. Staff was notified and we exchanged the two plates. We continued with dinner, but felt uneasy and carefully checked each piece of meat after finding the plastic pieces. We enjoy Shabuya, but after this experience I'm not sure we'll return.

The service was super fast and everyone was so kind and attentive. We enjoyed everything from the different meats to all the sides and drinks. Everything tasted fresh and there were so many options to choose from. Definitely a great spot for quick and cheap hot pot, we'll be coming back again!

Came here with a couple friends because we saw the student deal and thought there had to be a catch... turns out the only catch was trying not to eat 30 plates. For $10.99 this was probably the cheapest meal we've had in forever, and the food was actually so good. Service was amazing as well, we'll definitely be back!

The food was absolutely delicious, and the service was very friendly and attentive. Meat and veggies were fresh and tasty. The dumplings and chicken karaage served as appetizers were just okay. I just wish they had a little more variety of side dish options. Overall, we had a great experience and would definitely come back!
I go to a number of hot pot restaurants. This is by far my favorite. Reasonable price. Best selection. Excellent service

I can with a group of friends for a late night dinner and honestly it was the best! Our server, Drewski, took such good care of us and was so attentive the entire time. The food is great as always but definitely the energy of our server elevated it to the next level.
Food service and ambiance was immaculate. Drewski and jkobe was super helpful! Will definitely come back!

I would give them a 3.5/5. Overtime there is less selection in the seafood section, before ( as seen in picture in 2025) there used to be baby octopus, white clams, bigger shrimp size. Now with the same price, we only have frozen squid and some small clams and very little selection of seafood. Even the shirmp size is super small and the sentinel crab now only have small claws and not half a crab like before...quite dissapointed. I could barely choose anything from the seafood stand , most of the options are imitation crabs, eggs, or fish cakes .
The only things doesnt change are the quality of the meat. Still very fresh and tender cut.
Service is always good despite the business of the restaurant.
I usually go for spicy miso or original house broth.
Overall, still a decent place for big family party. My grandma loves this place. But for me it is not too worth it
Had a birthday dinner here the other week. Felt well taken care of, and there wasn't too long of a wait. Great service by Andrew and the rest of the team, will definitely be back soon!

For all you can eat, they do a great job of making diverse options for the meats. They're super tasty and I come here all the time. I recommend checking in early because they do get busy. My favorite time to come is lunch because it's cheaper but it's still definitely worth coming for dinner.

Shabuya has always been a great place to stop by after a long day of work. Talk about a great place to kick back and eat with your buddies. Service here is always A1 and if you get Andrew as your server, just know that you'll never run out of meat. Great food, great service, great atmosphere, what else could you want?
Leilani was awesome! She was really helpful when we were deciding between items. Super quick service and super friendly!!! I love this place

Overall, I greatly enjoy Shabuya, and it has become my go-to shabu spot in Orange County. The food is good, the process is simple, and the atmosphere is usually enjoyable.

I normally visit during lunch, and it is rarely crowded. Most of the time, I get seated right away. The longest I have waited was around 10 minutes, and even that does not happen often.

The meat is good, though I would not call it exceptional. Still, for the price and the all-you-can-eat format, it feels worth it. The self-service area for the sides and dipping sauces sometimes gets messy, but the staff usually keeps everything stocked and refilled. I would skip the cocktails. They look fun, but they do not seem to contain much alcohol for the price.

The service is usually solid. The staff stays attentive and makes an effort to help whenever needed. Not much notes needed here.

The weakest part of the restaurant is the atmosphere. For some reason, the front door is often left open. If you sit near the entrance, cold wind blows inside and makes the area uncomfortable. There is also a strange, high-pitched buzzing noise throughout the restaurant. It is not loud enough to ruin the experience, but I notice it whenever I visit. There is a huge parking lot, but it gets filled up nearby. I never had issues finding a close parking spot, but it doesn't take a minute or two to find one.

I recommend Shabuya for the lunch special. The price is reasonable, the food is good, and I would return again.
The broth, the vegetables, and meat, seafood are so good. We keep coming back. It's taste pretty amazing at the same time healthy.
Leilani was the best server I've ever had. If you ever come here, pray to god you get her as her server.
Leilani was the best server. Was super cool and nice. If you ever come here, ask for her, she was the best. Never had better service in my life
Came here with friends and ate good. Leilani was cool asf and hooked us up. Would only come back again if she's our server
food was great. Props to Leilani L. She just served everything so good and so fast didn't even have to call her over. The goat
Food was great as always! Service was quick too! Leilani was a great server! Great experience overall!

This place never disappoints- I come at least once a month with the hubby. It can sometimes get pretty packed during dinner/weekends but you can put yourself on the waitlist ahead of time.

Staff are friendly and always attentive - the selections are good and I love the sauce bar! Music is good as well especially if you're into EDM.

Was feeling sick so I stopped by Shabuya to max out on some iron and some hot soup to soothe my throat. I can always count on Shabuya to give me a great meal, but today especially I wanted to highlight my server, Vincent, who was super attentive to my party. He always ensured all our dishes came out timely, checked in often, and proactively filled our pots with more soup without us needing to ask. I had come in on a down day, feeling under the weather, but the attentiveness I received made my day feel all the much better. Other than this great service, all the appetizers were fresh and flavorful. Self serve bar was fully stocked and I was able to grab the variety of items I like to get with no issue. 10/10 will always come back, thanks for the great service!

Loved this place! The food was delicious, the atmosphere was great, and the overall vibe made it such a fun experience. Christian was super friendly, attentive and had amazing energy throughout the meal. He made sure we had everything we needed and really made our visit enjoyable. Definitely coming back!

Today I came in looking to eat and I was more than pleased with the servings, and even more with the server. Neil helped us out at every moment we needed and gave us advice on what he prefers, and it ended up being great recommendations. Overall I had an absolutely amazing time at Shabuya because of the environment and Neil! Thank you Neil!

Neil was an exceptional server, providing excellent service, and a great attitude. He was very quick, efficient, and nice. Shabuya ia delicious, and Niel makes the visit great. Do yourself a favor and get inside and try the food, and see if you can get seated in Neil's section for the best service of your life. My gf says that in her 10 years of going there, that was the best service she has ever had!
came in last sunday and had mikey as our server. he was very attentive, helpful, and kind. everything was really good, i would definitely go back!

Came in for shabuya dinner time. The place was packed, but joined the waitlist and got seated fairly quickly for how busy it was during dinner. The meat selection was great to pair along with their choices of broth. Our server Dan was very attentive and professional which made the experience that much better. Will be coming back.
Thanks again Danimals!

Danimals was super attentive to us and helped my family with what they needed! He suggested us great pairings of broths and what meats were the most popular. Would definitely come back again and have him as our server!

We had such a great experience thanks to Leilani! From the moment we arrived, she was welcoming and genuinely attentive. I highly recommend asking for Leilani if you visit--you'll be in great hands. Thank you for making our experience such a positive one!
Excellent restaurant. Very good drinks. Side dishes are amazing. Everything is clean.

Came in today July 4th and I pleasantly surprised when my service was good! My server Vincent was very welcoming for us and because we haven't eaten here before we had many questions (Party of 6). But, Vincent spent his time with us and explained every single broth and meat and gave us recommendations as well. I will definitely coming back due to the service and hopefully get Vincent again!
Food, specifically meat quality was so good, suggesting sauce bowl kind of little small.

the staff was welcoming, attentive, and constantly checked on us without being intrusive. The restaurant was clean, modern, and had a comfortable atmosphere that made it easy to relax and enjoy the meal.
The food quality really stood out. The meat was fresh, beautifully sliced, and there was a great variety to choose from. The broth was flavorful from start to finish, and the selection of vegetables, mushrooms, tofu, noodles, and dipping sauces allowed us to customize every bite.
Service was fast, the meat arrived promptly, and we never had to wait long for refills.
Highly recommend, and I'll definitely be returning!

Lunchtime looked a little busy but very good for the price. food was fresh and good condition. I also like that we have our own pots to eat in. Our server was Iry. She explained very nicely and smiled all the time. She made it very easy for us to request things . Good &delicious time
The food was delicious and the service was amazing. My 1st time there and will definitely be going back. Loved the experience of picking and cooking my own food. $20.99 lunch fir all you can eat!!

For me this was a pass. I like the concept and the variety of broth options they offered but the quality of the food and the service were mediocre. The pork options were the best, with the beef lacking in flavor and even the "higher" quality beef option tasting very basic and not as tender as you'd expect. I very much disliked their low plate limit for meats. While I fully support having a limit it should be taken into account how many people are in the party. We had 7 people in our group and with each plate having about 4 thin slices of meat that was not the type of meal experience one wanted. At the same time the servers did not regularly check in on us to allow us an opportunity to order additional plates, we had to flag them down for most of our orders. This results in your group filling up more on the salad/noodle/hot foods bar and making it not as good of a value for your money. Overall I would pass on this spot and spend a little more for a higher quality spot

Third time eating here at Shabuya! Danimals was our server this time, and he was very attentive throughout our meal. He checked on us frequently, kept the table clean, and was always friendly and engaging. Great service and another enjoyable experience. We'll definitely be back soon!

This spot is exactly similar to broth shabu shabu in Cerritos! I was speaking about it to my friend and the hostess told us they were owned by the same company. Good to know because it felt exactly the same haha. It wasn't as busy as the other location but everything from the process of ordering to the menu were the same. The inside was huge too.

I got the miso broth any we just loaded it up with meats and sides from the middle bar. It was a fun experience overall and the meats were all really good. The quality of the sides were okay, nothing to write home there but no point getting that if you are focusing and stacking meats up. Would recommend because it's Japanese too :)
The soup was better than before. However, it looked like they gave us leftover appetizers. The food looked old and it was hard to chew.

Fresh seafood, good selection of vegetables & meats with pork belly as our preferred meat. Ambiance is good.
Service was satisfactory up until the point when the server came to ask "are you going to pay up?" Taken aback by the rude questioning. There were plenty of tables available so didn't appreciate the rush at the end.
The shitsnest..one of the best of best. And the people working there are super cool. My family and I we never stop going there..and the beer amazing. I love this place

Love Shabuya they always have great service and are willing to accommodate a large group. I've never had a problem here; and food is clean, tables are clean - restroom could use more maintenance but acceptable given the amount of people that come here.

The food was fresh, flavorful, and high quality. The selection of meats, vegetables, and broths was fantastic, and everything tasted delicious.

What really made the visit stand out was the outstanding service. Andrew and Jakobe were both incredibly friendly, attentive, and professional throughout our meal. They checked in regularly, made sure we had everything we needed, and created a welcoming atmosphere.

The combination of great food and exceptional customer service made this one of the best shabu dining experiences I've had. I highly recommend this restaurant and will definitely be coming back.

Shabuya is a go to of mine and was fortunate to have a great server as well. Andrew was extremely respectful, efficient, and thoughtful! I also appreciated Jakobe's attentiveness. They made a good experience an even better one.

The service was outstanding--our server (Druski) was incredibly friendly, attentive, and made sure we always had everything we needed. The food was amazing, with fresh ingredients and premium-quality meats that really stood out compared to other hot pot spots I've been to. Despite how busy it was, the service was quick and efficient, and food came out fast. Overall, great food, excellent service, and high-quality meat. I'll definitely be coming back!

Our server, Andrew or drewski recommended the spicy tonkatsu mix and wow it was actually really good mix! He was always on top of it with bring out the meats right as well we're about to run out. Smooth service and super funny guy! The restaurant was busy yet our server was still able to get everything we ordered quickly!

Great experience! The food was delicious and everything tasted fresh. They offer a wide variety of meats and vegetables, so there's something for everyone. The customer service really stood out--staff was friendly, attentive, and made sure we had everything we needed. Definitely a place I'd come back to!

That was very nice experienced
We went there for birthday and graduation party six of us.
We enjoyed all deference soup and dipping also karaage side order.
Everything good taste.
We are happy with that probably we go again.

I always find myself coming back to Shabuya when I'm craving hot pot. The quality of the meat is consistently good, especially the thin-sliced beef and pork, and the broths never disappoint. I usually go for the Sukiyaki and Huo Guo combo--the sukiyaki is rich and slightly sweet, while the huo guo brings the perfect spicy kick. With fresh vegetables, unlimited meat, and reliable service

I've been here a few times for their lunch special. Such a great deal I can't find anywhere else, $20.99 all you can eat hot pot meat and sides Mon-Fri open until 3pm excluding holidays. Their servers come often to take your order for refills on meat and appetizers and are usually always friendly and helpful. Everything is clean and organized, with pop songs playing in the background. Love this spot!

My favorite restaurant tha best service very good food very fresh
Ambience feel like home

I came here on a weekday for lunch since I wasn't working that day and the price is unbeatable! I have been going to Shabuya for years now and it's always been a classic and affordable ayce shabu spot. It is a huge space and I love that we each got our individual pots. I also like that you can mix the broths so l always get a combination of the spicy miso and the tonkatsu! It's the perfect richness and spice level for me. The meats melt in your mouth and my favorites are the beef toro and the flat iron steak! The lunch menu is a bit more limited, but still so worth it for the price. There's a huge bar in the center where you can get sauces, veggies, seafood, noodles, and everything else. They always do a good job of keeping the bar stocked with fresh items and the meats come out really fast. Loved it and would definitely recommend it! I take my family here and they enjoy it too.
Nice service, delicious food, amazing staff and friendly atmosphere. We will definitely come back.
Every visit has been more than satisfactory. Their broth has the perfect amount of flavor. Not too salty. I enjoy their selection of toppings and assortment of meat. Would a million times, recommend!

We had just moved back to the area and were excited to revisit Shabuya, but were disappointed with the level of service.
It had been about a year since our last visit where the service has noticeably gone down.
Was sat and had placed our first order of meat which didn't arrive.
After waiting 15-20 minutes we had eaten just vegetables from the bar where we had to ask if our meat was going to come.
After asking we waited 5 more minutes where it did show up with slight variation from our initial order.
Our drink and rice orders also took unreasonably long where we were waiting 20 minutes after ordering.
Subsequent meat orders were delivered without issue.
Eye contact from employees are lacking where it was challenging to get ahold of anyone as they kept their gazes down.
Likely this is due to the servers being understaffed and/or when complacency sets in and server movements become robotic in just getting through their shift opposed to focusing on service.

Food quality is good with the communal bar being replenished and kept as clean as could be with the amount of foot traffic.

Would I go back? I would hesitate if we would have to continue to chase down food or drink orders.

Very spacious interior with a self-serve sauce and side dish stand. Meat quality was okay, you pay for what you get as their lunch deal is quite good. My issue was getting gaslighted several times -- I had ordered the sukiyaki broth and let the server know he gave me the miso one instead. He then gave me a new broth and insisted it on being sukiyaki when it tasted like miso again. /: I ended up switching broths with my friend since we were too far into the meal to leave but won't be coming back.

I remember Shabuya being very popular 5 years ago. Haven't been here in a while and it's still good, but not as good as I remember. I will say it is great value for AYCE hotpot!

The hotpot items seem very limited compared to other hotpot places. Missing some of my favorites such as quail eggs, kabocha squash, enoki mushroom... though they do have the best sauce bar situation. You can't really make a bad dipping sauce here. The Yuzu sauce and Goma are fantastic!!

Meat quality was good but sides are limited as well - karaage chicken or fried gyoza! My conclusion is Shabuya offers limited variety with decent execution, but it is a bit boring in terms of AYCE selection.

Host was super friendly and servers were attentive. Would only come back because someone else wants to eat here. Please bring back capsaicin extract.
Certified rapper aka Francine was a amazing server and gave us great service! She slayed at her job and gave us everything we needed.
The food was amazing. Fresh all you can eat meal for $30.00 per person. The open food area is very clean. Simple easy to choose from soup menu.

The food was excellent. The beef, pork belly, and chicken were delicious. They have high quality beef here such as wagyu and beef toro. The meat may arrive thin and small, but will grow in size in the soup. So order the quantity carefully. The service was responsive. The ambiance is nice and it's a big location.

It was a good Mother's Day for me.

~ Great service ~

Me and my friends love coming here, yes for the food, but also for the server Andrew!

He's so sweet and always brings out our meats super fast!

It's lively inside and always packed here.

Just went out to dinner with the fam and as always the food was hitting the spot. But what really made tonight stand out was our server, Andrew. He went above and beyond the entire night. Super attentive, friendly, and made sure everything was perfect without ever feeling overbearing. You can tell he genuinely cares about giving great service and making customers feel welcomed. Definitely one of the best dining experiences we've had in a while thanks to him. Appreciate you Andrew, keep killing it!

Went for dinner with my family here last week and just wanted to say our server Andrew did an AMAZING JOB excellent service he always made sure we had water and napkins and i honestly just super friendly he made my family really enjoy the dinner 100% will be coming back soon bug thanks to Andrew!

all I can say is 10/10. amazing service - shoutout my server andrew he gave fantastic recommendations and made this whole experience awesome. i'll be coming back and bringing all my friends. AMAZING YOU HAVE TO GO HERE

First time eating here on Monday and I had an amazing service from Austin. He recommended tonkotsu for me and made me feel welcomed. If you are coming here please request Austin as your server, he will cater to you.

First time at Shabuya yesterday and had a wonderful time. I had the spicy miso and tonkatsu mix recommended by a fantastic server, Austin! A little too spicy for my taste, but still great overall. Austin was very polite and respectful and really knew what a customer like me would enjoy. The music and environment brought everything together and really livened the experience!

Haven't been to Shabuya in a while, but randomly decide to stop by for dinner. I was pleasantly surprised with my experience. I usually order miso, but Lamar suggested I try something new and made me a broth that was unforgettable. If I remember correctly, it was miso mixed with sukiyaki. The meat quality was great and I enjoyed my overall dinner. If you stop by Shabuya, ask for Lamar for the best broth recommendations and service!

It was my first time eating here and I had a great experience. Austin was super helpful and took the time to recommend the Sukiyaki broth, which ended up being one of my favorites. You can tell he really knows the menu and cares about making sure you enjoy your meal. I'll definitely be coming back thanks to Austin!

Horrible service. I used to love this place. I want to continue to support them but ig looks like they are too popular and dont need customers anymore. I came here for a baby shower & 2 bd. I brought 3 cakes for them to put in the fridge for me. When they brought the cake it was smashed. They put the cake upside down. Then I asked them to sing for us for 2 people bd and their reply was, we can't sing until another 30 mins. The bill already came out. They want us to wait another 30 mins for them to sing? The manager was very rude. She offered to check the camera. I told please check. See who flip my cake upside down like a dumbass. She said we can take jt that far if you want. Sure please do. Of course they never did. They only care about money and not about customer loyalty.
Johnathan working the bar was excellent! Very attentive, great at explaining the menu and options. Also, very polite! Food was awesome! Overall 10/10 experience.

This is one of my favorite spots to eat! The food is great and I love the ambience. Came in and Austin was my server. He made the whole experience really easy and enjoyable, always checked in on us! Would definitely ask for him again!

Bad customer service with bad attitude! We come in early hours to book then people. When we come in they said there is no such thing. They don't see my appointment and am not on the list. The desk girls act like they own the restaurant. You guy need to retrain your employees. I have eat your place a lot of time and 2 places.

8/10
Got the spicy miso broth. I was very satisfied after my meal with the bros. Service was great and whoever got aux tonight has great music taste. Meat quality was pretty good too for an ayce restaurant. Broth itself wasn't anything special, but for all the things included for the price you can't complain.

5 star review. My server was the best and when he went on lunch, my fabulous 5 star server Aiden took over and served us excellently. Never forgot an order. Great food and environment. Shout out to her!!!
my life saver Aiden, came in clutch, seeing us back to back thank god she was there! Best server here btw.
You can't beat their lunch price, great value! With that said, do not expect premium hot pot experience. They've got the essentials!
I am going back again! The food was good. Service was accommodating and friendly. Clean surroundings, Ample parking.

I don't really write much reviews, but today I HAD to leave a positive message and give credit where credit is due! I was craving some meat and Shabuya just so happened to be on the way to home so I stopped by. I was immediately greeted at the door with such care and warmth and was kindly guided to my seat.

My server today was Austin and, let me tell you, he was absolutely phenomenal! I had just worked out today so I asked him for some recommendations and he was right on top of it listing out the best options catered to me. I went with his choices and they were perfect. Exactly what I was looking for today. Service like this does not come around often and his positivity and humor made it that much better.

The next time you come here you HAVE to have Austin as your server!

I go here all the time with friends and family and food is always amazing! It's super fresh, there's a huge selection of sides and meats as well. It's pretty spacious inside and clean. My family and friends go pretty often and the service is exceptional! Austin is usually the server that we see the most and he's so attentive and makes the experience amazing.

Steven is absolutely wonderful! I had such a great experience with him--he is professional, kind, and goes above and beyond to make sure everything is perfect. He really takes the time to listen and ensure you're comfortable with the process, which I appreciated so much.

This was my first time trying Shabuya and it did not disappoint! I sat at the bar and had Jonathan as my server--he provided excellent service from start to finish.
