Since it was my first time, he took the time to walk me through the entire experience, explaining how everything works and making sure I felt comfortable.

Jonathan gave some really solid recommendations that made a big difference, and thanks to him, everything turned out amazing. He made the whole process easy and enjoyable, which made the experience even better.

I highly recommend everyone to give this place a try, especially if it's your first time--ask for Jonathan! He'll take great care of you and make sure you have a great experience.

My boyfriend and I love coming here! The food and service is great. They have a variety of portion for you to choose from. Our waiter was Leilani she was very attentive and friendly! We will definitely be back, Shabuya never disappoints!
Drew was an Amazing host- cared for everything. As a first experience I had an amazing time and would definitely go back again!
We had the pleasure of having Drew as our host and our large party was taken care of so well!
Everything was so amazing!!! Drew was so helpful and kind! I will definitely be back!

Had an amazing first-time experience at Shabuya Fountain Valley earlier today. The ambiance was welcoming and the food was excellent across the board. I don't usually leave Yelp reviews, but our server Ken (Lamar) truly stood out--his recommendations were spot-on, he was attentive without being overbearing, and his energy made the whole experience even better. Highly recommend Shabuya and definitely ask for Ken if you can!

Absolutely no order to their waitlist. The hostess didn't take our name, number, or anything else besides part size. It was lunch time and others started to walk in. It was empty when we arrived. She sat 4 parties ahead of us. The guy who parked after us in the parking lot got sat before us! A group of 3 walked in and she sat them at the bar right away. An options not offered to my party of 2. I checked in with her again and she said, "You didn't ask me to sit at the bar. They asked me first." It's not my job to know what's opened! Immediately walked out after that. Ridiculous.

Leilani was amazing today she was very professional and accommodated my table very well. She made the experience so enjoyable and I appreciate the excellent service she gave us throughout our dine in experience thank you so much!

The food is great, 10/10! The service was quite bad tonight. I've come to this location many times before the staff has always been nice and polite. However tonight was a different case, I'm unsure if he was new to their staff, but his service was less than pleasant. He made mutiple mistakes throughout the night but us thinking he was new didn't want to complain. He messed up on our drinks, appetizers, and meats that we ordered. All little things we could over look. Especially since it was VERY busy we understand mistakes and mix ups happen. But what set me over the edge, bringing me here to leave a review is..
At the end of the night when we were leaving he asked my husband if he "got him?" Referring to a tip, my husband and I were taken aback and my husband responded with "I'm sorry?" The young waiter proceeds to get frustrated with us and with an attitude says "nevermind, forget it". We planned on leaving a cash tip, but for him to blatantly ask for a tip was so rude. I'm sorry but his service was less then mid, the young man Tex who replaced him on his break was far more polite and attentive. Our original waiter was more attentive on speaking with a young girl coworker in the back. I get it, I've worked in the service industry we all have bad nights, but from a service worker to another you NEVER ask for a tip!

Affordable, yes. But you get the price you pay. I gave this place a second chance and still dont like it. The service here sucks. My friend and I gave up waiting and just paid and left. Pots take so long to heat up so we kind of just sat there for a while. Veggie bar is a hit or miss. It doesn't feel clean. Bathrooms were super dirty. Someone even left their latex gloves in the sick counter. There are plenty better shabu places out there.

Shabuya was so good! We went with a garlic based broth, made multiple trips to the buffet station for an assortment of vegetables and carbs, and ordered rounds after rounds of steak. The staff did a great job replenishing our hotpot broth and water. My personal favorite was making our own dipping sauces, since that really enhanced our steaks. The one thing that bothered me was that the waiter never mentioned that *they* have desserts. You have to ask for it yourself, otherwise they will not bring it up at all.​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​ It was kinda crazy that our waiter said that our guest can treat us out for dessert afterward, implying that dessert was elsewhere. Anyway, inside can be noisy because of the music and chattering, but it wasn't so bad.

Sooooo yummmyyyy, friends and I had 2-3 bowls each! Almost 5 stars just bc our waiter didn't get us our drinks until 18ish minutes in when we were halfway through the first bowl. Took a while to get refills too but otherwise since it's self-serve - really good! Selection of broth, sauces and meats and noodles great

Used to be my go to hot pot place but haven't been in quite some time. Our server was amazing and super considerate. Meat and sauces were good, but their salad/seafood bar could use some more options since both sides were basically the same. Would come back for the price if I'm in the area
I went in to Shabuya today to celebrate my 21st birthday! I had an amazing experience there thanks to Leilani! Every time I go with my family we always have great service and good music too.

Wanted to leave a review today. Think the yelp app was broken though because I was trying to leave 10 out of 5 stars for Leilani's incredible service but I guess 5 stars will do. Already knowing our order before we walk in the door is top notch and and world class service. Shout out to Leilani
we always go to this location and our server LEILANI is the best!! the food is great and the capri soju is our fave :)

What a great experience. Today was our first time there. Dennis H. was such a great host. Food was fresh and tasty and Dennis's service was the perfect match. We're definitely coming back and definitely recommend this spot

Fantastic experience with Shabuya today! Drewski and Autin were just amazing. They were super attentive and were quick to answer any questions we had. Honestly a much better dining environment compared to other AYCE hotpot's. The meat quality was great and this place does their broths right! I would highly recommend people to come here and I guarantee Drewski and Autin would provide excellent service.

Can't wait for next time!
The best hot pot place I ever been. Will not go anywhere else. Loved the tonkotsu broth and spicy miso. The meats were fresh. The sides and sauces added good texture and flavor.

Had one of the best dining experiences at Shabuya Fountain Valley thanks to our server Dan Ngo.

The service was truly exceptional, attentive, friendly, and made everything seamless from start to finish. Dan went above and beyond to make sure we had the best experience possible.

Highly recommend asking for him if you visit!
Love this place and the food is great. They have good music late at night. Service is good too
This place had a very welcoming atmosphere and our server, Dan, truly made the whole experience exceptional. He was really dialed in on making sure we got taken care of and provided the best service.

Came by the other week with my friend and had an amazing experience. The food was delicious and the ambiance was just right. Our server Jonathan (Blur) also went above and beyond and took very good care of us. His service made our dinner 10x better. I'll be sure to ask for him every time I come back!

I had a great time at Shabuya with a large group of my friends. The environment was very lively and seating was not in issue. You don't need to study up on the menu or know how to eat hotpot style food as my server Drewski guided us along the way. Im a big fan of AYCE style establishments. The food was amazing and my server Drewski was kind and very attentive. He helped me choose out the perfect choice of meat and made sure I was well attended to. The bar had a great selection of addetives to add to the broth and I would recommend the quail eggs. It was my first time eating at this establishment with my girlfriend and the food was great and the service so amazing. I had the pleasure of having Drewski as my server and he helped us choose a broth that was very enjoyable. I would definitely came back again.

We recently had the pleasure of dining at a Shabuya in Fountain Valley that exceeded expectations in nearly every way. From the moment I walked in, the atmosphere struck a perfect balance of comfortable and just enough background music to create a relaxed vibe without overpowering conversation.

The service was attentive without being intrusive. Our server on that evening was Drewski. He was very knowledgeable about the menu, offered great recommendations, and made sure everything arrived at just the right pace. It's always a good sign when you feel taken care of. He was always ready to take orders and friendly.

As for the food, it was the real highlight. I started with appetizers For the main course, all the meats were great and delicious. Even the sides, often an afterthought at other places, were delicious.

Drinks were good and tasty. Prices were reasonable considering the quality of both food and service. Whether you're planning a casual dinner or a special night out, this restaurant delivers a consistently enjoyable experience. We will definitely be coming back--and recommending it to others. A big THANK YOU to Drewski for excellent services.
The service and food were great. Dan was super attentive to us. A lot of selection for sides meat and vegetables.

i went with my friend and our server vincent was super friendly and attentive to us. it was our first time there and he made it a great experience so we'll def come back next time. the price is good for the lunch special for only $20. the seating was nice and there was a self service bar in the middle. thank you vincent and staff

Yesterday was my first time at Shabuya, and let me tell you, it was a life changing experience. Upon entering, you are greeted with a smile and after being seated, our amazing server attended us with the utmost respect and kindness. Our server, Vincent, gave us recommendations and took care of us while letting us enjoy the peaceful ambiance. The food was amazing but Vincent's positive attitude and service was the cherry on top. Vincent has won Shabuya a life-long customer.

Parking was an absolute zoo, but we found a place. We had reservations (large party), and we were seated quickly. I'd never been here before, and I was surprised by how big the restaurant was, and I was immediately struck by the giant "salad bar" (veggies, sauces, shellfish, add-ins, etc.) in the middle of the restaurant. The place was PACKED, and the servers did their absolute best. Especially impressive, since the noise level was so high it was hard to hear.

I had the regular miso base; omg, it was saltier than the ocean (and I'm a salt-lover). We ordered every meat on the menu, but it was the Kobe and top sirloin that were the clear winners. The pork was more like fatty bacon (do YOU usually boil your bacon?), and the chicken kind of dissolved into the broth.

Now for the "Add-In Bar": . Yes, it had a lot of items. But putting the raw shellfish (most of which was floating in a swill of water) next to fresh veg was off-putting. There were seven or eight different (but similar-looking) sauces (not well-labeled), and I shudder to think how many fingers were in there. To be fair: this "salad bar" style isn't a bad idea, and I bet it was pristine before the dinner rush, but by the time we were there, it was pretty gross. It would probably take 2-3 designated employees just to adequately man and maintain this part.

HOWEVER: no one from our party got sick (as far as I know), everyone left full and happy (if overstimulated), and honestly, $30 AYCE that's protein-heavy is a STEAL.

Oh, also: the bathroom was satisfactorily clean (and has a fun faucet...it's the sink on the left. IFKYK.)

I know a lot of people love this place, and I get it, but I have a place I like much better, so I probably won't be back (and I doubt I'll be missed!), but I wish them good luck and good fortune.

Leilani was TEAAAAAAA!!! So sweet and real. Super attentive. The way Shabuya literally feels like the coolest place to be is bc of the bomb a$$ broth and the super sick ppl that work here like Leilani.

Honestly, I wish ALL servers were like Leilani - and hope we can get her every time.

I normally don't write reviews, but since my family and I became regulars here we get service from multiple servers..... but out of all the servers we had, Leilani was the best. Always a pleasurable time at Shabuya, we had Leilani serve us. If we come and she is serving us, she usually has our order in ready to go by heart before we sit down which is amazing, this isn't to say that all the other shabuya staff members aren't also amazing. Everyone here is great really!

I don't understand how this place has a 4.5-star rating; the server wasn't friendly, the meat wasn't fresh, the seafood bins were dirty, and the vegetables weren't washed. I suffered from stomach pain for two days after eating there.

My best Shabu Shabu in the area! I love their soup and side of buffet. There are variety of choices with the quality of meat. If You are looking for shabu with the great price and service quick. I highly recommended here.

I'm always up for trying a new shabu shabu restaurant, so some friends and I visited Shabuya for our weekly dinner.

Shabuya is located at the end of a shopping center with plenty of parking. They do utilize a Yelp live waitlist which we took advantage of. I put us on the waitlist 15 minutes before our arrival, and we only had to wait a few minutes to be seated even though there were quite a few other people waiting.

The inside is spacious with high ceilings. The booths and tables have good spacing, and everything was clean. There is a 1.5 hour dining limit.

They have a good selection of five broths including original house, miso, spicy miso, tonkotsu, and sukiyaki. I always go with spicy miso and theirs is pretty mild. They have a good selection of meats including five types of beef, two types of pork, and chicken. The only meat they are missing from our regular shabu shabu place is lamb. The meats were very fresh, and our orders for more were delivered quickly. Empty trays were also removed promptly.

I really liked the setup of their sides bar. Our regular place has veggies and noodles on one side, and eggs, seafood, etc on the other side and there is often a line on both sides when it is busy. Both sides here have mostly the same items, and even though the restaurant was pretty full, there was never a line on either side. There is also a sauce station on both ends of the bar, so again there was no wait. Everything was fresh, and most item containers were near full.

Their Asian chili sauce is HOT, much hotter than our normal place. I'm glad I tried some of it before asking for hot drops to add to my broth.

Our server Danny was awesome. He was very friendly and fun, and took excellent care of us. I hope we get him again the next time we visit.

We all really enjoyed our meal here, and $29.99 for AYCE shabu shabu of this quality with great service is a good deal.

Love this place! My boyfriend and I love to come here because it's not too expensive for all you can eat and everything is delicious! The workers are also very kind and attentive, we never have to wait for someone to check on us. My only thing is that the music is always a little loud, however they always play good music so it doesn't really bother me it just might be loud for some people. Bonus points: took my mom here (she's never had anything like this before) and she loved it!!
LEILANI WAS SO AMAZING AT HER SERVICE - literally made my hg and I day and the ambiance was perfect. She's so sweet, it truly made our first time experience so worth it!!

I'm writing this review while still dining here because that's how bad the experience was. She completely ruined my Friday night and killed my appetite, despite how much I usually enjoy the food.

Perfect place for a cold winter day for any party. Shabuya has 7 locations across Hawaii, California, and Las Vegas. We are fortunate to have it so close to where we live in Orange County. One of the best things about Shabuya compared to other AYCE hotpots in the area would be their competitive pricing in this economy ($21 lunch M-F specials and their dinner cost is about $30).
Service (3/5): On weekends, you'll find that are waits so long (+1 to 2 hours) so it is best to come early. On slow days, the service will be amazing and on busy days, you will rarely see your server.
Food (4/5): They have a good selection of vegetables, 4 appetizers, 5 broths (original, miso, spicy miso, tonkotsu, and sukiyaki). There are 6 different types of meat (prime blade, toro, prime cross rib, belly, shoulder, and chicken thigh).
The buffet table has some types of seafood (clams, mussels, shrimp, white fish) and different dipping sauces such as Ponzu, onions, garlic. Other things on their menu are their sake, soju, and draft beer. With 1.5 hours of eating, this is a great place to take families. They have employees frequently cleaning the buffet area and refiling trays. My only constructive criticism is that they don't change their menu adding or swapping in different meats or seafood. I can see how you can get bored with eating here after indulging in copious amounts of bowls.

Came in with a 10 people group on a weekend. Go early and check in/make appt! Delish AYCE! You get your own personal broth pot to cook. Each meat plate has 4 slices of meat. What makes this place special is that they have clams, mussels, eggs(!!) and octopi at the veggie bar. Ponzu and yuzu are great to pair as refreshing sauces. Easy free parking in a shopping mall!
The only concern is that we had to ask the server for tongs to pick up the raw meat(no cross contamination please), they weren't automatically given. Another negative at my table the burners were pretty slow to get to boil, the server said it's because I had tonkotsu flavor.
Bonus: for birthday you can get a free drink (soda) if you let the server know!

This is for last Friday, the 16th I went with my mom and to my surprise, I had Gummy/Victor again and his service was amazing once again! My mom couldn't have worded his service any better; he is the definition of what customer service is/should be and we will definitely look for him again! Missing the quail eggs and octopus, but other than that, the food and music were also amazing as usual! Thank you and we look forward to the next visit

We went to Shabuya and overall it was a really solid hot pot experience.

We got seated super quickly, which was a great start. Everything is self-serve except for the meats, so you can move at your own pace and grab exactly what you want. The selection wasn't huge, but it was just enough to keep me happy without feeling overwhelming. Everything looked fresh, and I really liked that they had iced seafood, which made it feel cleaner and higher quality.

For broth, we went with original and sukiyaki. The main difference was that the sukiyaki was a bit sweeter, which was nice for dipping meats and balancing out savory flavors, while the original stayed more clean and classic.

We honestly went crazy with the meat; so many plates (as you can see in the pic). The meat was soft, tender, and really well-sliced. My favorite by far was #5, the prime flat iron steak; that one stood out the most. Super tender, great texture, and cooked perfectly in the broth.

We also ordered the gyoza, which came fried and was actually really good: crispy on the outside and satisfying as a little side between hot pot rounds.

Service was really quick, but you do have to flag down the waiters when you want more meat or help. they don't check in constantly. Once you get their attention though, they move fast.

Overall, Shabuya was good, efficient, and satisfying; fresh ingredients, solid broths, great meat quality, and a smooth AYCE-style experience. Definitely a spot I'd come back to when I'm craving hot pot without the chaos.
Love the option to eat healthy, fresh food at Shabuya. I love to have lots of tofu and bok choy and graze allll the mushrooms. Unique experience!
W Leilani !!! She was awesome, great character, kept checking up on us, and had amazing conversation with our whole table ! We're coming back FOR SURE and asking to be sat at her table.

Thanks to all the staff for providing hospitality and professional service. Very well managed restaurant

Onto the food aspect, very good selection of Veggies and seafood. Broth was amazing meat selection was on point, and the servers were very prompt and attentive making sure we always had food and drinks. Left Shabuya feeling satisfied and gratified. Truly 5 stars. Highly recommended, good job to all Shabuya staff. Keep up the great work!

Overall great food, great atmosphere and great experience.

My friends and I frequent this location often due to the quality of the meat but today we were taken care of by Leilani and she was amazing! She really elevated our experience and was kind and helpful whenever we had questions or concerns about the meats and other items!

I am a regular here and of the countless times that I've been here, I always remember when Leilani is my server. She is without a doubt the best server I have ever had here and never fails to make my whole day. The food is great, priced are reasonable and they're the only shabu place that has yuzu at the sauce bar! Also love the new wagyu meat addition, it's definitely my new go-to

The 5 star rating is purely based on the service we received on a BUSY Saturday night. Our server Leilani was amazing!! She was very attentive, friendly and quick with the service. The food quality was great as always!

Favorite Hot Pot restaurant we go to. Food is always very good, atmosphere is always a vibe. Our server, Leilani, was very attentive with us, always checking up on us, asking if we needed anything, and when asked for anything, food, napkins, refills, etc. She would always be fast and accurate with it. I rate her 10 / 10

My family and I come to this place so often, always so good in all aspects. Leilani, our waitress, is always so tentative, fun, and sweet. She's always so fun to talk to and we always especially enjoy our visits whenever we're put in her section. Our favorite server for sure!

It was our first time visiting and our server Jenny went above and beyond in explaining everything along with suggestions based on our likes/dislikes. My husband got the Spicy Miso & I got the Original and she did not miss with the suggestion! She did great on checking in with us throughout our lunch. Loved the options they have and their lunch pricing is great!
Food is always good. Service is great and fast with a smile. The place is clean and well maintained all around. Thank you for your service.

Beware if paying in cash

My family and I celebrated our daughter's birthday there in Sept 2025. Food and service were great. We paid the bill in cash, tip included. Handed it off to our waiter and left the restaurant only to be called by the manager and accused of skipping out on our bill. She claimed the folder which the waiter handed her only contained $17. We were 5 adults and 3 children. The bill was over $200 and we paid it. They said they would call the police. I urged them again and again to call the police and review the security footage. I said I would even watch it with them to show that we did pay, but for some reason they didn't call the police. After a lot of back and forth they said they couldn't confirm that we paid it all but also stated that she (the manager) did not believe we scammed them, that we didn't seem like the type of people who would do something like this. After multiple calls and talks, I urged the manager to do better with their staff hiring because I believe the staff is stealing from customers who pay in cash. The manager couldn't say where the waiter went after he took our bill, so it's our suspicion that the waiters are going somewhere off camera and taking the cash payments and telling management that the customers skipped the bill. We had been going here for years. This was one our go-to restaurants every month. Our kids loved it and so did we but we can't go back here in good faith knowing how they treated us.
Our food was delicious! I loved the selection of fresh vegetables and good atmosphere. AJ at the bar was so helpful and gave our party great service. Would come back just for him!
Service is always super good here even on their busiest nights. We sat at the bar and our server aj was super friendly and attentive throughout our entire meal; making sure everything was good.

This place has pretty good food but what separates it from other places is the service. If you find yourself getting waited by my girl Leilani, you're in great hands!

My girlfriend gets thirsty when she eats and I swear we NEVER had to ask for a refill, so my lady was hydrated the whole time. Leilani is so attentive even though I'm pretty sure she was serving like 15 other tables, before we asked for stuff we'd find ourselves getting asked by Leilani if we needed anything. She definitely elevated the experience and my expectations of this place, the ambiance couldn't have been better thanks to her. Thanks Leilani!! We'll be back.

Typically our experience here is already very good, but this time it was absolutely impeccable. We were lucky to be taken care of by Leilani, who went above and beyond to make sure everything was perfect. She was attentive, friendly, and incredibly proactive--anticipating our needs before we even had to ask. From refilling broths and checking in frequently at just the right moments to making sure we were comfortable and enjoying our meal, her service truly elevated the entire experience. Leilani's genuine care made our visit memorable, and we will definitely be coming back because of her outstanding service. Highly recommend asking for her if you dine here!

The food was also fantastic. The cuts of meat were high quality and fresh, and everything we ordered came out exactly as expected.

Great tasting AYCE beef and chicken appetizers
Great service and friendly staffs
Great atmosphere and cleanliness
this is apex fun family dining, the kind where you bring the village and everyone is throwing stuff into a hotpot. Great during the rainy cold weather.
Price was great and service was outstanding. Shout out to Leilani for her excellent service and hospitality -- felt extremely well attended to!
Food was delicious. Price was reasonable. Service was quick and friendly. Leilani was a great hostess. 9/10 would recommend.
Service was great. Leilani helped us the whole time and always made sure we were well accommodated.
Leilani did a great job taking care of us. Checked up on us frequently and was super friendly. Would recommend this place for solid shabu and consistent service.

We had a great experience at shabuya, and a huge part of that was the bartender, Krenz. From the moment we sat down, he was friendly, attentive, and genuinely welcoming. He took the time to explain drink options, made excellent recommendations, and kept everything flowing smoothly even when it got busy.

Krenz has that perfect balance of professionalism and personality -- he made us feel comfortable, remembered our preferences, and checked in without being overbearing. The drinks were consistently well-made and added to an already fun, high-energy shabu-shabu experience.

exceptional service like this is what really makes a visit stand out. If you're dining here, definitely sit at the bar and hope Krenz is working -- he truly elevated the experience. We'll be back!

Can I just say I've been here countless of times and have had multiple different servers but I just have to say Drewski is my favorite by far. He's super funny and always has me and my family and friends leave with a smile. He's never disappointed especially when I bring newcomers and they ask him all sorts of things. Super helpful especially since it can get overwhelming during rush hours.

Aside from service, I LOVE the options that they have. My favorite cut is probably the sukiyaki broth and beef toro cut! Although it can be fatty sometimes, it's still my favorite nonetheless. I like other places too but I feel like nothing can beat the goma sauce here along with the green noodles that they offer which I don't believe I've seen anywhere else. The Volcano chicken they have is so so good too. Usually the "spicy" options aren't spicy enough but this hits the spot for me and I'm sure for any spice lover out there!

I definitely recommend asking for Drew (if it's allowed to request certain servers) if you want a funny, respectful server who's always on top of it especially if it's your first time trying Shabuya!!

Great experience for first timer! Leilani, our waiter, was very attentive and kept checking in on us every 30 minutes or so. Her service was amazing. The food here is also excellent! Good variety of vegetables and side dishes. Overall, Shabuya is a very affordable and delicious hot pot place!
I think they have less choices than before. The last time I came here was two weeks ago and they didn't even have baby octopus and one of the beef options is out too. It was like around 7pm
The server was not good and I felt like I would get food poisoning from that place. The restaurant had a weird smell.
Great food and service. 100% would recommend to friends and family. Always a number 1 choice when choosing an outing for lunch or dinner.
Love this place when I'm in the mood for some hot pot. I get the spicy miso and it's always great along with the beef toro.
Service is great!!! We wet do the lunch special pricing for group of 7. Got seated asap. Everything tastes great

Last night I had a great experience dining at shabuya. Food was great as always. The highlight of my experience was definitely the service. Our server Leilani was very welcoming and friendly. She frequently checked up on our table and brought everything out very fast. You could tell she loves her job. Great overall experience!

Leilani was an amazing server at Shabuya! She was super friendly, attentive, and made sure everything ran smoothly the whole time. Great energy and great service, she really made our experience better. Would definitely ask for her again!

Best and affordable hot pot place!
I have been into other hot pot places which are more expensive and not much better options in their menu.
In this place service is good, clean, yummy and affordable.
They had a huge lunch rush and took care of biz! Always a great time! The food and service was amazing! Can't beat the lunch special! See ya soon

Vincent made our experience absolutely amazing. From the moment we sat down, he was friendly, attentive, and genuinely cared about making sure everything was perfect. He explained the menu clearly, checked in at just the right times, and made great recommendations that we ended up loving. The service was super fast, and he never made us feel rushed. Service like this really elevates the whole meal, and Vincent was a big reason we enjoyed ourselves so much.
Neil was and is an amazing server. He went above and beyond for our group. Made us feel welcome and we are sure to come back!

We come here frequently and the food and service is always fantastic! However I do have to mention that the music is often questionable and feels weird for music to eat to. Having the music go from nickelback into bob marley into a bunch of mumble rap then 30 minutes of EDM is strange. Whoever controls the music has a very questionable playlist to say the least.

There are also times where it's just blasting like 160 bpm EDM or hardstyle/dubstep the entire time and I feel like I should have brought glow sticks to this rave.

Overall good food but whoever controls the Spotify playlist should be brought in for questioning.

Edit: I feel like I have to downgrade this to a 4 after more thought as every time we come here the main topic always ends up being the music. The music is honestly detrimental to a place that we enjoy coming to frequently.

not a huge selection of meat but great choices for the price! visited a couple days ago for a birthday, and although we were a little late to the check in for our reservation, they seated us immediately!
Only like it cause my girl loves it here..come here enuff times you start to looking forward to coming and the best part is you don't have to do the dishes wen your done eating..

Came to eat here with my boyfriend, had to come back twice in the same week. The meats are delicious and they have great selection at their sides bar. Our server Danny gave us amazing service. He was on top of it and really cool. Be back soon!!
The food is always consistent but our server Danny was so attentive and made our whole night so much better! He always checked on us and gave us amazing service!!
My server Danny was great! Super attentive, and quickly took our order and brought out drinks! Great service.
Great food and good vibes. Danny is an excellent server. We did not have to wait on Danny for service, he was attentive and kept the flow going. Would come back.

Shabuya - Fountain Valley, CA

Shabuya remains my absolute favorite all-you-can-eat shabu shabu spot in Orange County, and I've tried quite a few! The quality here consistently blows me away, especially the prime cut meats--tender, beautifully marbled beef that melts in your mouth after just a quick swish in the broth. For the price (around $30 for dinner AYCE), getting prime-grade slices unlimited is an incredible deal that you don't find everywhere.
What really shines for group dining is the individual induction pots at every seat. We recently came with a large party of 10, and it made everything so seamless--no fighting over a shared pot, everyone can customize their broth (I love mixing tonkotsu and spicy miso), cook at their own pace, and avoid cross-contamination for picky eaters or dietary preferences. It's perfect for big gatherings, birthdays, or family outings without the chaos of communal hot pots.
The veggie bar is fresh and plentiful, sauces are spot-on (ponzu and goma all day), and service is efficient even when busy. If you're a shabu fanatic like me, this is the go-to. Highly recommend!

We got the best service from Leilani! She was extremely kind, cheery and helpful. She checked in on us often, offering more broth and meat. The food was high quality too. We will be coming back in the near future!!

I want to thank our serve Lil Spoon for his spectacular customer service. He was fast and efficient & by far the best service we've ever had here at Shabuya. The food was fresh and tasty, can't wait to come back.

I don't think this place is a good fit for me. The previous times I ate here, the service was slow and we had to wait a long time for staff to come. This time, I already knew from experience that we were only allowed to eat for 90 minutes.

The staff reminded us that we had to leave within 24 minutes because they needed the table for the next group since it was very busy. I understand that, and we did eat within the 90-minute limit. However, we still had 10 minutes left, and a staff member came over asking if they could clear the table. I felt uncomfortable because this visit felt rushed, like we were being pushed out.

I'm not sure if I'll come back again.
I visit Shabuya very often because of the consistent food, great service, and good drinks! Vincent, our server was great and we hope to keep getting him as our server!

I went here today for dinner with one of my close friends, and we were rudely kicked out of our table. We checked in at 5:45 and were seated by 6pm. And by 7:15, our server, Chris. He came and told us rudely "somebody's going to come and clean your table." Nothing more and nothing else. And he quickly left.

The dining limit is 1 hr and 30 mins. It was only 1 hr and 15 min. We would have respected the policy and understood if our server were nicer. He could have said something like "Oh hey, just to let you know. We do have a time limit and you're about to hit it, if you could please wrap things up." Instead of his initial comment above.

And when I asked to speak to him again, he said that the reception girls told him that we were hitting the dining limit. I then went to asked one of the girls who checked my party in and she said that we took our headcount at 5:45. I don't even know what a headcount is. But even then, telling guests that "somebody will be here shortly to clean up your table," even 1/2 of party is clearly not finished eating.

I've been coming to this location for years, and after today, I won't be back.
The food is always good here and we always find it to be a good value. Service can be hit and miss, usually depending on how busy they are. We come here at least once a month.
Service is amazing, Jenny came in and checked in with us every 30 mins or so. 30$ for AYCE is impressive considering the great quality and value. Favorite meat has to be beef toro.

This is my least favorite location and i think ive been to the all the ones in SoCal.

The salad bar sucks. It's crazy cus i thought the salad bars would have all the same stuff but this one was lackin and a lot of the veggies were empty and not very fresh.
The meat quality was alright tho.
There were so many people working yet no one restocking the veggies :/

We were in CA recently in the last month for two related business trips. While there we at shabu shabu three time. Twice at a rates place in Cerritos, and finally at this chain establishment. So excited because they have a restaurant here in Honolulu.

The spicy miso soup is fantastic. Add some jalapeños and it brings the soup to the proper kick. The vegetables are fresh and perfectly cut. Tofu and all the right stuff. We ordered the beef and pork belly, and kept it coming.

Delicious, delicious, delicious x100. I am totally hooked and addicted. I need to go again and really soon. When i do I'll write a review so you can consider this eatery too.
Randomly stumbled upon this place last night when we were trying to grab a late bite. Favorite new spot! Good music and food and the capri soju is so cute. A very laid back spot
enjoy my time every visit! john was super kind and all the staff are very helpful and attentive. love it here!
Food and service was great!! John was super welcoming and accommodating to our party of 7. He is much appreciated
John was such a great guy! Enjoyed my time here everything was so good! Always love taking my friends here!!

Pretty good shabu shabu place. Each person gets their own pot, but i felt like they didn't have too many options for soup bases. I got the tonkatsu which was good. Meats were good, but when you sit with a table, they give you just a stack of plates without a utensil like a tongs. Feels kind of weird.
Great shabu spot! Definitely good bang for your buck (especially with their lunch menu). Lil Spoon Chris gave us exceptional service! Always a go-to spot for us
We love coming here ! Especially the server Leilani her service was 10/10 ! She was so helpful and extremely kind! She made her experience so much better. We are def coming back!
We loved having Leilani as our server! She checked in often, helped us get what we needed. Food is always good here!

This is our go to hot pot spot! The service! The selections! The food is always top notch! We have never had a bad experience. My family and I always get the spicy miso broth. For sides we get the spicy chicken karaage and goyza, they are piping hot and come out quickly. The meats are sliced super thin and cook quickly, our fav is the blade meat.

We had no trouble finding parking and we were seated within minutes upon our arrival. However, it took longer than expected for our server to take our order. After placing it, we were able to go get the ingredients that we wanted to add to our broth. The food was fine, but the service was really slow. The restaurant was not particularly busy and most of the servers were gathered in the back bar area, chatting among themselves. The lack of attention was even more noticeable when I saw that other customers had to wave across the restaurant just to get the staff's attention. Overall, it was an underwhelming experience due to the service.
So nice and so much food!!! Definitely would recommend if your really hungry if your looking for a small meal not the place for you.
Good food, ok service unless "Fast" is serving you. Beer is crisp and clean. Very dimmly lit. Food bar smells like fish...

Shabuya in Fountain Valley delivers the best shabu in the area, offering a superb all-you-can-eat experience. The dining environment is excellent, thanks to the great background music and consistently great service. The food quality is top-notch: you'll find fresh vegetables and the best gyoza around. However, the true star is the great sauce bar, which allows you to customize your meal perfectly. Shabuya successfully combines high-quality ingredients with fantastic hospitality and atmosphere.

It's been awhile since I've eaten at Shabuya, but their service and food are still top tier to me!!Jenny ended up being our server and she was on top of all of our orders!! THE BEST!! From meats to drinks- she's fast! It wasn't too busy in the morning either, so it was nice getting the extra attention. Food tasted delicious- can't complain when I just come for their beef and veggies mainly! Their selection is huge though- my photo didn't do it justice this time.

Definitely recommend coming here! It makes for a cute date and since it's been cold out- It's giving cozy hot pot vibes!
Great vibe great food. Leilani's service was on point. She was around regularly and got us everything we needed.
2nd time here, Lelani made a meat suggestion I would have never tried and I'm so glad I did, I have a new favorite for sure. Everything was quick and delicious.
Leilani was such an amazing waitress! She was super attentive and always checked in with us. Food is always amazing as well!

10/10 service
10/10 food
10/10 overall experience

Came on a Sunday evening with a party of 8. Our server was very courteous and attentive to our table despite the whole restaurant being packed. Meat came out fast and the self-serve bar was constantly refilled. The manager, John, also introduced himself to our table and made sure my dad's bday celebration was memorable.

This is the type of service that makes you come back and invite all your friends and family
Service was really good, our server Leilani was very attentive and cared to our needs. Would come back here again.
Food was great, our server Leilani was very attentive and welcoming. First time there and she was very understanding and helpful definitely coming back.
20$ Lunch deal is worth 50$ -- best deal going!!!! Couldn't recommend Shabuya any more for an AYCE Shabu Joint

Service was really good, our server was really kind and kept checking in on us and refilling our broths!

Loved the abundance of vegetables, seafood, and good quality meat (favorite was the short blade). There was a flavorful crab boil available every hour and there's a section of hot foods, drinks, and desserts. There's so much to try and so little stomach space.

It's cute for a little date night or a family meal. And there's seating outside or inside. It's a bit pricy and you have the option to sign up for a membership for a lower member price.

Being coming here for awhile now but the host lady and manager John is getting a bit full of themselves. Came on a Thursday, since there were only 2 of us they wanted to put us in the worst table by the kitchen. When we asked to be switched out the host lady and manager John were incredibly rude. It was not even crowded with plenty of seating! When my wife mentioned we will leave John snatched the menu off her hands. I have been coming to this restaurant for a long time. Tonight, I came here for my anniversary with my husband. We were placed at a table right at the dirty dishes area. The area smells bad. Then, John, the manager, came and rudely said: no.
He was angry and very rude.
After I said, it is ok, then I don't feel like having dinner there anymore.
John quickly took the menu I was holding on my hands.
This is the worst experience I have had at any restaurants I have ever been to.
I like the food here. However, because of John, the manager here, I will never come back here again.

Food is amazing I love the loud music and the atmosphere is perfect for a date night but not fancy and I love that so I don't have to feel like you have to dress up after a long day. Drinks are awesome definitely recommend any of the soju capris!! So adorable comes with a color changing ice cube. Servers are so sweet and will literally try and accommodate any requests given. It's my favorite place.

We came here for my son's birthday. For it being the majority of everyone's first time our server was very attentive & did an excellent job explaining how the operated. My dad & brother fell in love. My dad is bringing his friends for a get together here next week & my brother plans on bringing his family here soon.

We have been in Shabuya many time, but tonight is the best night and experience for me because Jonathan Bui was our server and he did a fantastic job. I hope that next visit he could be our server again.

This restaurant has serious hygiene problems. The meat wasn't fresh, and the dipping sauce tasted moldy. My whole family had a gathering yesterday, and when we got home, my family members felt unwell. We went to urgent care, Our health was ruined by a single dinner. I hope the relevant departments can investigate the food quality and safety of this restaurant. I will never go to this restaurant again; it's too terrible. If anyone else gets sick after eating there, please let more people know so they won't go to this restaurant!

A fun place to eat if you have a large group. Lots of choices and lots to eat. Quality is decent but what can you expect for an AYCE place. The service is always courteous and accommodating as we've been here multiple times for company luncheons. I love Tom Yum so have to wing it, improvise to make my own version of Tom Yum by using their kimchi. Overall good foods. Clean place.

Shabuya is an amazing all-you-can-eat hot pot experience! The selection of meats, veggies, and sauces is fresh and flavorful. The service is friendly and quick, keeping everything well-stocked. The broths are rich and customizable to your taste. Definitely worth the price for a fun and satisfying meal with family or friends!
So good everything was amazing service amazing food so amazing slaps 10/10 yum yum yum
Drewski was great! Highly recommend bringing your family for some AYCE at Shabuya. Very attentive staff and great customer service!

Drewski Made It Perfect!

Had an awesome time at Shabuya Fountain Valley! We came in as a party of 10, and our server Drewski absolutely crushed it. Handling a big group isn't easy, but he made it look effortless -- super friendly, fast, and always on top of everything.

He kept our broths full, checked in often without us even needing to ask, and made sure every order came out right and on time. Even with how busy it was, Drewski treated us like VIPs the entire meal. You could really tell he cares about his guests and enjoys what he does.

The AYCE hot pot itself was delicious -- fresh meats, tasty broths, and plenty of variety to keep everyone happy. But what made the whole experience stand out was the excellent guest service.

If you're planning to go to Shabuya, ask for Drewski -- he'll make your meal ten times better. Definitely coming back again soon!
Food was really good. The service was amazing and attentive. Our server Drewski was very helpful and great. I would definitely come here again!!!

Came here for my wife's bday. Very spacious and lots of parking. I might have went when it was short staffed because it took us a couple minutes to get greeted. This is a AYCE and the price is reasonable. Out of all the broths I liked tonkatsu and spicy miso the best the ambiance is friendly and the vibe was friendly. Lots of choices for veggies and meat. This is a spot you want to come when you're starving . I would come back. Strong 5/5 for food. Service was lacking a bit, like I said, I might have came in a short staffed day.

We celebrated my mom's birthday at Shabuya! We had a pretty large party but Leilani the goat helped us out with everything we needed and provided wonderful service. The food was great and all for an affordable price. I love meat

Amazing hot pot spot. Tonkotsu broth is my favorite along with the flat iron beef. Food can be slow, especially when it's extremely busy. Leilani was great however, she kept food coming and was checking up on us consistently. Would recommend asking for her if it is not too busy.
Great meal!! My server Leilani was beyond amazing!!! Offered great service, very friendly and fast!

We always love going to shabuya, but this time in particular the service was fantastic. Leilani was very attentive, we never had to wait long for anything. It was some of the best service I've had at Shabuya.

I have been going here the past few years either with my friends or my family. We typically go here for lunch because there are many tables available compared to their dinner hours. Yes, there is a 2 hour limit but trust me, most tables never make it to 40 plates of quality meats!

Parking fills up, great staff very fast and attentive, price is reasonable. Huge space, tons of seatings and tables.

2 sided food bar, great variety of broths, tons of options for veggies and seafood.

Unique flavors of boba drinks aside of regular drinks. Overall, my family loved it! It was nice the whole staff sung happy birthday to me, that was very nice of them.

First of all, this spot is our favorite hotpot! The food is the best specially this season, the ambiance is great, it's not crowded and the servers are all kind! They even have a lunch special of $19.99, where in California you can see a hotpot with that price!
They have an Anniversary promotion that runs through November, a 15% off..
Try it and I guarantee you'll love it too!

Honestly it was pricey for the options available. There was no fried rice, no corns as shown in previous photos.

The service was lacking. The lady took a while to come over to ask us if we needed more meat.

The broths were so bland, super diluted. I couldn't taste the sichuan flavor as it wasn't even spicy.

The food bar was very fresh. But the meats were alright.

Overall food was only worth $20 or less. I would only come for quick work lunch. I'm not sure how the dinner option look but we did have to get the dinner option for $28.

I went here for the lunch special and it was such a good deal! There are tons of soup bases to choose from and 4 meat options. I ended up trying both of the beef and the one pork option and they were all good. One beef was lean and the other was fatty. This place is on the smaller side but they had plenty of seafood, vegetable, and noodle options. There was even a small area for dessert. This time I went there was watermelon, coconut jelly (which was so good) and a Vietnamese dessert. There also had ice-cream cups for an additional charge. Our server was attentive but gave us space to enjoy our meal. I would come here again!

This was my first time trying Vietnamese style hot pot and I really enjoyed the concept.

We came in pretty late on a Friday night and were only the third party there. We went with Combo A for $27.99 (heads up, the prices currently shown on Yelp aren't updated).

For our broths, we tried the Szechuan, seafood, tom yum, and house broth. Having four different broths at the table was great because everyone could switch between completely different flavors throughout the meal.

The self serve bar had a big selection. There was tofu, plenty of vegetables, shrimp, squid, octopus, clams, mussels, imitation crab, and a lot more. The sauce bar also had pretty much all the staple sauces you'd expect. Honestly, making your own sauce was the best part.

The food itself was really good and everything from the bar seemed fresh. I wouldn't say the meat cuts were the highest quality I've had at a hot pot restaurant, but for the price and overall experience, more than good enough to leave with a satisfied appetite.

The staff was also really nice despite there being a bit of a language barrier. We were still eating about 10 minutes before closing, and not once did an employee make us feel rushed, they still felt welcoming.
Don't worry, we made it out before 10.

Overall, good food, tons of options, friendly service, and a fun concept. Definitely a place I'd come back to when I'm craving Vietnamese hot pot.

7.5/10

Food was just alright They have a transient issue in their parking lot and their employees say it is all the time. Not sure why owners/management are OK with it. Even 7-eleven addresses these issues in their parking lot. When we were leaving one of the transients was going to the bathroom against the trash bin enclosure in broad daylight with women and children around. Unacceptable!

Bo Nabe Shabu is definitely worth a visit! The ingredients were incredibly fresh, especially the beef and seafood, and the broth was rich, flavorful, and comforting. The restaurant was clean, modern, and had a welcoming atmosphere.

The staff was friendly, attentive, and made sure we had everything we needed throughout the meal. The all-you-can-eat selection offered plenty of choices, and everything was well stocked and fresh.

If you enjoy shabu-shabu or hot pot, I highly recommend Bo Nabe Shabu. Great food, excellent service, and a fun dining experience. I'll definitely be coming back!
everything here is so flavorful like their meat and broths. This place includes so many toppings plus free ice cream! Overall, the staff are so friendly and flexible
Good small seafood selection. Reasonable price for hot pot. Nice decor and clean inside. Service was a bit slow with only one person for lunch hour. But otherwise everything was tasty.

If you like all you can eat good food with reasonable price, come to this place in Garden Grove. 10 kinds of delicious broths with seafoods, beef, lamb, oxtail, and lots of veggies. Additionally, the sauces are special.
The owner and staffs are very friendly and nice. The service is fast. Come to enjoy.
This restaurant literally has the best hot pot i have ever had in my life. It is such an amazing deal too.

Ayce Menu A 25.95

Spot can be tricky to spot as it's tucked over by the corner.

Quality of the meats - 5/5
All were of great cut and not chewy at all.
Skipped the chicken so I can't give an assessment.

Pros - Had no problem asking for 8 plates of meats on the first round.

Everything was fresh at the seafood section.
Only thing missing from the bar was fried tofu.

Ladles and tongs are right by the bar which is nice.
Sauce Bar - 4/5
Had a lot of the essentials needed but caters more to the Vietnamese side.

Staff - Genuinely Attentive while stopping by several times (4) making sure everything was great. Ensured if additional plates of meats needed to be served.

Broth- 4/5
Needs some work as wasn't digging the collagen broth.
Overall , after all the cooking, the soup tends to get tastier.

Ordering process is straight forward and overall experience was great as I left fully satisfied in terms of appetite.

Rest rooms are clean.
I would comeback.

Delicious soup, fresh meat, good desert, and a lot of varieties. Chill atmosphere
Awesome service
Will come back
Underrated all you can eat hot pot. Great price , good meats and the best sauce selection I found in any hot pot place I been to. Service is always friendly.

great food. Service is awesome.

Very clean, also if you're a beer drinker, 1 free beer during happy hour.

Go there and come back and thank me.

If I live in OC I would come here to eat every week. I love the variety of vegetables, they even have bitter melon. The taro and pumpkin are so good. The dessert are good too. The lunch special is only $19.99 from 11 to 3. Kid is only $14.99. The place is clean and the staff is nice. Definitely will continue to come.

The service was very good. Took my mom here for a late mother's day and she was impressed. I like that they have crawfish. And mussels and clams. Their baby crabs are Much fresher than all the other hot pot places ive been too. Our server last night was sweet. Nice.. Thoughful and never got stressed. Although they dont have huge buffet section, i appreciate that they have enough of a selection for me to leave happy. I appreciated that they have meats that no other hotpot has. More adventurous meats I would say. Ive been eating japanese and korean hotpot for so long. As a vietnamese person, I love that they had beef stomach, bitter melon, tripe and that fatty beef cut at their buffet section that is usually in pho. I like that they are vietnamese and they know not to put too much food at the buffet at a time, which means, it isnt just sitting there all day. Their hot sauce collection is actually fire. and you have to try their XO sauce !! Their selection of different broths is larger than most places and isnt overly salty. I love that I couldnt even see the white rice or find it. And I love that they only really have tiny or small amount of noodles serving as if they know asians are going to try and stay away from the carbs until the end like asians do. lol. Out of the 10 hotpot places Ive been too between o.c. and l.a...... bo ne nabe is toe to toe with all that shabu" in irvine. I will return when I want to do vietnamese.
hotpot. Was going to gatekeep but my judgey vietnamese mom and I left very happy.
Good selection of beer and sake and soju as well... if I come during happy hour, im going to get in trouble with their free beer special. LOL. So happy we landed here
Vừa rẻ vừa ngon vừa bổ ăn xong sẽ trở lại và dài. Thank you ông chủ rất vui vẻ và nhiệt tình
Owner is super nice and goes to great length to provide good service and food quality to customers!
The hotpot here is so good. They have many kinds of meat I want to try. The waitresses are the best . Love this place
Good variety of fresh food, great service, and very reasonable prices. Owner is very hospitable. Will definitely be back.
Good food. Good service. We came here so many times . Seafoods are great . I love this place.
Solid hot pot spot! The soup base is authentic and rich. Everything from the veggies to the meat was fresh. Quick service and reasonable prices. I will definitely be back soon!
The food was really disappointing, the serving area was dirty, and they barely refilled the food. Definitely won't be coming back.
The second time I ate there was a big disappointment. Food was running out, and looked like old stuff from the freezer. Running out of desserts. Glasses were dirty! It tasted worse.

I feel like the past year or so has been quite a journey for seeking out the most affordable all-you-can eat hot pots that have a reasonable Lunch Special.

I started out with these places:

Shabuya $20.99
House of Shabu $21.99
Avenue Shabu $23.99
All That Shabu $29.99 (!!)

Bo No Nabe blew them all out of the water with their 19.99 lunch special! I especially love that they offer Szechuan broth, which is my favorite hot pot flavor. It was perfectly seasoned - not too spicy, not too salty, just really flavorful. They also had the meats I usually go for, like pork belly and toro, so I was happy right away.

They have a small seafood, veggie, and sauce bar, but it had everything I wanted, so no complaints there.

The restaurant itself is nicely decorated with a cozy atmosphere. The hot pot burners are separate units instead of built into the tables, which I actually didn't mind at all.

Overall, delicious food, friendly service, and plenty of parking. And with the lowest price I have found so far - definitely a spot I'd come back to.
Good food. Excellent service. Mom & pop establishment. Chill tropic edm. Would come back.

We came for the lunch special, which signs in the front say $19.99 including weekends and holidays. We go to sit inside and the menu lists the same lunch special. Our server said that it doesn't apply to weekends, so we left.
The food is amazing with affordable price!!! Highly recommend to come for their lunch price.

Love this place! My new favorite hot pot. Their broth options taste better than other places and they have a lot of sauce options. Their veggie options aren't as good as other places but I'll take great broth and sauces over that. They also have a grass jelly dessert and hot tea included. Definitely recommend!

Came back after last time I had good experience but this time it's odd. The broth doesnt taste like last time..flavor was lacking and I did tell the server, she added some more "crab" flavor in but still lacking. Last time we had 6 plates of meat, thjs time 9 plates and the server was not happy with it. Maybe it's the last time I come here again..
$33 per person add $10 more for 2 more broth. Came out nearly $100 (with tip) I think 9 plates of meat is not a problem? And how much customer eat is a problem? I don't think so.

The food was great and the price was also great too. There are a lot of varieties and the service was fast and always on point. The inside was decorated so nice and there are toys you can even buy too.
Affordable hot pot for ayce. My favorite broth there was the collagen and the miso broth. I love how their sauces were based off Vietnamese dipping sauces. My favorite meat was their toro

Nice new hot pot place in garden grove. Great deal on the lunch special which comes with 5 different meat selections, seafood and salad bar. Bonus on the dessert bar as well!

Staff was also very kind and attentive.

We were looking for a place to eat late into the night and found this on Google. Boy was it good!!!! It's all you can eat and they have different combos for anyone's budget. They were really nice and got us a table even though it was late but honestly we left stuffed silly on all the tasty food. It was so pretty with a clean interior and mood music. The servers were all helpful despite us ending our time a little after closing. We got the combo B and almost every meat we tried was a hit. They have so many options in broth, seafood, and veggies. Sidenote: I can't recommend the lemonade enough XD they also have a nice little punch card deal with a nice reward for when you hit 10 visits. We will be back for more in the future! Have patience the quality is worth it.

The variety was good, but they didn't stock up their cold food bar. A lot of the vegetables and seafood was low or empty. The sauce bar was also in the same state. Also, the servers were nowhere to be found when we wanted to order more meat. They had the gall to even ask for more tip after we made our payment. The parking is ample, but looks a bit sketchy due to its location. Its next to the restaurant and behind a lot of other shops. The store looked nice enough, but I think I was surprised at everything else to look at the decor.

Very disappointing experience. We visited around lunchtime, and my wife, who is pregnant, noticed a strange taste in the meat. I tried it as well and found it had an unpleasant smell and aftertaste.
We attempted to explain the issue to our server, but it seemed there was a language barrier, and our concern was not clearly understood. We asked if the dish could be replaced, but no action was taken.
After waiting about 10-15 minutes without any resolution, we decided to leave as we had lost our appetite. I still paid the bill with a tip, but I believe a manager should have stepped in to assist and address the situation properly.
Overall, this experience was frustrating and disappointing.

First time here. This place has a happy hour lunch special for under $20. You get your choice of broth, meats, and veggies. They sevrice they provide is okay. It does get busy here so you should come in early. They have plenty of tables and can accommodate larger groups.

A great hidden gem in the Garden Grove area! I was pleasantly surprised by their lunch special which was only $19.99 for AYCE hot pot, which is an amazing deal!!!

I went with the Tom Yum broth, and it was flavorful and satisfying. The meat quality was decent for the price, and the restaurant itself was very clean. They also have an AYCE self-serve bar stocked with veggies, sauces, tofu, noodles, and a variety of other items to customize your hot pot.

Service was generally fine, though we did have to ask a few times for additional meat. To be fair, we came right when they opened and were trying to make the most of the AYCE experience. It started off pretty quiet, but more people began coming in as it got closer to lunchtime.

Overall, I'd highly recommend checking this place out if you're in the area. It's an excellent value and definitely hits the spot. While the meat quality isn't on the same level as higher-end spots like Momo Paradise or other higher end hot pot spots, it's perfect if you're looking for a satisfying meal at a great price.

Plus, parking is easy since it's located in a plaza.

Knocked off one star only because the server was hidden in the kitchen multiple times even though it wasn't really busy either. She was sweet though but I did have to ask her multiple times to get the items. Overall, it's worth it though.
I thought it was alright, it felt like low quality hotpot compared to other places like dpot. however the price is cheap so i can't really complain.

Food

Seafood broth was the star. 4.7/5

House beef broth also excellent. 4.6/5

Service

4/5. Understaffed

Ambiance

4.5/5

This is my personal favorite hot pot place, for the price the flavor is excellent. A shame it wasn't crowded but Boiling Point (more like Mid Point) is always crowded in 2026.

I love hot pot, and this is honestly one of the best and most affordable AYCE shabu places I've been to. The broth options are great and have some really unique flavors. My favorites were the Bò no nabe and tomyum -- both were super flavorful and made the whole meal even better.

The meat selection is amazing, and the beef toro was definitely my favorite. It's so soft and tender, it practically melts in your mouth. They also have a great variety of sauces, so you can mix and match to create your own perfect dipping sauce.

My favorite drink there is the herbal tea, and the best part is that it comes with free refills, which is perfect with hot pot.

The lunch special is $19.99 for Combo A, which I personally think is already plenty. Even if you go for dinner, it's only around $25, which is still a great deal for AYCE. If you want a bigger variety of meats, there are other combo options available too.

The service was also very good -- staff were friendly, attentive, and made the dining experience even better.

To top it off, the grass jelly dessert was delicious and the perfect refreshing way to end the meal. If you love hot pot and want a great AYCE spot that's flavorful and affordable, this place is definitely worth checking out.

Very bad experience the beef have taste. And the server can't Understand anything. Very disappointing.
Never touch anything just 1beef to try and paid 40$ and left!!!! Never go in this place!!!

So we wanted seafood buffet tonight but my husband didn't want to drive all the way to Fullerton. We did a Yelp search and after about 30 minutes of calling around, we decided to try this restaurant out.

The place is small and appears to be family-owned. We went with Combo A since we don't eat much and that was plenty for us. It's about $25 per person before tax and tips. Although you can get up to 5 cuts of meat/protein, we didn't want anything other than the eye round beef. The sliced chicken was dark meat chicken so I didn't want any. My husband had a few slices of it. We told the server we didn't want the pork belly nor the el toro beef (too fatty for us).

The seafood and vegetables bar was plentiful. It had all the greens and veggies that I like (taro, squash, bamboo shoots, mushroom varieties, etc.), in addition to the fish, shrimp, clams, fish balls, fish tofu, egg, so that's plenty to choose from. Pay for what you eat, no need to pay extra for what you don't want.

I really like their mixed jello dessert drink. The jello has the perfect firmness.

Service was good. But the girl that served us never came back to offer us more meat after the first round (although we didn't really want more). The guy (owner?) came by to pick up the dirty dishes and asked if we wanted more meat. Told him maybe a couple slices of the lean beef but we didn't want a whole plate. So he brought out two thin, large pieces of beef, which was perfect.

Overall, it was good, nothing fancy as other shabu places I've been too, but that was fine for me because that's all I wanted to eat and there was more than enough.

Fresh and Delicious! What a great surprise. Our first time won't be our last! The buffet had so many fresh veggies, noodles and toppings. There was a sauce buffet also! The service was fantastic making sure all of our broth and glasses we're full. Absolutely delicious! You won't be disappointed!

Cute little restaurant with a great lunch deal. $20 for ayce lunch shabu. All the broths kind of tasted the same so I can't comment but the sauce bar was pretty stocked and had a little bit of everything.
Service was quick and efficient, ambiance was festive for the new years. I liked that they had some sweet things on the side for dessert like fruit and coconut jelly.

The meat was solid, for $20 bucks u can't beat it.

We came for Vietnamese hotpot for their AYCE lunch special, which is just $19.99! The small plaza this restaurant is in had plenty of parking and there was no wait when we arrived, though it filled up throughout the lunch hour.

FOOD:
They have a wide selection of veggies, noodles, etc in their buffet section. They also have plenty of variety to make your own DIY dipping sauce.

What I really liked was you can order one broth per person, so we were able to try four different broths at our table! They had a wide selection of broths from beef both broth to tom yum broth!

For the lunch special, you're limited to Combo A, which still has plenty of good options. The meat quality was really good for the price because it was a good balance of being fatty and lean. After our first round of orders, we quickly found our favorite ones to reorder.

SERVICE:
Service was great! When it became busier, we had to wave down our waitress a few times to place another order, but we always received our food quickly afterwards. They definitely don't skimp on portion sizes; we always received a healthy portion size of meat, so overall no complaints!

I would definitely visit again whenever I'm back in the LA area!
So good!! Food is fresh and tasty!!! Highly recommended for family!! Good for vegetarian as well!

My heart is one star, but I give two. 1. The corn tasted bad. It's a color that can't be eaten. I'll give you all the meat and the frozen meat that was cut and put in the freezer yesterday. The shrimp is placed without thathing. Kimchi and sauce all have no taste. There's nothing fresh, the interior is not good, and I don't think anyone will come again and again, and I don't understand why the star is 4.3. It has the merit of the price, so the taste is 1 point, but the real price is 2 points. And the T-ara song keeps repeating. I'm going crazy.

Vietnamese hot pot? Love it!
For dinner for the cheapest price is 25$ and having a choice of 5 meats for ACYE. I didn't need the fancy meats - I just need good broth, veggies and meat!

The star of the show here is having chao as a sauce choice!! I grew up eating chao and have never seen any restaurants have this option as a sauce.

Service was good - they are attentive and friendly.

We tried the tom yum and yamaki broth - highly recommend!!

This is a solid Viet hot pot spot in OC! We ordered Combo B and it was honestly the perfect amount, great variety without feeling overwhelming.

The AYCE bar is convenient with fresh veggies, seafood, noodles, and a full sauce station so you can customize everything exactly how you like it. I really like how it wasn't overly crowded like other hotpot spots (we came on a Saturday evening too). Everything was pretty clean, some ingredients were well stocked while others had to be replenished.

The broth paired so well with the meats from Combo B, and I really liked the tom yum broth because it was tangy! The balance of flavors made every bite comforting and satisfying. It's the kind of place that works for casual dinners, group hangouts, or when you're just craving something warm and cozy.

There were pretty few people in the restaurant when we went for lunch time around 2pm. Their prices at $18.99 per person for all you can eat hotpot can not be beat by anyone else but you get what you pay for. The meat, soup, and all the veggies almost felt like you could easily replicate this at home. There wasn't a wow factor that made me want to try it again. There was also only one girl working at a time so I did feel bad bother her for refills of meat. If you're looking for a cheap all you can eat hot pot that does the job, this place works. Otherwise, spend a little more money and skip it.

This place would have had 5 stars if the service was better. I had to flag someone to take my second order and the place was pretty empty.

What I like about this place is the broth flavors. It's really good and not bland at all. They also have chili pepper to make ur dipping sauce spicier.

Although, their dipping sauce is bland, if you add their special garlic oil, the sauces come to life.

The meat is average quality. They have all your veggies and they have ice cream as dessert !

I prefer this place over Oniku. I still prefer the shabu at Bella Terra but that's too far of a drive.

For the price and proximity, this shabu will now be my go to one.
I highly recommend this place. Their premiere package is a little pricey but worth it. The wagyu, fish and fried rice are amazing and of course, there's unlimited soft drinks.

this place was solid for $18 for ayce hot pot! the taste was pretty good for the signature & milk soup base. however, not sure if the oils of the hot pot made our stomach hurt after or just a combo of things, so just make sure not to overeat!

if you pay in cash, you can get 10% off your order. service: our servers were kind & checked in on us regularly!

there weren't too many people when we went so it was nice and cozy!
Got the combo A, AYCE. It's a great value with delicious meats. There's a wide variety in the veggie/seafood section that you can go grab on your own.

The service was terrible. There were four of us, and every time we ordered four meat plates (one for each person), the waitress only brought enough for one or two people. It felt like they didn't want to serve us properly, even though this is an all-you-can-eat hot pot . The waitress seemed to ignore us and avoided taking our orders, which made the experience very frustrating.

Although the price is only $19, I would rather pay a few more dollars to eat at a restaurant with good service. To make matters worse, my friends ended up having stomach pain after eating there.

Overall, very disappointing experience.
So good!!! The staff is super friendly and so helpful sauces and veggies are so yummy, our waitress was so sweet and showed us all the best meats and broths we will be back!

Came In on a Monday with my bf. Food was great I love that you can serve your own sauce, veggies and seafood. I was craving soup all week and this really hit the spot. Meat was delicious combined with sauces and veggies. Service was great and attentive. Great price for a great meal. Ice cream after really hit the spot. It's also super clean and Christmas vibes, cute for pictures & vibey. We will be coming again
Great selection of seafood and vegetables. Drinks and ice cream included. Excellent customer service.
Everything was good! The food was amazing along with fantastic service! 10/10 would recommend to anyone who's looking to bring their loved ones! A hearty meal you will never forget

Im not sure if I just came on an off day because others seem to really enjoy this spot- but I was ultimately disappointed. The price of this place is pretty affordable so I guess you get what you pay for.

The szechuan broth and tom yum broth was lacking flavor, I had to add a bunch of seasoning to make up for it. I wish i took a picture of it, but the szechuan was missing its signature red color and peppers and just looked bland. There is a variety of toppings but could be better options available. There were only a few noodle options available as well. The hot bar section looked like it has been sitting out. The complimentary lemonade or orange was also not that good. They give out free Walmart branded ice cream. The first round of meats we received were reallly good! However the next few plate were tiny piece of meat that disappeared in the soup?

Nonetheless the service was super nice and made up for the experience. This place is just OK in my book. I also found it interesting they give you a discount if you zelle them.

Arrive for an early dinner with friends and the staff was able to accommodate us before a large group were to come in. Staff was more than helpful in making sure we were good on our proteins and soup bases. Great selection of vegetables and proteins to choose from. Restaurant was very loud once the place filled up.

Came in on a Sunday afternoon with my son, and it was not so busy. We did Menu B. My son had miso and I did house special soup. My soup was bland and I had to add more spices to make it more flavorful. They had herbal tea, orange juice and lemonade free.

Meat quality is better than Shabuya.
Customer service was friendly.
Recommen cho những người muốn ăn lẩu với giá phải chăng. Có lunch specials lúc 11h. Phục vụ thân thiện dễ thương lắm nhaaa.

Finally got to try this place. Went here for early lunch. They open early 10:30am & we were the first one there. This place is fairly new, just open six months ago according to the owner.

First of all, the price!!! 10/10 for weekdays $18.79 from 10:30 to 3pm. The buffet tables are more than enough for me. Seafood & vegetables are what I was looking for. Beef tripes & jumbo shrimps were perfect. I wish they have green onion for my sauce :-( the soups broth were good. I had the spicy one & my son had the original. Both were great.

I would definitely coming back here & bring friends before they change the price Dunno how they can make money with this pricing. lol

Yes!! Highly recommend this place.
Been here for the first time and very satisfied. The food was good and clean. The service so friendly specially Tina so kind to us. Will come back for another day
Need to put out a bigger spread of food for the buffet. There were very limited options for the salad bar.
