For all you Shabu lovers & enthusiasts like me, Bò no Nabe is a different place to try, but it's not a memorable wow place. The bestie wanted to try somewhere new with our families after a fun-filled pickleball Saturday, so we Yelp found this spot.

Located on the far right side of the Hanmi Plaza on Garden Grove Blvd, it's a quaint Shabu joint with a basic exterior, but once you go inside, it's more lively with Japanese inspired decor. It has a spacious seating area with the buffet style bar along the far middle wall. A sauce bar lies besides it to the left. They even have an ice cream freezer with ice cream sandwiches for dessert. The staff was very attentive, however, don't expect them to clear up your table from empty dishes while you eat. Ours kept piling up and we had to collect them to one corner of the table. The staff was easy to flag down for more meat orders and/or drink refills though.

The prices are decent for AYCE, but you pay for what you get, as the meats are really thinly sliced. They fall apart on the tray when you try to pick them up with chopsticks. I did like that you can choose up to 4 broths ~ which we settled on the Bo no Nabe House, Tom Yum, Miso & Yamaki. My favs out of the bunch was the Tom Yum (which was a lil sour & spicy) & Yamaki (which was a Yamaki Mentsuyu with teriyaki paste). If you are like me..you are like huh?..I had to google it too, it's ok lol but apparently Yamaki Mentsuyu is a popular, concentrated Japanese noodle soup base (dashi) known for its rich, savory-sweet flavor from high-quality bonito flakes (katsuobushi), soy sauce, mirin, and kombu. The burners took a hot minute to heat up our broths, a huge contrast to those built-in table shabu stoves at most places..so sucks if you are hangry. Lol..gotta wait! Having dined at many of good Shabu spots all across OC, the buffet bar is pretty minimal here. The veggie & seafood selection is ok, not great. The staff did do a good job at restocking the bar, but it isn't as fresh as you'd expect. I didn't try it, but they had like 3 items on their prepared mini-bar ~ fried rice, a ramen bag, & a fried item that I couldn't make out. To conclude the meal, if you are craving sweats, there was some fruit (watermelon), almond jello and a grass jelly with basil seeds ché. The sauces were ok, even the best attempt of my concoctions couldn't make it close to my bomb secret sauce at All that Shabu.

All in all, try Bò no Nabe if you want something new & different, but IMO, there are plenty others in the area that might be more supreme.

Update! I initially gave this Shabu place 3 stars, but had to decrease to 2 because shortly after eating here, I developed a pounding headache..which is my personal trigger when there is a high content of MSG in the foods I consumed. I have no qualms about using some, if needed when you cook, but after a certain threshold, my headaches tell-all..so if you are sensitive as well. Heads up. :/
Very good food and service! I love it. I recommend the prime beef. Get lots of that. There's alot of extra stuff you can add and get yourself, too.
First time customer and i was not disappointed! So super good, service was awesome and definitely picky eater friendly too! Loved everything and the environment was super great.

Went here to try their lunch special for $19. I loved that they opened at 1030am. My daughter still takes a nap so it's hard for me to get lunch foods around her nap and before picking up my older kids from school.

We walked in a couple minutes after 1030am and it was clearly a shock to the hostess. They were still getting things set up and going but I didn't mind it. The restaurant was clean and open. It felt welcoming.

The lunch special comes with choice of broth and 5 meat options. There was a big sauce bar that my husband loved and many buffet options with fruit, noodles veggies, seafood, and even some cooked beef. I ate more items from the buffet than meat ordered.

This hot pot is more Vietnamese flavors. We tried the signature broth and spicy suchan. The signature was really good. My daughter was just drinking it as a soup. The spicy suchan wasn't great. My husband added a lot of sauces to it to customize for himself. I wanted to try the hot and sour (tom yum) but we were only allowed 2 broths. I'll try it next time.

We were there for 90 minutes and were the only customers the whole time. Makes me think the earlier opening won't last long but I'll enjoy it while I can.

Good selection of meats (seafood and beef are my favorites) and all the usual vegetables you expect at ayce hot pot. Four broths to choose from. I chose the #1 and it was good. I don't know about the others. Good value for the lunch special. I'll be coming back.

This place is a hidden gem for your hot pot needs. I would highly recommend the is spot to anyone. Especially during the lunch hour $18.99 per person is amazing! They have open sauce bar, seafood, and veggies too! Staff is really nice and attentive. I been here multiple times and never been disappointed.
5/5

Meats were fresh and good. Some extra veggie like young mustard green beside bok choy and Napa cabbage. Service was also good for a small restaurant, not top notch but got what I asked for fairly quickly. I think I found my to go to for soupy meals with AYCE meat and veggie for under $20.

I love this viet hot pot joint. You pick your meat plan. There's a bar to pick your veggies/seafood, make your own sauce (i make my special garlic/tahini/cilantro/hot sesame oil), refill your own drink (nuoc mat is chrysanthemum tea, so refreshing). The black jelly is perfect. The first ice cream sandwich is free.

@coffeeshopsofoc follow for more

We checked out Bò No NaBe in Garden Grove and it was such a good time. The setup is super easy and you get four different broths that keep getting refilled so you never run out of anything. The broth choices all had their own flavor and it was fun switching between them while everything cooked.

The seafood and meat selection was fresh and they bring it out fast. We ordered a bunch of different things and everything came out clean and well prepped. The noodles and veggies were perfect for filling the table and it all cooks right in front of you so you can make it exactly how you like it.

The place is casual and the staff was really friendly. They checked on us often without being too much. It's one of those spots where you end up staying longer because you're just comfortable and having a good time cooking and eating. I would definitely go back, especially with a group.

3.5 but rounding up for the service workers!

Your small, family owned and no frills hot pot spot.

3 menu tiers, starting at around $25 per person.

Decent broth selection, but nothing stood out.

The self service bar was sparse, but carried your typical hot pot veggies, variety of balls and carbs. The sauce bar though was lacking. Note: there is a small "hot foods" bar by the drinks and the stir fry corn was so good!

If you're not up for the wait at other spots, give them a try. They're doing their best but there's always room for quality improvement.

Parking can be tight since it is a very large plaza with MANY other eateries.

I like that they give you four broth without any extra charge. All the broths are really good I've tried almost all of them, and they're full of flavor. My only gripe is that the beef quality is just okay, and I really wish they served beer. Oh yeah, they open late which is really nice

Yes we were there 5 people and have 3 shrimps left over in the pot
Waitress want to charge us 15% surcharge for left over food.
We waited to talk the the owner or store manager but no one was available

We had no choice but have to pay for the 15% surcharge according to the waitress Nhien

Then later she came and told us "good news, the owner checked the camera and ok to wait the 15% surcharge "
It's the first time and will be our last visit!

I'm the typical hot pot type of person that goes to Broth is what I want to start off by saying but today my wife was sick and wanted to try something near so we branched away from our usual.

Broth has variety while broth is limited regardless of that don't let it deter you from coming here because for the price, you're getting a fair amount of choices. We opted for combo A because we mainly like beef and it was pretty good for the price. (Side note if you pay cash or Zelle, they give you a 10% discount)

I forgot to take pictures of the sides bar, but they had a pretty good variety there too from shrimp, beef/fish balls, lettuce, cabbage, mushrooms, different sauces etc.

I want to give a big shoutout to our server Nhien who was attentive to us because as the saying goes, You can always order more and not order less (they add a 15% Surcharge for wasted food) because me and my wife were ordering maybe 2-3 plates of meat every time she visit and I for sure ate about 10 plates. So once again, thanks for your patience and attentiveness.

Im going to give it a 5 because I was happy but initially opted to give it a 4 because it didn't have the variety I wanted such as kaarage or rice but I was happy and won't dock it from them.

Came in for the hot pot lunch special and you truly get what you pay for. It's a deal, but don't expect the world.

For the hot pot, the first round they bring you out all the meats for you to try. I would say if you're willing to shell our $5-10 more go somewhere else. The sauce bar is messy (sauce dribbles everywhere, limited options), the vegetables look a little wilted or cut a couple days ago, the meat is average, and the staff is just running around trying their best to handle the volume.
từ trước tới giờ chưa ăn quán lẩu nào ngon như ở đây, rất ngon, thịt tươi, nhân viên dễ thương, thân thiện, lựa chọn tốt nhất, mãi ủng hộ quán
Đồ ăn rất ngon , các anh chị phục vụ rất dễ thương và thân thiện . Thịt tươi , giá phù hợp , có kem miễn phí nếu đi buổi tốiii

We've been here twice. We had the AYC lunch. Really great price! Very nice atmosphere, cute and clean. Meat is excellent, tender and flavorful and the variety of dipping sauces is amazing-love, love the Szechuan! The vegetable/fish bar is extensive, clean and fresh. First time we went they also had a fried rice and a corn salad but they didn't have it the second time and same for tofu. Staff was friendly and attentive but got a little ignored on the second visit. Well worth the price and we'll be coming back.

All-you-can-eat hotpot! The service was great, and the broth was delicious. The beef was great, and the veggies, seafood, and sauces were all tasty too. Even though the restaurant was short-staffed, they managed the crowd really well and kept things running smoothly. Very kid-friendly with a nice family atmosphere.

This place went beyond my expectation. The food was nice good, definitely worth 19 dollars for a AYCE lunch. We came on a monday morning and the service was really nice. The server was prepared to take order and always make sure we're comfortable. The music being played fit the cozy atmosphere of this place. Would definitely recommend.

I took my good friend here for a Happy Belated Birthday Lunch. It was our 1st time dining here. It was delicious! Price was good. Food even better! I will be back and recommend this place to everyone.
Great hotpot. Much to try. God broth. Fresh meat. Dipping sauce are perfect. Parking Easy to access

The staff and management are very friendly. They offer unlimited food, including seafood, and the price is reasonable for an all-you-can-eat restaurant. They also have a stamp card program, where you receive a free combo after collecting ten stamps. I highly recommend this restaurant.

everyone is very nice and sweet : the food is top notch .
Very good and friendly ambiance .
Clean - highly recommended

Beef is fresh, and the food comes out really fast. The portions are generous, and everything tastes flavorful and well-cooked. The service is friendly and efficient too. Definitely a great spot for a quick and satisfying meal, I'll be coming back for sure!

I ate at Bo Nabe and the soup was really just right -- not salty at all. The ingredients were super fresh too, so everything tasted clean and light. I left feeling full but not heavy. I'd go back for sure.
Awesome food. Awesome service. Awesome prices. HIGHLY RECOMMEND. There broths were super flavorful.

I gave four stars because the staffs are nice and friendly. To be honest, the food quality and ambience are just meh.
Nothing really special about this place that makes it unique. The broth itself is not too flavorful like at hot pot places that I've been to.
I feel like this place has a lot of potential, but they just don't deliver it in terms of quality and variations.
Parking is plenty in the plaza and easy access.

I was craving sushi and saw this place was open, so I pulled over.

Unfortunately my experience was extremely poor, in fact I walked out.

The place was empty at 1 PM on a Tuesday which by itself is a bad sign. The interior is modern, black, grim and not very appetizing... There's all sorts of electronic devices I guess you're supposed to order from.

When I asked to be seated... With a bored-looking chef staring at me and another guy on his cell phone,...a young waiter took me to be seated.

The place was completely vacant but he insisted that I sit at a very isolated table.

Then, the menu - - it's certainly confusing and lots of rules about this and that.

All I wanted was some basic sushi but it seemed that the only option was all you can eat. I don't know, maybe not - - but I was so irritated already I didn't bother figuring it out.

I just got up and left and told them I was not impressed with their restaurant. Poor service, confusing menu. I just drove down the street to the fantastic Matsu Japanese restaurant, super friendly, busy, beautiful decor. Yummy and not at all expensive... Although I probably spent as much there as I would have at Aura with their all you can eat option.

Anyway, I guess I have Aura to thank for leading me to a better place. Good luck.
Not too special but pretty good in general. Pretty affordable for both sushi and hot pot. The servers are friendly, nice, helpful. Each table has its own tablet to order, so it's very convenient.

I came here with my boyfriend for dinner on a Tuesday night and was seated immediately. There was a lot of seating inside and outside! the outside had cute lanterns and a pretty cherry blossom tree, which definitely added to the vibes. The staff was extremely accomodating and kind, and they explained how the different menus worked. We got the omakase experience, which was an AYCE sushi and hotpot set! The sushi was fresh and delicious, and the hotpot was really good too.

I'd definitely comeback next time with a big appetite!

Roomy interior. Way too many rules, too many limits (2) often it's on what you actually want. Too many price models but no where on the menu lists dinner price for Tuesday. The weekend and holiday dinner price is plastered every where though.

Any meats you actually want is on the premium menu.

Hot pot bar is a joke. Only 1 choice of green vegetable (bok choy). Unless you count corn and mushrooms.

A 1 piece sashimi took 15 minutes. They service time is how they get you.

Go to the Hot Pot at Bella Terra up the street for twice the variety without all the limits of 2-4.
My first time here honesty amazing place love the food love the sushi , come and visit is amazing
Won an Instagram giveaway that allowed me to try the Omakase! The sushi was very good and loved that you can do hot pot and sushi all together. Enjoyed the Mala soup and staff was nice and friendly!

Our family was craving hotpot and sushi, so a combo restaurant seemed like a good compromise? Unfortunately I have to say Aura doesn't do either of them well. We ordered the non premium menu and felt the selection was enough but nothing was great.

We were tired of the sushi after the first round. The fish didn't taste particularly fresh. We had one salmon roll where it was an overwhelming amount of rice and cucumbers and a speck of salmon. The California rolls had too much mayo. We ordered a dynamite and it was a hot mess with way too much sauce.

The hotpot was okay. I feel the self serve station of vegetables was pretty small. There was also shrimps available but they were small and didn't look appetizing. There were decent selection of meats to choose from the menu but we only stuck with beef belly. The beef broth was a little salty and didn't have depth.

I don't know, for $45 per person it didn't feel like a quality dining experience. You're just eating just for the sake of eating. Nothing was particularly enjoyable. Not worth the fake paid social media hype.

Honestly with any place that does sushi/hotpot or hotpot/bbq never really do either well. We got the omokase set and the omokase sushi was actually delicious, I'll give them that. The other sushi you order was decent. The peppered salmon, mackerel, and carpaccio were the stand outs. Hot pot was very lack luster. We got the spicy tofu and bone broth and both were okay at best. Meats for hot pot were decent but the sauce and hot pot bar were kind of sad. Decent sushi and sub par hot pot.

Service on the other hand was really good in the beginning. Halfway through our meal it felt like they forgot about us. Mind you, there were only three other tables in the restaurant. They would walk past us multiple times without saying anything...

Thus restaurant probably would be better as just a sushi place

I've been coming to the physical location since it was Sakura which I often visited with large groups. It became Slice which was a great go-to for lunch dates.. and really wanted to love Aura. But, the main down sides were.. they didn't offer split shabu pots. THATS JUST CRAZY especially for being a shabu restaurant. You have tables of 6 with 3 burners, single pots.. how are you able to accommodate different dietary restrictions or preferences??? My family and in laws LOVES AYCE and they would be regulars here but the only thing that holds us back is the single pots. Also be warned, their veggie/sauce bar was sub par. Didn't even have carrots or trays to carry back all the condiments. You'll need to make a couple of trips to carry tiny dishes/bowls back. Plus side, appetizer and sushi/rolls were quite tasty! It's worth $30 for their lunch option without omakase. I'd probably go back, but just with 1 person. My main 2 suggestions: add split shabu pots and add more veggie selections then you'd have more foot traffic.

The NEWEST ayce in HB - sushi AND hot pot! Went with the omakase menu and my favorites were the yellowtail and salmon belly. The two broths I tried were sukiyaki and beef bone broth. You order on the iPad then it has a 5 minute timer until you can place another round in. Friendly and attentive staff. Went on a Saturday night and got seated immediately. They offer outside patio as well!

Overall, the experience was decent but I felt the price was a little high for what was offered. The meat was average; it had decent marbling, but at this price point, I expected slightly better quality. The broth was good overall, although I thought the seasoning was a little too subtle. A bit more seasoning would have helped bring out the flavors. The hot bar was probably the most disappointing part of the experience. There weren't many items or add-ons to choose from, so the selection felt somewhat limited. The sushi however was quite good. We especially enjoyed the carpaccio and several of the rolls, including the yellowtail jalapeño roll. Those were some of the highlights of the meal. Overall it's a decent place with some good menu items, but I think the value could be better considering the price. Parking can also be a bit of a hassle depending on when you visit.

I went here last night with my date, and was impressed with the service and the quality of the food..

I did feel bad that it was a slower night for business. We were one of four tables, but it was a Monday night after all.

The staff was attentive and checked on us frequently. The hot pot was better than I expected. The suggested combination of spicy and umami broth was a great combination. It was the last dish that we ate and I was so stuffed that I couldn't finish. I did want to continue eating, because the taste was so good.

The photos didn't do it justice, but I will be sure to have the hot pot earlier in the meal, so I can finish it completely.

I am already looking forward to returning. It wasn't cheap and cost, but we got our moneys worth.

Tried the Omakase menu at Aura Sushi & Hot Pot . The sushi was our favorite, everything was fresh and we really enjoyed the variety! The hot pot comes with different broth and ingredient options, so you can customize your pot with whatever you're craving.

A fun spot to check out when your group wants a little bit of everything!

What we ordered:
-Omakase Menu: bluefin tuna, black cod, yellowtail belly, salmon belly, bluefin tuna belly, red shrimp, kanpachi, aji, halibut, japanese scallop, oyster
-Carpaccio: tuna, salmon, yellowtail
-Shishito Pepper
-Spicy Crispy Tuna Rice
-Hotpot: mala, sukiyaki, premium brisket, chuck tender, top blade, chuck eye

The omakase AYCE offering was delicious. It's been a while since I have AYCE sushi given most of the time the quality is as you would expect.... Average!
However, here the AYCE sushi was delicious and the variety was impressive. Of note the black cod and hamachi belly!!!!!

Try this place

the Server garcia was very nice and the meat quality was fair for the price, the ambiance was nice and as for the shabu I really enjoyed the shrimp broth apposed to the beef and the buffet style veggies, sushi and sauces were very convenient!

If you can't decide whether you want sushi or hot pot, this is the place for you.

They have the premium and omakase ayce options (lunch starts at $29.99 for premium and $39.99 for omakase).

They have a self-serve sauce and hot pot toppings bar. You can order everything through the ipads on the tables.

Quality is good and you have a large variety to choose from.

Lots of parking available.

We came here as a party of four and really wanted to like it. The concept of having all-you-can-eat sushi and hot pot together is great, but unfortunately our experience afterward was not.

The food smelled and tasted fine while we were eating, but later that night all four of us had upset stomachs, and the stomach issues continued into the next day. Since every person in our party experienced similar symptoms after eating here, it definitely raised concerns for us about the food.

The restaurant also wasn't very busy when we went, so I do wonder about the turnover and freshness of the fish and other ingredients. Of course, I can't say for certain what caused our stomach issues, but having all four of us feel sick afterward was enough that we wouldn't return.

It's also quite pricey for an all-you-can-eat restaurant. The concept has a lot of potential, but unfortunately, based on our experience, it wasn't worth the price or feeling sick afterward.

First time going to an ayce that had both hot pot and sushi! We went for lunch and decided to get their omakase that had 8 different premium nigiris to try. Very pretty and melts on the tongue. They also have different cuts of meat to choose for your hot pot as well. The food was very filling and we ended the meal with some mochi ice cream.

service was okay.. the manager was really intense and kinda scary LOL, my server was super sweet tho! (tatted guy with piercings and glasses i think! very helpful) the sushi was good, nothing crazy special but it was good. the eel was okay, salmon was good! the pepper salmon was also good but a little too much of the chili oil or whatever it was. the hot pot meats were ok, soup broth was also ok, overall.. ok haha. the price was quite expensive for what it was tbh, it was like $45 a person before tax and tip.

ordering on the kiosk was a pain, the tablet wasn't working at first and had to be switched, idk if the switch messed stuff up but they missed some things and it never came out so we gave up bc reordering was a hassle with the 5min timer. you can only order every 5 min which i get to an extent if people spam and over order, BUT really frustrating bc you have to bulk order at once, so the wait between food was longer. there were times we had gaps where we weren't eating at all and just waiting.
salad and sauce bar was limited, some things also weren't well stocked or seemed that fresh. sauces were good tho! idk i prob wouldn't come back tbh tho

If it is a first time experience like it was for my husband and me. Definitely have your server walk you through the menu because you order your meat and sushi off the a tablet which was a bit confusing to us at first.

The place is nice and clean. And the server was super sweet. She was willing to answer all our questions and was very accommodating.

When you do the hot pot, you grab your own veggies and sides from the little buffet near the door. (I would've given this place 5 stars... however the things in the cold buffet bar didn't look as fresh as I expected)

My husband and I each got a different flavor broth for our hot pot. I got the bone broth and he got the spicy one. The bone broth was soooo delicious, I definitely recommend that if you want something simple.

The sushi that was served was pretty fresh. We both loved the nigiri selection that they had and they were all so tasty.

We would definitely go again.

Got the Premium Menu AYCE. Everything was good. The beef that I tried were tender. However, compared to the last 2 Hot Pot restaurants I tried, the beef at ASAHP could have used more beef flavor. A pleasant surprise was that shrimp was available at the self serve bar. It would have been nice if they had Shacha sauce as an option in their sauce bar. For my first round of Nigiri, there was a brown sauce on top of the fish. For subsequent orders, I informed one of the staff members to omit the brown sauce. For the sushi, it was of average AYCE quality, texture, flavor and fish to rice ratio. Service was very helpful and attentive. I went on a Saturday around noon time and did not have issues with parking.

Such a fun spot for a sushi and hot pot gathering!

They offer omakase starting at $39.99, which includes unlimited sushi and unlimited hot pot. If you want something more simple, unlimited sushi + hot pot starts at just $29.99!The outdoor patio is beautiful, and there's also a cozy indoor dining area. Great deal for the area!

IG: socalhkfoodies

This place has so many ads on social media and influencers who more than likely were paid to promote the business. It's funny how all the comments on their ads are by bots. Every customer that I know that has dined here say don't waste my money. Aura, why are social media influencers saying one thing but real, regular everyday customers saying another?

Very very small selection of hot pot ingredients and a short list of meats that were all tough. Flavors of the soup were so so, the sushi was lower than average but I descent selection of sushi but the quality of sushi was also so so. The service was extremely slow and no one ever checked on us and we had to ask repeatedly for our water and iced tea to be refilled.

With all the other hot pot restaurants in the area they need to up their game to stay in business I think. As it is now I would not consider going back, especially with the poor quality service and lower quality food selection. The service was the kicker for me that makes it so I won't go back or recommend this place to friends or others.

Came here a week ago and I think this place is definitely worth a visit if you enjoy hotpot and sushi. The reason I gave them a 3 star is because the some of the raw fish was fishy and when I order plates if meat for the shabu they do not bring the amount you order. I would order 4 plates of beef belly and 4 plates of brisket and they would only bring 2 of each. Which is a pretty disappointing.

The service is good and wait staff were pretty attentive. Ambiance is nice but a little dark.

I might go back but as of right now I will still pay a little more for other places that have more selections.

Unfortunately it didn't meet our standards. The omakase was just ok, and the hotpot was also just ok. Very limited selection and taste was just not there. Service is very backed up, I don't think we'd be coming back. It used be a hotpot place called slice and it was very good! But hopefully in time they get better with the demand & service.

Also! Beware this morning as I checked my bank statement. I was charged $20 more than what it was. We tipped in cash, and still got charge 18% tip. We will be calling the bank to dispute it.

TERRIBLE!!!!

EXTREMELY worth your money, they have AYCE sushi, hotpot, and omakase, and they do it well. my favs were the crispy philly roll, hotpot, salmon and tuna nigiri from the omakase and more. BTW: if you don't like wasabi, ask to remove it from the omakase set (it's good either way but all up to preference!).

not too mention their music taste is amazing and it's a whole vibe when you eat there :) they are also right next to brew story, the best spot to get full after a sweet treat! thanks aura for the good grubs!

The food tasted amazing. This place definitely provided my moneys worth. The only reasons why I didn't provide 5 stars was because I ordered things early and some took a while to come so I thought they were missed. Also I wanted to purchase another pot of broth to cook because my son doesn't like it when I cook things that he doesn't eat in the same pot. I was told it was 1 pot for 2 ppl, so I'm not sure if the worker didn't understand that I was willing to pay for another pot. I had to wait until my son was doing eating from the pot so that I could cook my hot pot items.

Restaurant need to fix their AC. We were sweating even before our pots came in. We had to take our 6 month old back in the car cause she was sweating. Staff were also sweating. They are also clearly understaffed, kudos to the staff they currently have running around trying their best. Food was good, restaurant is spacious and concept got the attention of the crowd as there was a line. Management needs to do better for this restaurant to succeed.

Waited total of 1 hour to get in, even though there were extra table we, were told to wait only 8-10 minutes ended up an hour before we just left, since many people did too after waiting too long and weren't able to enter, regardless of a lot of empty seats inside the store. And other people waited almost 2 hours and what the store claimed was short staff, therefore can't be seated. I wouldn't recommend this place if you want to wait 2+ hours like the other guy said.

Servers were nice and attentive, and we went with the regular AYCE option. The sushi was better than some of the other AYCE sushi spots around the area, and everything came out pretty quickly. We went on a weekday when it wasn't very crowded, so that probably helped with the fast service.
The sushi selection was pretty decent, and they also offer an Omakase option for an extra $10. We weren't hungry enough to upgrade, but for the price, the regular AYCE was pretty good.
For the hot pot, there were only three meat options available: brisket, beef belly, and pork belly. I'd recommend ordering a few portions of each because you only get a couple pieces per order. There were two of us, and we ordered two portions of each meat, but still ended up needing to order more. The hot pot bar selection was pretty limited, but it had enough to do the job.
Overall, I'd recommend Aura Sushi & Hot Pot if you're looking for a combination of sushi and hot pot. Just keep in mind that they have a 90-minute time limit, so I'd recommend ordering as much as you can upfront to make the most of your time.
For the price, I'd definitely come back.

Overall: 3.8/5

First, some house rules... 90 minutes all you can eat. Order as much as you want at a time, but wait 5 minutes between orders. All orders are on an iPad at the table . You can upgrade to the Omakase Nigiri and premium hot pot meats which includes things like Toro for sushi and sliced ribeye for meats. Omakase Nigiri is not a part of the all you can eat menu so you only get it once.

We did not get the Omakase. The sushi is what you'd expect from any all you can eat place in terms of quality. There are good pieces and okay pieces. I thought the fish to rice ratio was fair and not trying to stuff you with rice. There's a wide variety of things including many cooked items, rolls, and carpaccios (limit as well). As for the hot pot, it's more shabu-shabu than hot pot if you know the difference. We got the beef bone broth which had good flavor. The meats were good, but a lot of the regular menu cuts are on the fattier side. They also have a vegetable and sauce bar that's self-serve.

The service was good and the staff worked hard running food and keeping your table clear. We went on a Sunday evening and it wasn't very busy. The hot pot meats came very quickly and sushi as expected took a little longer but came in reasonable time. However, it does feel like their system may not be built to take a large rush unless they staff more.

Overall, do we think it was worth it? Yes, absolutely. There's a lot of variety and the quality is good enough all around. We will definitely back and try the Omakase menu.

Came back bc my family was in town and they remember this place. If you don't do the $50 omakase, idk what you're doing

Service was great bc I messed up on the iPad so she hand wrote my first order. Salad dishes are smaller (good for us) so you can order more stuff. There's the veggie and seafood bar or now which was nice.

They started my raw fish again without issue and even did it for my mom!

AYCE sushi and hot pot. Both the sushi and the hot pot are delicious. I paid $59 for the Omikase option which was worth it between the Omikase sushi and the Omikase level hot pot meats. The options are great and the sushi is soo good. The hot pot broth was really good I got the bone broth. The restaurant has a great feel though I will say the music was a little loud. The restaurant is big with plenty of seats and the staff were all super friendly and the service was great!
Worst ayce, rice is dried out, wasabi is dried out and looks like sand. Rolls fall apart when you try to pick a piece up. Veggies for shabu look old dried out and sad.

We absolutely LOVE the new hot pot place! This location took over one of our favorite hot pot spots, so we were a little nervous at first, but we are so happy we gave it a try!

The all-you-can-eat options are amazing, the food is fresh, and there's such a great variety for the whole family. Everything was delicious, and the service was wonderful.

Our family comes here about once a month, and we can already tell this is going to become our new favorite family tradition.

If you love hot pot, you definitely need to give this place a try! We'll definitely be back! the service is outstanding!
Amazing. Super fresh and delish. I suggest the house broth. The apps were amazing. Our server was super sweet. Also suggest getting very little in your soup bowl to start.
Delicious sushi, good selection, very fresh! The staff were fast and helpful and good prices!
The quality is excellent for the price, and I'm very satisfied with the variety of sushi available.

Weekend pricing starts at $50 per person ($60 for premium menu) not include drink.
Order in the iPad at the table. Can order every 5 minutes. Some dishes are good, some are not. Eel roll and other baked roll were good. I wasn't loving the sashimi. Tuna sashimi was good. Others not so much (albacore). I can't taste the freshness. Spicy tuna wasn't spicy at all.
Hotspot wasn't take good.
Each table can get 2 flavor hotspot. We got dashi and mala. Dashi flavor was just ok, not much flavor there Didn't like mala at all, it has the after taste that none of us likes. Maybe an acquire taste for someone else. We each got 1 bowl of soup and that's it. Overall I am not too sure if it's worth it the price. Maybe during weekend lunch when they have cheaper pricing.
Friendly staffs and fast service. New restaurant, clean bathroom.

I made 3 visits to Aura before leaving this review and I'm a huge fan because they serve my two favorite foods in the world: sushi and hot pot. We always get the sukiyaki broth because we love the sweet and savory flavor profile. All the meats are thin and delicious, but you'll get a thicker cut with the bulgogi. Highly recommend upgrading to the premium menu though because you'll get the omakase experience - it's delicious! Service has always been kind, but requires some patience when the crowd picks up. Compared to when they first opened, I see improvements and you can even order your food on a tablet now and some items are self-serve to keep you happy while you wait on the kitchen. Totally worth giving a try!
This place is delicious. The service is incredible. They have amazing staff and food. Sushi and hot pot is crazy. Their music is bopping. So clean inside.
has to the the worst sushi, and shabu. makes me realize all you can eat is not the best. also my friend had the runs about 30ish min into our meal after consuming sushi.

The service was friendly, the food is delicious, the place is very clean. Entrance from the road is a bit confusing because it was right next to a plaza but parking spaces are not shared. Good that customer are more likely to find a space but good luck if you missed the entry way. Recommend this place and we shall return!!

Plenty of parking.

Indoor and outdoor seating. Also a great place to watch sports.

We went with the premium menu. It's unlimited ordering. We got the Sukiyaki and Mala soup base. Both soup base were good. Small basic meat selections and sides.

They have discontinued the Volcano Hot Pot.

IMO this spot is only worth the money if you eat sushi. My husband really enjoyed the AYCE sushi.

Overall, the meal was great! The Mala broth could have been a bit spicier, and having a wider variety of side dishes for the soup would have made the experience even better. We especially appreciated the quick and friendly service from Josh and Cathy. They were attentive and made our visit very enjoyable.
2nd time coming back. The food is delicious. Genuinely an amazing experience. The environment is beyond welcoming. Seriously one of the best in HB

Came here 11:50 am expecting the restaurant to be ready come to realize we have to wait with plenty of table available in the midst of a holiday weekend your restaurant isn't ready to accommodate people are you an actual business or a joke because you actually paid online influencer to influence people to try your restaurant out we left frustrated and hungry. DONT COME HERE waste of time my
Best advise until they get their act together

Sushi potion to rice is perfect. It's rare to find a place that has both good sushi and hot pot and I have found it. The service is excellent. Our waitress name Cathy has fantastic customer service. Check on us often and answer any questions with a smile.

Social media influenced my group to visit Aura Sushi and Hot Pot.

We tried a few different salads (octopus salad, cucumber salad and seaweed salad) - the cucumber salad was a favorite. The rest were so - so; we also ordered sushi and hot pot.

The hot pot - I'd not recommend. The flavor was lacking for the broth and it just seemed off. The sushi was hit or miss - we ordered a handful of different rolls at the table and some were well received (salmon skin hand roll, spicy tuna roll) others - like the Philly roll and baked salmon roll were not the best. We did like the carpaccio we ordered, edamame and takoyaki.

The tuna crispy rice was a favorite of appetizers as well and we also ordered a fish collar which was overcooked and the Greens beans seemed oil logged.

Service was good at the beginning as it was not busy then as the restaurant picked up we had to ask and remind our server to get our bill but she was kind and helpful mostly aside from that.

We all know social media is curated - this didn't quite live up to the hype but was alright.

I absolutely love this place ! The staff were amazing and very attentive and welcoming!
The food was amazing too! The fish was so delicious and fresh that my own boyfriend who doesn't like fish absolutely loved the tuna here ! I love this place the ambiance was amazing!
So much good food. Such good sushi. Food came out fast and cuts of meat/fish were very high quality
Cathy was awesome as our server, she kept the plates coming fast. Excellent quality sushi for AYCE and the hotpot's are outstanding! Will be back again!!

I got the Omakase menu ($49.99) for all-you-can-eat sushi and hot pot, and it was such a steal.
I'm usually skeptical about AYCE spots, but the quality here really surprised me. The sushi was super fresh--honestly tasted like it came straight from Japan. The Omakase platter was beautifully done, and my favorites were the bluefin toro and scallops.

We also tried a bunch of appetizers like the tofu, salmon collar, udon, spicy tuna crispy rice, salmon roll, and carpaccio--and everything was actually really good. We also ordered a few different sushi rolls, all were solid but the one that was my favorite was the spicy scallop roll, chefs kiss for sure! We wanted to try more but got way too full. The hot pot was just as good, especially with the unlimited prime beef. I could honestly eat it every day.

Service was also amazing--super attentive, always checking in, refilling drinks, and they were so kind with our baby making a mess and kept bringing us extra napkins.

Perfect spot for date night, family dinners, or just a good AYCE experience. We'll definitely be back.

I came here for the first time with my big brother from UCI Dance Community. Shoutout INSA Dance. We were here for soft opening. They have only been open for a month so the service wasn't as quick as you expected but the service was top tier. Friendly staff. The sushi took a while to come out - we waited nearly an hour...so we ended up also ordering shabu / hot pot to start before eating what we came for (ayce sushi etc) because it was a hot summer day. I liked the rice to fish ratio for the nigiri. I will def try to come back for lunch special !!! Y'know about that inflation...

Had a great experience at Aura! Everything we ordered was fresh, and the quality of both the sushi and meats exceeded our expectations. The Sukiyaki broth was especially flavorful and paired really well with the meat.

Service was excellent throughout the meal. The staff was friendly, attentive, and quick with refills and clearing plates. Overall, a great spot with quality food and great service. Definitely looking forward to coming back.

0/10 DO NOT RECOMMEND

service: 2/10 horrendous. Had to ask multiple times for green onions with multiple different servers. Was given a little small dish...ask for more was told "they are cutting it" to 10 mins later ... "they ran out"
We weren't check on and had to flag down servers. It was our first time there and would had like a rundown on the menu and how things work...

Side note: they were not busy!! & how can you run out of green onions as a hot pot place...

We came with four adults and one 4yr old toddler. We ordered their Omakase. Which was advertised as their premium fish.

Note everyone at the table must order the same. Which is fine. that's how most all you can eat restaurants works.

BUT....

They brought out 5 and wanted to charge the toddler as a full adult order . I had to complain and said no it's only for 4adults. The server stated it's based on height !!! Not age. (What is this Disneyland...) anyways they ended up charging the toddler half price $25.99

Omakase: 1/10 not good. Nothing premium. The rice was dry like the Sahara desert. Fish was not as fresh as I would had hoped.

Restroom: women's restroom had no soap at all to wash your hands...

Meats: 10/10 they have great cuts of beef. But that's all. Sauce bar is lacking. Making everything else boring to eat. Left unsatisfied and irritated.

Honestly: they should just focus on their all you can eat shabu and have sushi as their side dish.

Oh and their tablet system to order food... this was the first for me...but when you order off the tablet. Once you submit your order you CANNOT order again for another five minutes. The tablet is literally counting down every minute. (You only have 90 min)

Advice: you want great all you can eat with sushi rolls & bang for your buck!! Avenue Shabu is the place to go.

We came here for father's days and was extremely disappointed.

The service is already horrid, stood at the door of this empty shop for like a good 5 minutes before getting seated finally. There seems to be only one or two waiter and the waiters seems rather unfriendly. The menu so far seems rather limited, sashimi isn't all you can eat. The meat quality is really bad, for example, the squid almost feels dried up and old. I wouldn't be surprised if I end up getting food poisoning here. The "limited to 1 per person" sashimi Isn't of that good quality. The hotpot's soups are especially bland, your meat ends up with no flavor like as if its boiled in hot water with an aftertaste. The restaurant itself feels kind of dead, like the atmosphere isn't really lively. If you're looking to go to a ayce hot pot place, I'd recommend nice to meet you or momo paradise for the same price as dinner here. And for ayce sushi, I'd recommend going to sukiya for dinner, as they have a huge buffet and selection of meats and others including drinks for pretty cheap.

Please don't listen to those influencers online promoting, they are probably paid to promote or are just glazing for views.

Very disappointing experience. We waited 10-15 minutes before a waiter or waitress came to take our order. When they finally arrived, they never explained how to use the iPad ordering system, leaving us to figure it out ourselves.

After placing our order, only about half of the food we requested was brought to the table, and we waited at least 30 minutes for food to arrive. To make matters worse, we were charged $40 per person when the advertised price should have been $25 per person.

Overall, the service was poor, the wait times were excessive, and the pricing did not match expectations. There are much better all-you-can-eat Shabu Shabu restaurants out there, and I would recommend going somewhere else.

Food was absolutely incredible and FRESH. Service was off the charts. Everyone working was helping us and very attentive to refills, cleaning up plates, and helping our group since it was our first time here. Highly recommend this new place in HB!!!

Once we sat down- it was an immediate regret.

Customer service wasn't so great- our server went on lunch without saying anything. There was a lot of back and forth.... Staff is trying to figure it out. Their iPad ordering system is terrible and so inconvenient especially if you have a larger group.

Here they only allow It's two person to a small tiny hot pot so we had to keep asking for more broth.

The concept is great - hotpot and a good selection of sushi.

Meat quality was meh, the sauce is store bought.

Being charged dinner prices when it was supposed to be lunch...

Sushi was pretty decent is the only positive.

Was it worth it? Would we come back? No.

Fantastic experience at Aura Sushi.

I ordered the omakese tier which came with some amazing pieces of sushi! The fish to rice ratio is outstanding. Fish tasted fresh and enjoyed all of my rolls.

Excellent quality for AYCE. Meat cuts were all fresh with very generous portions offered.

Service was fantastic! They were kind, accommodating, answered all of our questions and provided suggestions, and attended to our needs constantly to make sure we were content and refilling beverages.

This is a fantastic option for sushi and hotpot combined!

The guest with me ate the meat and enjoyed it with the Sukiyaki broth, but I only ate a limited amount as I wanted sushi more than meat. The meat that I did taste was good and had a sweet flavor from the sukiyaki broth that was enjoyable

Highly recommend giving this place a try!
brianna recommended the omakase dinner for 49.99 all you can eat. fish was fresh and delicious
Food is delicious service is awesome love the music. Hot pot And sushi . Open for lunch and dinner

First we stood at the check in area for 5 minutes no one acknowledged us, then when someone finally said something to us they were very rude and just said you are going to have to wait outside. When we finally got seated we placed our order and the sushi took forever to come out. When it finally did there were so many things that we didn't order. Then one of the rolls never came out. The restaurant was under staffed. We did have a spill at the table, the waitress was right there and didn't hell to clean it up. I waited a few minutes and asked for some extra napkins to clean it up.

Honest review:
2 people came
Ordered dinner omakase (most expensive option) $50 per person

Omakase sushi plate - 3 stars - some were good and some were fishy. Nothing impressive about this plate. Not Sure why it's omakase--they were just sushi with different types of fish.

Beef bone broth - so brand. 1 star - Never order if you want something flavorful. Our server was nice enough to let us add another broth. We added mala and it added some flavor but not good.

Meats - ehhh - 3 stars

Miso soup and shitito pepper - 1 star salty don't order heart attack alert

Side and sauce options - extremely limited - 1 star

Service - friendly and attentive but not happy vibe- 4 stars

Ambient - spacious and clean - 4 stars

They had a system glitch while we were there so some orders didnt come out but didnt really want them as we were tired of the food. Not worth the calories

Although this restaurant claims to have "aura," it actually has NONE. The ambiance of the restaurant was cold and unwelcoming, demonstrated by the dull-colored geometric decorations and table settings. What's so aura-ful about that???
Also, I got food poisoning. Probably from the red-40 tuna. Or the hotpot broth that was more bland than an almond mom. I thought I had made the most of my AYCE sushi and hotpot, but clearly not: the food was so bad that even my stomach didn't want it.
The Instagram promo videos for this restaurant made the food look delectable, but do not be fooled by this. Unless you have a stomach of steel, do not come to this restaurant.

These people delete honest comments on their social media. That says a lot about the place

Food:
-The hotpot was very unappetizing. We should've known because our server asked us at the beginning of the meal if we were even interested in getting one. Broth was super bland. We've tried multiple broths and none had much flavor. Do not expect tonkotsu, bone broth had a weird flavor to it (nevertheless bland). The meats were decent but almost tasted indistinguishable due to the bland broth. Didn't have certain veggies such as carrots and spinach that would've added flavor. Instead it was filled with bean sprouts.
-The sushi was alright but please do not fall for their social media. Unless you order the most expensive level omakase, the fish quality is very dry and bad unlike what they post online. This place uses 2 different quality of fishes. The $29.99 lunch or even $39.99 dinner uses fish that's on par with cheap Chinese buffet, sometimes even worse. Their rolls that do not use fish or the ones with fish drenched in some kind of sauce are good. Please be warned to not order their "seared" fish. Any of it from carpaccio to nigiri, it was not fresh seared fish as you'd get from any ayce sushi restaurants, it was cuts of old fish that was pre-seasoned with a lot of salt and pepper. It tasted like super salty jerky and made our party lost the rest of our appetite.

Service:
-We came for lunch on June 5th after seeing them posted on IG about their ongoing pricing special of $25.99. An older Korean lady who served us said no promotions going on and charged us $29.99 per adult. My husband asked her what about our kids? Our daughter is under 3ft (and needed highchair to reach table) and according to their WRITTEN RULES in menu should be free. She said no free it's by age, all kids charged $14.99. Do not expect them to honor any of their policies here. Very unprofessional and unethical business practices. We saw on Instagram that people who came that day and the day after got the $25.99 pricing, so this place can pick and choose how much they want to charge you. Maybe the server didn't like the fact that we were Asians with 2 kids (3 and 8)? I'm not sure.

-This was our second visit. The first during Mother's Day week was just as bad, and we tried to give them a second chance. The younger female server who was always refilling our waters was the only redeeming factor. It seems like for the most part they haven't figured out their hiccups since opening yet. They kept all the tables and utensils from Slice, which worked as an a-la-carte shabu joint, but very cramp for an ayce shabu plus sushi restaurant; the tables were tiny. Both times we came when they brought out food, they had no idea where to place it down and had to extend it to the next table. We felt super cramp and rushed to eat, it ruined our meal.
-Due to the cramp space that we encountered the first visit too, we asked the same older Korean lady if we could order the carpaccio a serving per round (limit 1 serving per person) and take it slow. She said no, we have to put in the total servings that we wanted, and that's our only chance to get carpaccio for the entire meal. It just came off like they wanted less work and for you to put in all your orders in one round and not bother them the rest of the time.

We will not be returning. We wanted to give local small businesses a chance, but it seems like this place only valued customers who get the omakase. I cannot trust a restaurant that does not honor promotions that were advertised on the SAME DAY and written rules they have on the menu! There are many better ayce shabu and/ or sushi places out there. Perhaps we are spoiled with the immaculate quality of those joints from Vegas. If you're looking for quality shabu (with sushi options) check out House of Shabu Shabu II for $28.99. Oniku with their $25.99 ayce shabu lunch option has much better meat quality.

Food was very tasty, the appetizer choices are extensive and I especially enjoyed the green beans. I like the concept of sushi and Hotpot. This spot is relatively new so be aware of the growing pains, service for sushi was quite slow. However its decent quality sushi, specifically the yellow tail was very delicious. Id give this place a try its worth coming during lunch hour for 30 dollars

This place is alright, but they could work on their service. They're nice people, but we were sat for 25 minutes before even being asked what drinks we wanted. We had to ask to be served. After that, we wanted to order our food and were left for another 15 minutes before I got up and asked them AGAIN to serve us. We shouldn't have to asked to be served, let alone twice. We were then given a QR code to scan and were able to order. Not sure what his name is, but this pretty young guy was super nice. Wasn't even our waiter but he was kinder than the girl serving us.

Food wise, it's good overall. The beefs were pretty good quality, but the broths were bland. The bone broth isn't the typical flavor you expect, it's sweet in a weird artificial way, and super bland. It isn't rich whatsoever. Same goes for the dashi broth. The sushi roles were probably the best out of it all. The sushi quality is top tier. I will give props for that.

The self serve bar was essentially empty. The sauces needed to be refilled, and they ran out of bowls.

Tried once and honestly never again

If you are looking for some different options, then this is a good place to try since it has both AYCE sushi and hotpot. However, due to staffing shortage, be prepared for a the wait. Although, the service is very good!! The quality of the sushi is good for an AYCE place. Not a lot of meat options and hardly any seafood for the hotpot.
Fresh sushi, quality hotpot ingredients, and friendly service. Everything was delicious--we'll definitely be back!
Great food and really nice ambience. I'd definitely come back. Service is super friendly and nice
Rihanna was such a nice and helpful waitress, although we didn't have the best experience, I didn't get half our food our cooked fish came out raw. $260 for 5 people

My experience here today with my family was so frustrating that I felt compelled to share. We arrived around 3:30 PM, and right off the bat, almost every open table was piled high with dirty dishes that hadn't been cleared. We had to wait just to get a clean table.
Once seated, the issues only multiplied.
Missing Essentials & Limited Stock. They were also out of their standard hot pot base soups, we settle for whatever random options they had left.
Extremely Slow Service. We waited 30 minutes just for our first order. We placed a second round of orders that never showed up.
All customers at the restaurant seemed frustrated. After waiting forever for our food, we finally gave up and asked for the check. It took 20 minutes just to get the bill and right as it arrived, our missing second round food finally showed up. Total mismanagement.
When I brought this up, the server just blamed it on being "too busy" but the restaurant wasn't even full. There is absolutely no excuse for service this disorganized. We paid extra for a premium experience and left disappointed.

The customer service was great, But the food was tragic as soon as the broth touched the inside of my stomach I felt my stomach start to brew more then the broth in the pot. DO NOT COME HERE if you are trying to enjoy some broth and food this is not the spot.

If you want Shabu and Sushi this is the place to go! Came here on a Saturday night with our besties visiting from Hawaii! They wanted something that they didnt have back home. So why not try this AYCE spot! We chose the Omakase AYCE ($49.99) service was great even if we were struggling with our orders we still enjoyed it a lot and had lots of laughs.
Eyes were bigger than our stomachs but everything was awesome! Omakase selection is what we got and worth it. Service was great!
Recommend giving this place a try. Ordered the omakase menu and it was worth it! Staff were very friendly and welcoming!
The food was amazing and everyone was super nice. They were super quick to get my food and the place looked luxurious.
this place was amazing. they have good customer service, good fresh sushi, and nice meat choices. the broth is really good and it was worth my time.
Amazing quality sushi and meat! Wonderful ambiance and service! We loved everything we ate, beyond delicious.

Daughter treated my Birthday dinner in here.
We try Hotpot & sushi ( AYCE)
The broth ( Hotpot#2) was flavored for me.
The sushi was okay, we enjoyed it.
They had TV with movie ( if they turned on the Close caption will better , easier understand the story of movie.)
They had nice music during we enjoying our food,
The service okey.
The salad bar just small to choose but okay for me.
Foood and service! Was great all you can eat ! Can't beat it . Sushi was so so so good . Non stop back to back .
Excellent service! Amazing staff. Fresh sushi. Loved it all around. Safe space, and clean area. They just opened, and they have amazing deals for lunch.

My family ended our Cali trip at Aura Sushi and Hot Pot. We had an amazing experience! The hot pot was delicious and the sushi was phenomenal!! The service was top notch and attentive. We are sad that we will be so far away for a return visit.

I was very satisfied being able to enjoy both all-you-can-eat sushi and hot pot in one place.
The sushi was fresh, and the salmon and tuna were especially better than expected.
The hot pot broth was clean and flavorful, and the quality of the meat kept me coming back for more.
If you're looking for a great-value AYCE spot, this place is definitely worth a visit.
From the ambiance to the food, every thing was amazing! The fish was so fresh! The bone broth for the hot pot was yummy! Highly reccomend visiting this spot

Sushi was scrumptious ! hot pot i give it a 1 not so much options for buffet sidings compared to Shibuya
No Greeting the customers once you walk in
And once seated we had to wait 10-15 mins to be approached by our waitress . Dinner promo for $37.99 including hot pot with ayce meat as well

First time here and was very pleasantly surprised! Quality of sushi was so good! The hot pot was very yummy. Everything came out so quickly as well. The service was so prompt and we had an amazing waiter named Brianna! Thank you for an amazing experience, will definitely be back!
Service was really great, servers were kind and fast. Brianna was especially awesome!!
Great service and the quality and variety was impeccable Brianna was our waitress. Will be coming back.

Finally got to try this place! Went for my mom's birthday. The sushi was extremely fresh and not rice heavy which is rare to find in AYCE places. The service was amazing! We had Brianna and she was such a sweetheart. So attentive and helpful as it was our first time trying hot pot. The broth types were great. We mixed half spicy and half bone broth and it was very tasty! The spicy tuna crispy rice was perfect, the salmon and yellowtail nigiri were buttery, and the appetizers were great and such a good variety. Definitely coming back! Great service, great food, and just a great experience overall!

Everything is so perfect !!!
Very good high quality sushi and meat
Inside restaurant is Very clean modern style
Strongly recommend this place
Great food and fresh ingredients! The hot pot broth was really flavorful and the staff was super nice. Would definitely come back :)

We had the best experience here, a huge part of that was thanks to our server Brianna. She was incredibly attentive, kept our hotpot broth topped off, made sure we received our orders at all time and kept our drinks filled. The food was amazing, both sushi and hot pot options did not disappoint. I definitely recommend this new place, will definitely be back!

best sushi and hot pot in the area!
I tried both sushi and hot pot
so unbelievable for fresh and tasty
I will definitely come back soon

Absolutely love this place. I recently started working close by and I love the service here. They have high quality food and definitely take care of their customers. Definitely recommend for a nice night out.

Number one spot in HB, service is unmatched. Staff is top quality. Food is delicious. Having them serve you is a privilege. This place is a must if you are in Huntington Beach!!! You will not be disappointed.

Came here around 1:45 PM just in time for lunch, excited to try out Aura Shabu & Sushi. Right when we walked in, multiple staff members were staring at us but no one bothered to greet or seat us. Two servers literally looked at us and ignored us until one finally said "welcome in," then suddenly everyone else repeated it after already seeing us standing there.

You can definitely tell this place used to be slice Shabu because the interior is exactly the same. Even the tableware is the same, and the name "Slice" is still on the tables. It honestly feels like they just changed the name and reopened.

After getting seated, nobody explained how ordering worked. No instructions on the broth, proteins, or sushi menu. We had to stop a server ourselves just to ask how to order everything.

When the food finally came out, the broths were super watered down. It honestly tasted like hot water with MSG and salt. The whole experience felt unorganized and disappointing overall.

Sadly, this place was pretty mid and not somewhere I would come back to.

The best quality meat and soup base I have ever tried.
Nice mood and good care service.
The service was great and the sushi was fresh. the shabu beef broth was very plain and not flavorful.
super great service and super amazing food, good ambiance and decent prices. thank you 2 wonderful ladies

Drove past by here ánd decided to stop by to give it a try,
The sushi is really fresh. Shabu is very simple and clean.
This new restaurant was very good. Tons of options for both their sushi and hot pot. Highly recommend the spicy tuna hand roll.

Good restaurant! They have kind staff and a good AYCE sushi/shabu deal.

Their sushi is top notch and super tasty!
Went here for lunch during their soft opening. No wait time. There is a QR code for menu selection.
Great food, fresh sushi, and the hot pot was delicious. The staff was friendly and service was fast. Definitely worth it for AYCE -- will be coming back!

Awesome service and awesome food

Make sure to get the omakase here because of the price and the quality

Honestly u don't even need to eat the rest of the food they offer here, I would just get the omakase and be satisfied
