Omakase isn't like a 10/10 but a 7.5/10

What could be better would be the rice.
Rice is a little lacking so if they could improve that, omakase could be a 8.5/10

Try this restaurant on Mother Day with a special price of $25.99. Clean restaurant, great waitress with good customer service skill. I tried mala and sukiyaki broth, which are much better than other places that I tried. Soup tastes just right and I can smell the aromatic of the mala. Eels sushi is so good, and the meat is delicious. Overall, sushi + hot pot all in one place, that's a non-negotiable deal.

Nice clean interior, standard service, good vibes, great location with good parking, and really good food

Unfortunately though, they still need to figure a lot of logistics out with the ordering system. We came in with a party of 15 for Mother's day, already understanding there would be a lot of food going around because there's a lot of us and 2 cuisines available - hot pot and sushi. But it got to a point where we were receiving way too many duplicate orders. And at first we thought maybe some people were ordering extra, but eventually everyone was confused that certain food was coming out as no one had put it in.

We realized there was an issue when they brought out our carpaccio orders 3 separate times with each turn having 15 orders of 4 different fish each. And mind you, carpaccio/nigiri is limited per person and written on paper so it should've already been a blaring red light to the servers that brought out the food that they were giving us way too much of a limited food item but they brought it out anyway.

So overall, I think all the food here is great. Hotpot is standard, but the sushi items specifically were good, the fish is really fresh. Try the yellowtail! But I would wait to come back until they figure out a better ordering system - both qr code system and sushi ordering paper, and maybe don't come with such a big party at least for now.

Golden broth and sushi rolls,
Every bite just warms the soul.
Cozy nights and flavors bright,
A perfect feast from first to last bite.

Our family came for the ayce lunch deal discount they were advertising for Mother's Day. I called the restaurant earlier during the week and the person on the other line confirmed it was $26 lunch special for Mother's Day weekend and that lunch was from opening to 2pm. When our party arrived and seated by our waitress, she also confirmed that it was $26 for lunch. We were excited and started ordering but a moment later the manager came out and said that there was no lunch special price for the weekend and that it was dinner price only. This was not mentioned in the advertisement and so we thought it was kinda shady practice. In addition, the customer service is slow and the process for ordering food is not user friendly at all. They make the customer order food by using a QR code, writing on a piece of paper, and finally telling the waitress what food item to bring out. The process is too excessive instead of using one source to order everything. For the premium price you pay here, there are better places elsewhere to eat sushi/hotpot that's better in service. We won't be back.

Amazing experience! Their AYCE omakase is a must-try. Every dish was delicious, and all of the hot pot meats were top quality. The staff was incredibly attentive from start to finish. Will definitely come back!!
We had the omakase. Top quality sushi and prime grade meat!! Would easily recommend. So sad I didn't have enough space in my belly to try out everything on their menu.
Food was good love the sushi a lot of different options. Service was fast everything came out quick. Nice ambiance great for family.

We got food poisoning here. My family ate here last night, and as soon as we left the restaurant, I started feeling sick and ended up vomiting right outside in the driveway. I've felt terrible all morning, and now my child has diarrhea as well. This place seriously needs to improve its food safety and stop serving unsafe food to customers.

Came in with a party of 6 on a Friday night and we got seat immediately (there were only 2 parties of 2 seated.) Service was slow and all of the servers seemed confused. They dropped off 4 plates of food that we did not order. The Asian hostess/ server was not friendly. The only 2 stars is for the girl with the brown/reddish hair in bubble braids! Super sweet & friendly and walked around with a smile.

Food was ok. Mid way, they brought out an omakase service on the house. I asked if we could take 3 instead of the full 6 but they said it was already made. Very sweet & I truly did appreciate it but we were already stating to get full before that came out.

When we asked for the check, they brought it out & the Asian host/server said "just wanted to let you guys know that next time, we're gonna charge you guys for the unfinished food but not for today since we're on soft opening." Completely understandable since it's aye but they brought out SIX omakase plates + 6 sashimi rice bowls mid meal.. I feel like that was a little unnecessary because we would have finished our food had they not brought out 6 extra plates that we did not order.

Maybe let customers know at the beginning so they could plan accordingly?

All in all, I won't be back or recommending to others. Overpriced (we got it on a soft opening special $38 but would not pay $48) & bad service.

I can vouch for the other reviewer that the service or opening if this restaurant was not prepared properly. There was a lot of stalling and waiting on behalf of the stuff everytime something was brought Out Whether it be napkins, water, utensils, and so forth. It wasnt even that busy. Other hotpot places I been to service Was Quick even with 15 tables full So it's kinda Questionable here. For a place where you cook yourself shouldnt take that long. Price just ain worth it. I'm going back to Shabuya or HotC

Called in to confirm if they were still running their Mother's Day special and the older lady who picked up couldn't understand me and also said they don't know about the promotion so they wouldn't honor it. Had me call their manager's number to ask them but they didn't pick up the phone. Decided to stop by anyways because we had already made lunch plans with family and were in the area.

Came during their soft opening so they're still trying to figure out how to run smoothly. We waited 20 minutes to be seated even though there were a lot of empty tables and three front employees. One of the employee finally acknowledged us then told us there's a bit of a wait bc the kitchen is backed up. Ok, we waited.
We thought the wait to be seated was going to be it but it was throughout the entire meal. We had to check in with them a couple of times to see if our order was ready. Mind you, we're ordering everything ourselves through our phones so we're not even asking the waiter to take our orders. When we ask the waiter/waitress to check, that's when they'll bring the meat that's already been prepared out, meanwhile they're just kind of standing in the corner.
When I asked the waitress for a soup so we could sip the soup from the hot pot, she looks puzzled and says they only have plastic utensils. Funny, you only have plastic spoons for hot broth? When she finally put the pieces together that we received no spoon at the beginning for the hot pot, she brought some out.

Food
2.5/5 - Everyone has their own taste preferences. Sushi was alright, not bad.
Shrimp tempura didn't have that light fluffy crunch, batter was thick and the shrimp was overcooked like they battered an already cooked shrimp and then fried it. Meat quality wasn't great. Brisket was so chewy, it ended up in a napkin. Beef belly had way more fat than meat, bulgogi was alright. I've had better dipping sauce. They only had udon for a carb option. Veggie bowl included bok choy, chewy Napa cabbage, squash, mushroom, and a bunch of bean sprout.

Wouldn't crave or come back to this place as there are better options out there.

Found this delicious ayce sushi/shabu on yelp and it's definitely being added to my go to places. Came on a Friday night and there was no wait. Their quality of sushi is way better than all the other ayce sushi spots in Orange County. Other places should take notes on their fish to rice ratio because it was perfect. Service was phenomenal, servers were super sweet, and answered all our questions. I highly recommend coming here before the public finds out how good this place is because I strongly believe they are going to have a long waiting time on the weekend! This place also has hot pot but I personally think their sushi is the star of the show. So please check this place out!!! My favorite was the salmon, tuna, and yellowtail nigiri. For shabu my favorite meat was beef belly and was very good quality
Authentic sushi. Fresh parts, great rice to fish ratio, and very friendly staff. Everything we ordered was fire. If you're looking for a solid sushi, here it is. Can't wait to come back!

Stopped by during their soft opening for lunch. The new environment has a modern vibe, and everything looks clean and beautifully designed. The food was exceptional, and the overall experience was great. Definitely looking forward to coming back again.

Great service overall. Called a few days prior to make a reservation since we had a large party. Then kept calling back because our party kept growing. They are very accommodating and genuinely nice. Got there a little early and the service from the two guys was on point. We will definitely be back. Thank you to the staff!!
Food service and ambiance excellent!!! We have come back from Costa Rica just to visit again.
If I'm craving shabu on an empty stomach this is the spot for ayce. Workers are so nice and friendly. They always got great music playing.

Another fabulous experience here! And once again, excellent customer service! Everyone was very attentive and helpful. Of course, Andrew is THE BEST! Fun, bubbly guy who personalizes the experience. I love this little place! I hate waiting during peak hours, but I don't want them to get bigger. This is definitely still our go-to shabu place and where we take friends and family!

Came here with a group of about 10 people. Service was fantastic and the orders never stopped coming, which was great. All the meat choices are good, even on the lower tier. We ordered a lot of cabbage and broccoli!
Such amazing food and great service. The meat was delicious and the vegetables were crisp! We will be back here!!

Been over 6 plus years since coming here so it's good to see they have around and expanded Located off golden west same area with the habit and tastea Indoor diningWaitlist on yelp Shabu options with à la carte and 2 types of packages silver and goldIncludes appetizer multiple rounds of consumption as long as finished and dessert Starting at $37 and basically the difference is 3 additional protein on gold package Service was ok. Seem like only 1 hostess who also took orders but also multiple staff members standing around chatting amongst themselves and not really paying attention to when waters could be filled or offering to refill broth or checking up Didn't really explain how anything worked with orderingCounter and tables available. Sports on yes Clean restaurant overall Could be loud and very quiet We tried out the silver package and was provided an order form Quality of meat rounds were hearty portion beef pork chicken option and j believe shrimp as wellStandard veggies of bok choy spinach Napa cabbage fish cake tofu carrots zucchini mushroom Overall not bad and hit the spot for being hungry but service and attention to detail lacked.No immediate rush to return back in the near future.

Nolan's girlfriend was a phenomenal server! Super sweet and helpful. Our favorite shabu spot - great deal, high quality meat, and always great service! Wagyu Chuck eye is our fav, and the spicy miso broth is a vibe. Thanks Nolan's girlfriend!

This review is long overdue. This is a delicious AYCE hot pot Japanese restaurant in Westminster at the edge of Huntington Beach. It is right off the 405 fwy and a 2 minute drive from Bella Terra. We went for the AYCE lunch special. Our server was Tuan, he was helpful, friendly, and knowledgeable. We ordered the Kombu and Spicy Miso. For meats we got the pork belly and brisket, which was tasty! The vegetables were fresh and plentifulI. If you are looking for great food and service, this is the place for you!

Hands down, my favorite shabu spot. my fiancé & I come here all the time with my brother and sister in law, and it's one of our favorite guilty pleasures to enjoy together. We love coming during happy hour because the prices are so much better & honestly, the quality and quantity of food are unmatched.You get endless veggies/ & meat for your soup, and on top of that, fried appetizers that you can keep ordering throughout your visit as well. If you like your broth spicy, ask for the hot drops!! My sister in law loves spicy and always adds extra. I'm a bit of a wimp, so I stick to about three drops, but it definitely adds a nice kick and is super yummy.The place is always clean, and the servers are consistently nice and accommodating. I've tried several other hot pot spots since coming here, and this one is still my favorite overall. I recommend it to anyone and everyone looking for a great hot pot experience.
Great service, great food, with great companies!Loved the variety, French fries, gyoza, meat selections, vegetables, and free ice cream!

Food is SS++ tier everything was amazing, came last night and left so full and satisfied. Service is insanely excellent and I was treated graciously. It's ayce restaurant but I just got the smallest size, which is already enough. Workers are all so friendly and the atmosphere is great.
We came here after paddle boarding and we also wanted to celebrate our friend's birthday. We were hungry and this AYCE place hit the spot. Good service.Please come and create your own adventure.

service was so amazing and everyone was so attentive!! had my drink refills right away and everyone is so nice the food was just as good the flavor is amazing i tried the spicy miso broth and it was just amazing everything was amazing !! the entire place is so welcoming and has such a calm feel to it. i will definitely be returning! 10/10 place !!!

Shinobu's are slept on. Never understand how this shabu place and their sister Japanese bbq spot are as empty as they are, but helps to get served quickly.Used to come pre ayce option, but now with ayce, it's even better.Servers are always so friendly and definitely remember the regulars. Meat quality is good and sides/sauces are great, especially the fried shrimp. Overall great place.
My granddaughter's favorite place to eat for her birthday dinner.Food and service are always excellent.

Manager Kevin and his staff took care of my group. They were constantly refilling drinks, broth and picking up our selection menu. All the meats and broth had great flavor and veggies were fresh. Highly recommend coming here for a premium Shabu experience!

The food is consistently high quality: the "all you can eat" format gives you plenty of variety (from thinly sliced meats and fresh seafood to a generous selection of vegetables and noodles). One highlight is their Spicy Miso and Tonkotsu broths -- rich in flavor, comforting, and customizable with added chili oil or other seasoning. The meat selection impressed us too: the short ribs and ribeye had wonderful marbling and cooked beautifully in the broth.The service was spot on! They came over constantly to check on us and make sure we were good . I also like that the tables are far from each other which gives you a lot of space

Stopped by 8Hotpot & Grill Buffet a few weeks ago. I had the full ayce buffet the first time. Much better than I anticipated. ;)Also enjoyed the jello and mixed dessert drinks after dinner.Came back again recently for the individual hot pot. I went with the beef hotpot choice and that was excellent. Requested no pig blood cake and no tendon and server brought out a plate with extra sliced beef instead. Beef was lean and very tender. Everything was delicious: broth, meat, veggies abd herbs, and a side of noodles.So perfect for one person.Will bring my family back soon.My only recommendation for the restaurant is running the a/c during business hours. With so many grills and hotpot's going at the same time, the place feels so congested and our clothes & hair had the lingering smell of smoke for hours after.Service was excellent. Server and the owner lady kept on checking and made sure everything was good. They were very nice.
Lẩu bò & lẩu cua đồng ngon. Giá hợp lý đặc biệt cho giờ trưa.Cám ơn chị người làm (trung niên, đeo mắt kính) rất dễ thương và chu đáo làm bữa ăn thấy ngon miệng hơn.

After seeing countless TikTok and Instagram posts promoting their hot pot for $14.99, I was skeptical. Most influencer reviews aren't exactly known for their honesty. But my husband and I decided to give it a shot anyway.We arrived at 11am to an empty restaurant which didn't exactly boost our confidence, but we pushed through and ordered the crab and beef hot pot. We were pleasantly surprised! The broth was rich and flavorful, the portions were generous, and the meat selection was impressive. The beef hot pot alone came with short ribs, tendon, beef balls, Vietnamese ham, and sliced beef. I left completely full.The servers were warm and attentive, which made the experience even better.Would I come back? Absolutely. Sometimes the hype is real. This is one of those times.
Happy hour was so goood! Didn't expect such good quality meats. Our mini pot was loaded! The veggies are pretty fresh and decent too. All that for $15 was crazy

My family and I got the lunch hotpot deal each for 15.99. I chose the crab flavored hotpot, which included seafood proteins like crab cake pieces, shrimp, imitation crab, and comes with a plate full of noodles and fresh herbs to put in the soup.The staff was very friendly, and the service was great.

Came on a weekday for a group of 6 and we had a wonderful meal!We loved that this was a vietnamese type of hot pot. They have a variety of hot pot broth selections. I got the house special (thai) and canh chua. The broth was so flavorful. The owner was really nice. He explained the whole menu to us and when we finished ordering, he walked us over to the buffet area where we explained each item to us. He told us if we needed anything to just let him know. Super sweet.The drinks are also an amazing deal. If you order sugarcane it is buy 3 get 1 free. Or if you order the other drinks it's buy 1 get 1 free (ex. Thai tea). I would definitely come back again. For such a great price, this place is definitely worth it.

If you love Vietnamese hot pot, you have to try these two specials at 8 HotPot & Grill AYCE in Westminster!First, the Lẩu Sườn Bò comes with rich beef bone broth, premium beef ribs, rare beef, tendon, beef balls, fish cake, and thick noodles. It's hearty, flavorful, and so satisfying!Then there's the Lẩu Riêu Cua, featuring a delicious crab-based broth with tomatoes, crab, pork blood, fish cake, fried tofu, and fresh herbs.And here's the deal: both hot pots are only $14.99 during Happy Hour from 11 AM to 5 PM daily, regularly $18!They also offer all-you-can-eat hot pot and BBQ with over 35 options, including American Wagyu, BBQ short ribs, seafood, vegetables, and snow crab legs during dinner.
Amazing deal with Vietnamese hot pot and delicious drinks! Ongoing deal for $15 of Vietnamese hot pot!
Food was great and recommend got to come the service and people were amazing! The happy hour deal was super affordable for myself, my girlfriend and my dad to enjoy a vacation lunch to visit him
I love the vibe of the vibe of this restaurant. The staffs are very friendly and there are many options of food for you to try.

The service and hospitality was excellent! Just a bunch of friendly, good, and positive people here!The inside is huge! Plenty of space and tables. Its nice inside with the theme. They have these black and goldish color tables with hot pot burners and an interesting grill in the middle using some type of parchment paper. They give you a bottle of butter to drizzle it over the paper to grill the meat. It doesnt look like it gets too hot but it definitely will cook your meat and it doesn't burn nearly as bad as the Korean bbq ones. I chose the hot pot and bbq with snow crab legs today. Its 24$ for lunch hot pot and grill. 27$ for everyday dinner and weekend hot pot and grill. 1$ discount if you pay cash. Its 33$ for hot pot and grill with crab. I think this is a steal. These prices don't include drinks. There are 9 different broths and you can choose 2. None of them are spicy. I chose the pork bone and beef. The beef tasted a little like pho.As far as meats goes, there's not much. This place is very limited in hot pot and grill options. They don't have beef belly or pork belly or much seafood. They do have a calamari skirt that was decent. They had galbi, but it lacks a lot of flavor. All their meats lacked a lot of flavor.What I did enjoy was the sauces and salads. They had so many different vietnamese sauces from nuc mam cham to ginger fish sauce to soy sauce and fermented tofu sauce. I loved the pig ear salads. I also liked their veggie options. They had a good amount of choices. I ate the clams and the offal items. I generally like intestines or tripe and this of that nature. They didn't have intestines or tripe though.I ate my fair share of crabs as it wasnt big but it tasted good. It wasnt salty and they kept a flow of it coming! They're really good about refilling and bringing things out.They had some jello and oranges for dessert. For hot foods they had salt and pepper shrimp, fried fish, small fried crab and others. I did not enjoy this section as much as everything lacked flavor or didn't match my flavor style.All and all, I would definitely come again. Great deal and above average food!

I came during lunch when it was only $24, and it honestly felt like a steal for the quality and variety.The first thing that impressed me was how fresh everything looked. We arrived right when they opened, and the vegetables were vibrant, crisp, and fully stocked. My favorite soup base was the tom yum--it was packed with flavor and had just the right amount of heat and tanginess. I could've happily enjoyed that broth on its own.I also loved that the hot bar wasn't just an afterthought. They had unlimited marinated crab, stir-fried egg noodles, and several other prepared dishes that were actually worth going back for. The grill selection was just as good. The skewers and shrimp were my favorites, and adding a little of the provided butter while grilling made everything taste even better.The restaurant itself is spacious with plenty of seating, making it a great option for bigger groups or celebrations. The staff kept an eye on our table, cleared plates quickly, and were always friendly whenever we needed something. Between the fresh ingredients, flavorful broths, and great service, this is definitely a place I'll be returning to.

We stopped by on the way to La for lunch and didn't expect much for 23.99 , but this place was amazingThe miso soup base was one of the best I've had, maybe it was the actual seaweed that they put in there but it was super rich in flavorThe house special soup was also uniquely good, it was Thai soup base with just the right amount of lemon grass.The side selection was pretty typical outside of these razor clam that I've never seen before at a ayce hot pot place but they just went so well with the soup.The old lady that helped us was also extremely friendly and made sure we had everything we neededOverall, 10/10 especially for the lunch price
Place busy and many choices.Take 3.5 out of 5.Staff works hard and keeps things good.taste some food are good, other are better.Come with an empty belly.

Saw how cheap their AYCE was and had to try it. The shop is in a busy plaza in Westminster next to a com tam place. Did the dinner all you can eat for the crab legs. They have plenty of fresh meat and fish in fridges for you to cook and plenty of veggies and sauces. The kalbi was my highlight as well as the tong ho veggie which is a recent favorite. The crab legs were also nice and meaty. Definitely come hungry!
Everything was good, love this place. Service was really good, I got 9 types of broth to choose, and the drinks were great. It was amazing. I'll come back again.

Mình đã có dịp trải nghiệm quán lẩu và nướng với mức giá buffet chỉ 26.99 và cảm thấy khá hài lòng. Thực đơn đa dạng với nhiều loại thịt, hải sản, rau và món ăn kèm tươi ngon. Đồ nướng được tẩm ướp vừa vị, còn nước lẩu đậm đà "tùy theo khẩu vị mỗi người". Không gian quán thoáng mát, nhân viên phục vụ nhanh nhẹn và nhiệt tình. Với mức giá 26.99, đây là một lựa chọn rất đáng để thưởng thức cùng gia đình hoặc bạn bè. Mình chắc chắn sẽ quay lại và sẵn sàng giới thiệu quán cho mọi người.
Service was really good. The waiters were nice and took care of us carefully.I loved the broths there and many kinds of food, so I had variety options to try.I'll come back again.

I was very disappointed with my experience here. For an all-you-can-eat hot pot and Korean BBQ that costs around $28 per person, I expected much better quality.The food was the biggest letdown. The meat was very poor quality--tough, chewy, and lacked freshness. The only item that was somewhat acceptable was the Korean BBQ beef, but even that was hard and not tender. The chicken feet were so tough they were practically inedible. Some of the frozen items were still stuck together, making it obvious they hadn't been thawed properly before serving.The grill was also disappointing. Instead of grilling directly on the grill, they covered it with a thin sheet, which completely took away the grilled flavor.The drinks weren't any better. They advertised buy one, get one free, so I ordered the soy milk drink. It was so watered down that I could barely taste any soybean at all.The restroom was another major issue. It looked like it hadn't been cleaned in a long time. There was a dead cockroach on the floor, the sink was dirty, and the toilet paper dispenser was empty. A dirty restroom makes me question the cleanliness of the kitchen as well.The only positive thing I can say is that the restaurant was quiet with no wait. Unfortunately, after eating here, I can understand why.Overall, I don't think this restaurant offers good value. The food quality simply doesn't justify the price. Personally, I wouldn't pay $28 for this meal again--in fact, I don't think it was even worth $15.

Great service , all servers were so helpful and kind especially Dung, Big thank you for helping us. First time eating here and really enjoyed the experience. Definitely coming back with the family for the delicious soups so flavorful.

We came on a Sunday night around 8pm. The staff were all super friendly. It was our first time so they explained how to use everything and recommended a few things to us which was nice.It felt like going to my mom's house when she's hosting a potluck. I don't know how else to explain it. I felt like I was eating food made by family - some very tasty, some okay, some not good. But the variety was just enough for me to enjoy my meal. I got the sour cabbage broth and the miso broth which I really liked. I have no complaints about the shabu meats. we tried the Korean short rib which I liked. It's not the cleanest but I'm very pleased with how friendly the staff was and the food was good. I don't know if I'll be coming back since we're not from here but I might if we're in this area again!

TLDR: It's $29.99 for an AYCE where you are given grill and soup access. The concept makes it feel like a bargain; the quality of the food and options will make them feel like a ripoff. It's worth trying, but I'd be amazed (and disappointed) in myself if I choose to come back here. Soup: You get 2. I got the mushroom and beef soup. Good news, the beef soup is basically pho soup, a half decent pho soup. Mushroom soup was.... just mushroomy. I did enjoy it more by mixing the two. Grill: It's a normal grilled just layered with parchment paper. They give you liquefied butter to help with the greasing up of the paper in the initial cooking phase. Things cook fine without the butter after the grill gets going. Cooked foods: They're in a buffet warmer, but I'd say they're closer to room temperature. You get deep fried blue crab legs, fried fish fillet, pork bone soup, clams, vegetables, and a few more options. They're good enough to try, but you could feel that they've been sitting there for a few hours. For the grill / soup: The "US Wagyu" thinly sliced meat is so frozen that you're gonna have a hard time removing it form the container. Thankfully, the rest of the ensemble is just refrigerated. Bulgogi is decent, the pork teriyaki is decent, the fish options aren't seasoned, but it's fixable with the butter and sides. Basically, you get 8-10 ish options where you'll say, okay. It's a bunch of okays, and I think some people will be fine with that. Unfortunately, I'd rather pay $2-3 more to get a bunch of good. Given the poor state (and look) of the food options here, I would recommend cooking everything medium well or well done, just to be safe. Miscellaneous hotpot section: You get pho noodles or egg noodles, a bunch of vegetable options, an assortment of squid balls, fish balls, imitation crab, shellfish, and other low-cost items to add body to your pot. Appetizer table: I'm not gonna lie. I didn't touch anything here. I'm just telling you that it exists, and it's all eaten cold. Dessert: Fruits. Cool. If you want ice cream, that's ala carte. $2 ish per cup depending on the flavor. Ambiance: These are one of the places where I'll just tell you to look at the food and nothing else. The place feels like it's seen better days. Everything on the buffet section feels like it's more than 10 years old, or bought 2nd hand from a failed restaurant. The tools/utensils provided are generally stained, and you could tell that they just wipe the surface when cleaning, as the crevices are on the darker end. I came in at 6pm on a Friday and it was a ghosttown. Thankfully, people started coming in closer to 7pm. Remember the meat section? The part where you expect to get most of your money's worth? They're the only place that hides most of their stock at the back. The thin beef slices only had 5 containers in the freezer, and they'd refill it only when it dropped to zero. I understand if they do that to maintain freshness, but even the stuff coming from the kitchen is frozen, so they clearly prepped this beforehand already. It's just eerie when you're basically coming in to what feels like the very start of dinner rush, and the place isn't stocked. Service: Good. The staff are polite, they try their best to give you what you want, and they're working with what they have, which isn't a whole lot.

I'm not a complete clean freak however this place really needs some polishing. We walked in around 4pm and no one was inside. A nice lady came out and explained everything to us. We came at an odd hour apparently so things weren't fully stocked.We got the hotpot & grill combo. The meats were a little skeptical. The hot foods were also a little skeptical because I dont know how long its been sitting out there.The flavors of the broth that we got were good. But i dont know if i'd come back.

Love that I dont have to pick between hotpot & grill because they offer both here. So many different broth options to choose from & you can do half/half to try 2 broths! I got the #1 & the #5. Both very flavorful.Lots of sauces to choose from/make your own dipping sauces. The fridge has different meats to grill, the counter has things for your hot pot and there's also a section of cooked foods that they keep in the warmers.Overall I think its a great price for what you're getting. I just do wish it was a little bit cleaner - if you can look past the cleanliness, then I think you'll be fine.We were the only family in during that time (we went like around 4pm so it was an odd hour to eat) but they were very attentive. The guy working was very nice and the lady was so sweet, always checking on us and she made sure my toddler had food to eat too. Reminded me so much of Vietnam for their hospitality.
So far so good! I've gotten 2 to good to go orders and the food was great! The service was nice and the food is really yummy and I see myself coming back here again and again in the future.

8 Hot Pot Grill Buffet AYCE in Garden Grove was an amazing experience. The side dishes were a big highlight crab, chicken wings, and Vietnamese-style snacks were all really good. I also loved that the food bar was constantly being refilled with vegetables, sides, and other fresh options, so everything stayed stocked and ready.The hot pot and grill options were great, especially the Thai-flavor soup base, which was my favorite. The beef was delicious, and they even had wagyu meat, which made the AYCE experience feel extra worth it.Overall, this is a great spot for anyone who loves hot pot, grill, and a wide variety of sides. Great food, lots of choices, and everything kept coming out fresh. I would definitely come back.

In a busy plaza with many other eateries. We came in on a Saturday. No line, but a good amount of tables occupied. It's a combo of Hot pot & bbq for $26.99, but if you pay cash you save $1 per person. Or if you want to add snow crab to your meal it's an additional cost per person. We went with the cash discount amount of $25.99 per person. For the hot pot, you have an option of 2 soup bases for each individual pot. We tried the house special, pork, bone, spicy miso, and sour viet soup. My favorite was the sour viet soup and house special. All soups were pretty flavorful and tasted very Vietnamese. The grill was different. They lay something like a parchment paper over the grill and then add melted butter on top, the you add your choice of protein. We did not particularly like anything that was grilled. The hot pot was more enjoyable. Once you order your soup bases, you get up and grab plates full of veggies/noodles/seafood/meat to add to your hotpot, meats/seafood to grill, hot appetizers, cold appetizers/pickled veggies, sauces, and dessert (fruit or jello).The cold appetizers and pickled veggies were pretty good. The hot appetizers my family enjoyed: especially the snails, crab, and shrimp. There was a bit of a variety of veggies. The meat and seafood didn't seem very fresh. Usually I don't eat fish, but the swai fish with the sour soup was probably the best. Which is not saying much. The dessert was good. Pandan jello was a bit hard, but edible. Cut oranges and watermelon were really sweet. There was also this hello/chia seed drink that I really enjoyed. Overall decent meal, but not sure if we will come back. Cleanliness was questionable, don't look too closely at the floors, tables were a bit sticky. They are also on the app Too Good To Go if you do that, they give a good amount.

The weekday was so slow, so at first it felt a little confusing and honestly made me a bit afraid to try it But after eating here, I can say this place is excellent!The all-you-can-eat crab for only $35 is super worth it and honestly feels very cheap for the quality and amount you get. The crab was fresh, sweet, juicy, and had no fishy smell at all. Everything tasted really good, especially the seafood and hot pot.The service was also amazing -- very friendly staff, good service, and they always made sure we had everything we needed. The restaurant was clean, comfortable, and perfect for eating with friends and family.Definitely one of the best seafood/hot pot spots I've tried. I'll absolutely come back again! Highly recommend if you love unlimited crab and seafood. I think this place deserves more attention and ads because the food and value are honestly so good.
Good food, food service, nice vietnamese music. We were there for lunch on Fri for our anniversary and enjoyed everything! Highly recommended.

Service was great and workers were kind but the restaurant is just filthy. Restrooms were terrible with the sink nearly falling off the wall and broken tiles on the floor. Utensils and tables were dirty. I was given tongs that still had food on in as if he grabbed it from the dirty bucket. Just overall looked deserted and run down. Quality of meat was average and questionable. Not many choices for veggies and noodles for being a hotpot ayce. The warm food choices were old and cold. $28.99 could be better spent elsewhere.
